鱼体土黄色至蓝灰色，幼鱼眼部有一黑色横带，随生长黑色横带逐渐缩小乃至消失，尾柄处有一橙色横带；成鱼腹部有6～7条蓝色纵纹，体侧后上部有一大块椭圆形黑斑，背鳍第四棘延长成丝状。栖息于珊瑚礁海域珊瑚茂盛处。 [2]鞭蝴蝶鱼图册
性格温柔，以其他鱼类的卵、珊瑚虫、海绵、藻类和小型无脊椎动物为食。生活在珊瑚丛中，适应力很强。海（洋）生。 [3-4]鞭蝴蝶鱼

斯氏似弱棘鱼（Hoplolatilus starcki）又名蓝面鸳鸯，为鲈形目、弱棘鱼科、似弱棘鱼属一种生存于近海珊瑚礁区的热带海水鱼类。斯氏似弱棘鱼分布于印太海域巴厘岛，印度尼西亚，菲律宾海域，北至马里亚纳海域南至新克里多尼亚等多处海域，多在珊瑚礁周边游荡，觅食各类有机物碎屑，遇危险时会游进珊瑚礁中躲避。可作为观赏鱼。
体极长，标准 [1]体长为体高的3.7-4.6；背鳍前无任何高凸的脊。吻短。口大，端位；上颌骨延伸至眼后部下方；上下颌齿具细小圆锥状齿。前鳃盖边缘具锯齿，主鳃盖棘退化。鳃耙数，22-27。侧线鳞孔100-108。背鳍基底长，具硬棘VIII，软条21-24；臀鳍亦长，具硬棘II，软条15-16；尾鳍深叉形。体黄褐色，腹侧较淡；头部蓝色，一直延伸至的鳍基部。背、臀鳍淡黄色，有时背鳍为淡蓝色；尾鳍鲜黄色，上、下叶及中部具白缘。
主要栖息于礁石陡坡外缘石砾堆底质海域，通常成对活动，遇到危险时会迅速躲进洞穴里。以小型甲壳类为食。
分布于西太平洋区，西起摩鹿加，东至密克罗西亚，北至南沙群岛，南至新加勒多尼亚。台湾分布于南沙群岛。

宅泥鱼（学名：Dascyllus aruanus），又称三间雀、厚壳仔、三带圆雀鲷，是雀鲷科宅泥鱼属的辐鳍鱼纲鱼类，分布于红海、印度洋至太平洋热带海域，包括中国南海诸岛、海南岛及台湾周边 [3-4]。体呈银白色，体长约60mm，具3条黑褐色横带，腹鳍黑色，一纵列鳞25—27个，眶前骨与眶下骨具锯齿 [3]。
该鱼栖息于珊瑚礁区，集群活动时由雄鱼领导形成群体，常与同种个体争夺栖息空间 [2] [4]。以浮游动物及藻类为食，繁殖期雄鱼护卵并具攻击性，卵约3-5天孵化 [1] [4]。人工饲养时需维持5条以上的群体以观察社会行为，水质变化会导致体色加深及争斗加剧 [1-2]。作为国际贸易量较大的观赏鱼，其人工繁殖已成功 [1]。印度洋与太平洋种群因冰期海平面下降导致基因交流受限，形成不同遗传谱系 [5]。
台湾鱼类志(沈等, 1993)；Fishbase(2005)；Fishes of Japan(Nakabo, 2002)
体呈圆形而侧扁，标准体长为体高之1.5-1.7倍。吻短而钝圆。口中型；两颌齿小而呈圆锥状，靠外缘之齿列渐大且齿端背侧有不规则之绒毛带。眶前骨具鳞，眶下骨具鳞，下缘具锯齿；前鳃盖骨后缘多少呈锯齿。体被栉鳞；侧线之有孔鳞片15-19个。鳃耙数23-24。背鳍单一，软条部不延长而呈角形，硬棘XII，软条11-13；臀鳍硬棘II，软条11-13；胸鳍鳍条17-19；尾鳍叉形，上下叶末端略呈圆形。体呈白色，体侧具3条黑色横带；在吻部与眶间骨间的头背部上具一个大的褐色斑点；唇暗色或白色的；尾鳍灰白；腹鳍黑色；胸鳍透明。宅泥鱼图册

点纹斑竹鲨，是须鲨目须鲨科 [6]斑竹鲨属 [7]底栖小型鲨 [8]。体延长细狭，浅黄褐色，尾细长；吻宽而圆钝，眼小，具鼻口沟；口宽大，平横，上下颌具唇褶；齿小，齿头三角形，侧齿头细狭或无，多行；尾鳍狭长，上叶较狭，下叶前部不突出，与中部连合呈广圆形；臀鳍低长，与尾鳍下叶毗连。
点纹斑竹鲨分布于中国台湾海域和南海，印度、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、印尼、越南及澳大利亚沿岸也有分布。常栖息于松软的沙泥质或珊瑚礁或潮间带水坑中。夜行性，以小型甲壳动物及鱼类为食。卵生，卵壳扁平形，孵化约需要4个月。 [9]
出于自我保护意识，点纹斑竹鲨会像变色龙一样，体色会根据周围环境而变化，所以是“鲨鱼家族里的变色龙” [10]，具有一定的观赏性。 [11]点纹斑竹鲨在《世界自然保护联盟濒危物种红色名录》中属于近危（NT）保护等级。 [12]
点纹斑竹鲨最初由Müller & Henle于1838年描述并命名为Chiloscyllium punctatum。属名Chiloscyllium源自希腊语“cheilos”（意为嘴唇）和“skylla”（被定义为一种鲨鱼）。 [3]

王子雀鲷（学名：Pomacentrus vaiuli (Jordan & Seale, 1906)）是雀鲷科雀鲷属的鱼类，体侧扁呈卵圆形，体长可达10厘米。幼鱼体表呈蓝紫色，头背部为橘黄色并具2至3条蓝色细纵带，背鳍后方有黑眼斑；成鱼全身黄紫色，鳞片具深色缘与紫色斑点，背鳍保留黑斑，鳃盖上方有小绿斑。背鳍具13枚硬棘与15-16枚软条，臀鳍具2枚硬棘与15-16枚软条。
本鱼分布于印度西太平洋区，包括日本、台湾、越南至萨摩亚群岛等海域 [1]，栖息于礁体外围圆石或碎礁区域，活动水深为1-45米。幼鱼常隐匿于礁石缝隙，成鱼杂食性，以丝状藻及小型无脊椎动物为食，繁殖期产出黏着卵。该物种为常见观赏性鱼类。
纲：硬骨鱼纲 Teleostei；系：卵附系 Ovalentaria；目：鲈形目 Perciformes；科：雀鲷科 Pomacentridae；亚科：雀鲷亚科 Pomacentrinae；属：雀鲷属 Pomacentrus；种：王子雀鲷 Pomacentrus vaiuli。 [2] [4]王子雀鲷
词源：属名 Pomacentrus 源于希腊语 “poma”（盖、鳃盖）与 “kentron”（刺），指其鳃盖骨上的棘刺。 [2] [4]

线纹异齿鳚，Ecsenius lineatus (Klausewitz, 1962)，鳚科异齿鳚属的一种鱼类。
体延长，稍侧扁，似圆柱状；头钝短。前鼻孔具1鼻须，无眼上须及颈须。齿骨前后方各具一犬齿。侧线无成对的侧线孔。D. XII, 16-18；A. II, 19-20； P. 13； V. I, 3。背鳍具缺刻；背鳍、臀鳍最后软条与尾柄以鳍膜相连；尾鳍鳍条均不分支。体侧上半部，从鳃盖后至尾鳍基部约有10个黑斑，形成一纵带；头部有2条黄纹，较上的一条由眼上缘延伸至体上半部，下面一条较短只限于头部。背鳍基部另有黑纹；活鱼时体色为浅黄色，背鳍基部为橙纹。

斑点长尾须鲨（学名：Hemiscyllium ocellatum）是竹鲛科、长尾须鲨属鱼类。最大总长度为107厘米。体小而纤细，鼻子短。它有一条口鼻沟，将嘴巴和鼻孔连接起来，还有一个小的鼻倒刺。两个无脊椎的背鳍大小相似，位于身体的后方。肛门鳍位于尾鳍的正前方。尾前尾拉长且较粗。胸鳍和骨盆鳍圆形且呈桨状。斑点长尾须鲨可以利用肌肉和骨骼变化抬起身体，并将这些鳍移动到大约90度，从而利用鳍作为“脚”并进行行走。身体呈米黄色或棕褐色，并有许多间隔较宽的小黑点。在胸鳍上方有两个大的黑点，周围有白色的边缘。这些看起来像是军服上的装饰肩章，因此得名。
通常栖息于深达40米的浅水珊瑚礁栖息地中。它们能够沿着海床“行走”，通过弯曲身体同时摆动其骨盆和胸鳍来实现爬行运动，主食各种甲壳类动物、小鱼和多毛类蠕虫。分布于西太平洋的新几内亚和澳大利亚北部附近水域。在澳大利亚东海岸附近，最南端是新南威尔士州的悉尼也有分布。也可能分布于马来西亚、苏门答腊（印度尼西亚）和所罗门群岛附近，但是不确定。
斑点长尾须鲨最初由Bonnaterre于1788年描述并命名为Squalus ocellatus。后来该名称更改为有效学名Hemiscyllium ocellatum（Bonnaterre 1788）。属名Hemiscyllium源自希腊语“hemi”（意为“一半”）和“skylla”（被翻译为鲨鱼）。 [4]
斑点长尾须鲨最大总长度为107厘米。体小而纤细，鼻子短。它有一条口鼻沟，将嘴巴和鼻孔连接起来，还有一个小的鼻倒刺。每个下颚的牙齿都很相似，而且很小，基部很宽，只有一个尖，后向排列。两个无脊椎的背鳍大小相似，位于身体的后方。肛门鳍位于尾鳍的正前方。尾前尾拉长且较粗。胸鳍和骨盆鳍圆形且呈桨状。斑点长尾须鲨可以利用肌肉和骨骼变化抬起身体，并将这些鳍移动到大约90度，从而利用鳍作为“脚”并进行行走。 [4]

四带笛鲷（学名：Lutjanus kasmira (Forsskål, 1775)）是笛鲷科、笛鲷属的暖水性海洋鱼类。成体全长可达300毫米，体被中大栉鳞，吻部钝尖，上颌前端具2小犬牙，下颌具尖牙。体色呈亮黄色，体侧具4条蓝色纵带，幼鱼时在第2、3纵带间有一黑斑特征且各鳍均为黄色 [1-2] [6]。
四带笛鲷栖息于珊瑚礁海域浅水区，以无脊椎动物及鱼类为食 [3] [6]。分布于中国南海诸岛、东海南部、台湾海峡南部，以及印度洋北部至澳大利亚、日本等海域 [3] [5]。研究表明其平均体长、体重及种群特征随时间推移呈下降趋势，种群稳定性易受捕捞活动和海表温度变化影响 [4] [7]。孟加拉笛鲷与四带笛鲷的线粒体基因组分析显示两者亲缘关系最近 [9-10]，印度洋西部群体间遗传连通性为生物多样性保护提供依据 [8]。
鱼体亮黄色，体侧有4条蓝色纵带，幼鱼时在第2、3纵带间有一黑斑。栖息于珊瑚礁周边100m处。性格凶猛，以无脊椎动物、鱼类为食。 [1]
全长达300毫米。体被中大栉鳞。吻钝尖。上颌前端具2小犬牙，下颌具1行尖牙。犁骨和腭骨具绒毛齿。前鳃盖骨后缘具1深凹刻，与间鳃盖骨结节相嵌合。体侧具4条蓝色纵带。幼鱼在背鳍鳍条下方具1黑斑，随生长消失。

钻嘴鱼（学名：Chelmon rostratus）是蝴蝶鱼科、钻嘴鱼属动物。体长20厘米。有一个细长的嘴用以捕食岩石缝及洞里的食物。白色的身体带有橘黄色垂直条纹，条纹戴黑边。在背鳍上有一眼点用以迷惑敌人。跟其他蝶鱼有很大区别，很好辨别。寿命10年。 [1] [5]
钻嘴鱼为一类珊瑚礁区热带海水鱼，活动深度为水下1-25米。分布于西太平洋中部的澳大利亚东部，为该地区的常见鱼类，活动于珊瑚礁丰茂的地区，觅食各类动物的碎屑，也会用尖嘴凿食礁石及石缝中的无脊椎生物。可作为观赏鱼。该物种形体有点弱，其特殊的吻部吃食困难，神经质的性格容易受到惊吓，很难在水族箱中繁殖成功。 [1] [5]
钻嘴鱼体长20厘米。体高而呈卵圆形；头部上方轮廓凹陷。吻突出而呈一管状嘴，口开于管之先端。上下颌短钳状。体被大型鳞片；侧线向上陡升至背鳍第8-9棘下方而下降至尾鳍基部。背鳍单一，硬棘9，软条30，软条部长于硬棘部；臀鳍硬棘3，软条19。体珍珠白色，后部较黄；体侧具5条垂直色带，前4条为镶黑边之橙黄色带，最后1条为镶白边之黑色；头背处自颈背至吻端另具一镶黑边之橙黄纹。背鳍与臀鳍后部橙黄色，中央为灰色，末缘具蓝灰色线纹；背鳍软条部具眼斑；胸鳍为灰黑色，前缘与后缘黄色；尾鳍基部橙红色，后部淡色。 [4-5]钻嘴鱼图册
栖息于礁区、岩岸、近海沿岸、珊瑚礁丰茂的地区、河口域或淤沙的水域。栖息深度为水下1-30米。 [1] [4]

拟唇鱼（学名：Pseudocheilinus hexataenia），又称六带拟唇鱼，是隆头鱼科拟唇鱼属的一种硬骨鱼类。体长椭圆形，侧扁，口小前位，上下颌具1行锥状齿，上颌前端有1对向外后方弯曲的犬齿，下颌前端具2枚犬齿。前鳃盖骨光滑，体被大圆鳞，颊部具2行鳞，侧线中断，侧线鳞14～18+4～8。体侧具5条纵带，颐部有2黑点，尾柄上部具1黑斑 [2-4]。背鳍具9枚硬棘及11-13枚软条，臀鳍具3枚硬棘及9-11枚软条，尾鳍呈圆形。
该物种分布于红海、印度洋非洲东岸至太平洋中部，北至日本琉球群岛，国内见于南海诸岛及台湾海域。隆头鱼科包含57属约500种，拟唇鱼属为该科下的一属，其下包括六带拟唇鱼、姬拟唇鱼及眼斑拟唇鱼等物种。多栖息于珊瑚礁区域，以软体动物为食 [4]。
原始文献：Acta. Soc. Sci. Ind. Neerl., 2:4
国外分布：红海, 印度非洲东岸至太平洋中部, 北至日本琉球群岛

黄身海猪鱼（学名：Halichoeres chrysus）是隆头鱼科海猪鱼属的一种鱼类，又称黄尾海猪鱼。该物种隶属于动物界脊索动物门硬骨鱼纲鲈形目，由J. E. Randall于1981年依据所罗门群岛的标本命名，同物异名为Thalassoma lutescens Burgess et Axelrod, 1974 [1]。成体体长可达52.88毫米，体重约1.92克，尾柄肌肉标本采用酒精固定浸渍并存放于4℃环境 [2]。
黄身海猪鱼分布于台湾海域，其活动具有昼夜节律性，在暗周期（主观夜间）会藏匿于基质中休憩，光周期实验显示其初始驯化周期为12小时光照与12小时黑暗交替，自由运行周期为24.42小时 [3]。标本ASIZP0914959于2007年7月30日采自台湾渔人码头水族馆（北纬25.05度，东经121.55度），由张荣樺采集并鉴定 [2]。

细纹凤鳚（学名：Salarias fasciatus），又称花豹、西瓜刨、草猛、食苔巴士、食苔古B，属鲈形目鳚科凤鳚属的底栖海水鱼类。体延长侧扁，体色呈黄褐或黄绿色，体侧具8对延伸至背鳍的横带，各鳍分布斑点。该物种分布于印度西太平洋海域，北至琉球群岛，南达澳大利亚大堡礁，栖息于暖水岩礁区的石缝或砂底，以藻类、有机物及小型猎物为食。因啃食藻类习性被作为观赏鱼引入水族箱，饲养时需控制水中氨含量低于0.5ppm、铜离子不超过0.2ppm。其游泳速度快且抢食能力强，但对绿丝藻清洁效果有限 [2]。海南三亚蜈支洲岛海域海洋牧场通过人工鱼礁投放和珊瑚移植恢复生态，细纹凤鳚作为珊瑚礁区典型物种 [3-4]。
细纹凤鳚（学名：Salarias fasciatus）为鳚科凤鳚属的鱼类，俗名细纹动齿鳚。分布于非洲东岸至土阿莫土群岛、南至澳大利亚大堡礁、北至日本琉球群岛等海域、台湾岛以及西沙群岛、海南岛等，属于暖水性鱼类。其常见于岩礁岸边。该物种的模式产地在东南亚。
非洲东岸至土阿莫土群岛, 南至澳大利亚大堡礁, 北至日本琉球群岛等海域
背鳍Ⅻ-18—20;臀鳍Ⅱ-19—21;胸鳍14;腹鳍Ⅰ-2;尾鳍7+9+5。体延长，侧扁。头短，头长小于体高。吻短，圆钝。口端位。上下唇边缘无锯齿。上下颌牙各1行，尖细，能活动;无犬牙。前鼻孔有1掌状鼻须。眶上须分支，短于眼径。颈须宽扁，有柄，呈掌状。鳃孔宽。鳃盖膜与峡部分离。侧线仅见于胸鳍上方。背鳍起于鳃孔前上缘，棘部长于鳍条部，中间有浅凹，末端连于尾鳍上。臀鳍与背鳍鳍条部相对，边缘锯状，末端连于尾柄。胸鳍扇形，侧下位。腹鳍喉位，棘短，埋于皮下。尾鳍圆，中央9鳍条分支。体黄褐或黄绿色，体侧有8对横带，并上延至背鳍边缘，每对间有的交叉。体前部有多行上斜黑点和线纹，各鳍有斑点。

双色异齿鳚（学名：Ecsenius bicolor），又称双色虾虎，为辐鳍鱼纲鲈形目鳚科、异齿鳚属的一种底栖海水鱼类。前半身呈紫色或灰色，后半身呈黄色或橘色，背鳍与鱼体等长，雄鱼产卵期体色变为红色并具白色斑纹 [1]。
该物种分布于印度太平洋区，包括菲律宾、印度尼西亚、日本等海域，栖息于水深1至25米的珊瑚礁潟湖中，常隐匿于礁石缝隙仅显露上半身。其以有机物碎屑及海藻为食，属杂食性。双色异齿鳚易接受人工饲料，可作为观赏鱼单养 [1]。
本鱼分布于印度太平洋区，包括马尔代夫、斯里兰卡、缅甸、日本、台湾、泰国、越南、菲律宾、印尼、澳洲、圣诞岛、可可群岛、斐济、马绍尔群岛、基里巴斯、马里亚纳群岛、密克罗尼西亚、东加、瓦努阿图、帕劳等海域。该物种的模式产地在Saddle群岛、Burma。
本鱼通常只能看见前半身，因为金黄色的后半身常藏于岩石或底沙中。额部有须状触须，独特的背鳍和鱼体一样长，产卵期时雄鱼体色变成红色，有白色斑纹，产卵后又变成深蓝色，有浅色斑块。背鳍硬棘11至12枚；背鳍软条15至18枚；臀鳍硬棘2枚；臀鳍软条17至21枚，体长可达11厘米。双色异齿鳚图册
魔鬼蓑鲉（学名：Pterois volitans）是动物界脊索动物门辐鳍鱼纲鲉形目鲉科蓑鲉属的动物。 [1]

泥楼牙花鮨（学名：Odontanthias borbonius）是硬骨鱼纲鲈形目鮨科牙花鮨属的一种鱼类，中文别名黄斑金花鲈，曾被归为Holanthias属的异名种 [1]。原始名称为 Serranus borbonius Valenciennes, 1828，接受名为 Odontanthias borbonius [4]。幼鱼体长20.0-23.4毫米，身体呈淡粉色，带有大型黄色斑点 [7]。
该物种分布于印度太平洋区，包括中国台湾南方澳、印尼、日本（如Suruga Bay、Okinawa）、帕劳等海域 [1-2] [7-8]。其栖息于水深152米以下的深礁环境，偏好陡峭斜坡、垂直岩壁及火山岩堆积的复杂地形。根据观测记录，该深度区域鱼类丰度较低 [2-3]。
幼鱼与成鱼体色相似，呈淡粉色，并带有大型黄色斑点；固定后黄色斑点会消失，但原位置散布的黑色素囊可作为其区别于同属其他物种（均无此类斑点）的特征；幼鱼具有大而光滑的鳃盖间棘，眼上脊具锯齿，颞后棘具锯齿 [7]。
泥楼牙花鮨栖息于水深152米以下的深礁环境，偏好陡峭斜坡、垂直岩壁及火山岩堆积的复杂地形，该深度区域鱼类丰度较低 [2-3]。在波纳佩（密克罗尼西亚）的研究中，Odontanthias borbonius被列为可能指示中太平洋中层光照带（mesophotic）栖息地的四种鱼类之一 [8]。

黑尾海猪鱼（Halichoeres melanurus）又称黄斑海猪鱼，橙线龙，花猪龙，为鲈形目，隆头鱼科，海猪鱼属一种热带地区近岸珊瑚礁海域生活的鱼类。黑尾海猪鱼分布于西太平洋日本海南部至大堡礁海域，外形奇特，色彩丰富，可作为观赏鱼。
主要栖息于温暖浅水珊瑚礁区及岩岸海域，深 [1]度约0-15公尺的海域。主要以底栖性甲壳类、软体动物、多毛类、有孔类、小鱼及鱼卵等为食。具性转变的行为，是属于先雌后雄型的型态。
分布于印度-西太平洋区，由日本至澳洲海域，东至萨摩亚及东加等。台湾南部、西南部、北部、东北部及小琉球之岩礁海域皆有分布。
小型之隆头鱼，体色多彩多姿，纹路变化多端，是较适合水族观赏的鱼类。其有斑驳的保护色，亦常会钻入砂中，所以潜水在美丽而隐密的珊瑚礁海域，并不易看见。可食用，但个体小，较无食用价值。

腋斑普提鱼（学名：Bodianus axillaris）是隆头鱼科普提鱼属的一种辐鳍鱼类，又称腋斑狐鲷、白尾龙。体长可达20厘米，体侧扁，头尖，成鱼体色分界明显：前半部暗褐色至棕色，后半部淡茶色至白色，胸鳍基底、背鳍及臀鳍软条部各具黑斑；幼鱼通体黑色，体侧具9条对称白色斑纹。背鳍具12枚硬棘和9-10枚软条，臀鳍具3枚硬棘和12-13枚软条 [1]。
成鱼常单独栖息于亚潮带水深2-100米的岩礁区，幼鱼多在岩洞或礁石下活动，偶以“鱼医生”角色清除其他鱼体表异物，主食底栖无脊椎动物 [2]。分布于印度-太平洋海域，包括红海、东非、日本、中国台湾地区及太平洋诸岛 [3]。该科具性别转换特性：雌性成熟后可转变为色彩鲜艳的雄性，雄鱼具领地性，多成对繁殖，幼鱼与成鱼体色差异显著 [4]。世界自然保护联盟（IUCN）将其列为无危（LC）物种。
腋斑普提鱼最大体长可达20厘米（标准体长） [6]。体长型，侧扁；头尖；眼眶间隔稍凸。眼眶前与前鳃盖被鳞。齿圆锥状，上下颌前侧具2对犬齿。成鱼身体前半部为暗褐色到棕色，后半部为淡茶色到白色，以背鳍硬棘部末端往腹鳍方向为颜色的分界 [1]。雄鱼在背鳍和臀鳍的软条部各有一显著黑斑 [6-7]。胸鳍基底亦具一黑斑。背鳍具12枚硬棘和9至10枚软条，臀鳍具3枚硬棘和12至13枚软条 [1]。
幼鱼通体黑色，体侧具9条对称白色斑纹 [1]。随着成长，其体色会经历戏剧性的变化 [4] [6] [10]。其幼鱼与黑身普提鱼（Bodianus mesothorax）的幼鱼相似，但本种幼鱼具有白色斑点，而非黄色斑点 [6-7]。
绿丝隆头鱼（学名：Cirrhilabrus solorensis）为隆头鱼科丝隆头鱼属的鱼类。分布于印度尼西亚、菲律宾、日本琉球群岛以及南海诸岛等。

斑胡椒鲷（学名：Plectorhinchus chaetodonoides），别名燕子花旦、花旦新娘、朱古力，属硬骨鱼纲辐鳍亚纲鲈形目石鲈科胡椒鲷属鱼类。幼鱼体呈咖啡色并具乳白色圆斑，成鱼转为青白色密布胡椒状黑斑，最大体长可达72厘米。分布于印度-太平洋海域，包括马尔代夫、印度尼西亚、菲律宾及中国台湾周边珊瑚礁区 [1]。
该鱼幼体因独特斑纹被广泛作为观赏鱼饲养，需维持水温24-27℃。饲养初期需用活虾肉或蛤肉诱导摄食，饵料添加综合维生素可提升幼体存活率。成鱼栖息于岩礁区捕食甲壳类及软体动物，肉质鲜美被视为高级食用鱼，因体型较大较少见于家庭水族箱。其幼体主要来自印尼，在观赏鱼市场普及率较高 [1]。2009年广州海洋馆"海底名花展"及2017年上海海洋水族馆"海洋怪鱼生物特展"均将其作为展示物种 [2-3]。
英 文 名 ：Harlequin sweetlips
体形特征 长达72(厘米)。此鱼幼鱼胸翅特大，摇摆起来比大鱼好看得多，长至中等大小时斑纹开始转变，幼鱼褐色的鱼体，白色的斑点，成鱼时，灰白色鱼体上带黑色斑点。斑胡椒鲷图册

红牙鳞鲀（学名：Odonus niger），俗名魔鬼炮弹、红牙板机鲀，为鲀形目鳞鲀科的其中一种。
红牙鳞鲀（Odonus niger）又称魔鬼炮弹，尼日尔炮弹，红牙炮弹，属鲀形目、鳞鲀科、牙鳞鲀属，为一类生活在近海区域的泛珊瑚礁区海水鱼。红牙鳞鲀分布于印太海域印度尼西亚及马尔代夫海域，喜成群在近海巡游，掠食小型猎物或海底的甲壳类，偶尔活动于礁石区。可作为观赏鱼。
红海, 印度洋非洲东海岸到太平洋中部社会群岛. 南至澳大利亚, 北至日本南部
本鱼分布于印度太平洋区，包括红海、东非、南非、塞舌尔群岛、马尔代夫、留尼汪、印度、日本、台湾、中国、斯里兰卡、泰国、越南、关岛、印尼、马来西亚、新几内亚、澳洲、密克罗尼西亚、圣诞岛、新喀里多尼亚、帕劳、菲律宾、基里巴斯、东加、法属波里尼西亚等海域等。 [2]

角鳞鲀（学名：Melichthys niger）是鲀形目鳞鲀科角鳞鲀属的海洋鱼类。其体呈蓝黑色椭圆形，侧扁且覆菱形小鳞，体长可达136毫米以上。头部眼间隔圆凸，吻部前突，上下颌各具4齿；尾鳍呈新月形，外缘具浅蓝色条纹，第二背鳍与臀鳍基部均有浅色纵纹，胸鳍短圆呈黑色 [1-2]。角鳞鲀属（Melichthys）是扳机鱼科的一个小属，目前包含3个公认物种 [6]。
该物种广泛分布于大西洋、印度洋及太平洋的热带至亚热带海域，中国南海为其主要分布区之一。栖息于珊瑚礁区及近海底层浅水区域，亦喜欢成群在波涛汹涌的大洋岛屿周围聚集，游动能力强，常在开阔的水中层活动 [3-4]。其因尾鳍粉红色得名“粉红尾炮弹”，背鳍形似枪械扳机而俗称“扳机鱼”，亦称“黑炮弹” [5]，鱼皮坚硬需剥皮食用，兼具食用与观赏价值。角鳞鲀属鱼类攻击性通常较低 [4]，但在繁殖期或保护幼仔时领地意识强，曾有在马尔代夫等地攻击浮潜游客并造成较深伤口的记录。
测量标本1尾，体长136.2mm，采自台湾（美国USNM标本）。
背鳍Ⅲ，2＋31；臀鳍2+28；胸鳍16；尾鳍1＋10十1。体侧鳞片55横行。

月蝶鱼（学名：Genicanthus lamarck），又称蓝宝王、拉马克神仙，是刺盖鱼科、月蝶鱼属的小型珊瑚礁鱼类，属硬骨鱼纲辐鳍亚纲鲈形目。体呈卵圆形，雌鱼体长可达13厘米，尾鳍上下缘具黑带；雄鱼体长可达18厘米，尾鳍丝状延长显著且无黑纹，体白色带黑色横条纹，胸部具黑色斑点，背鳍具金色斑点 [3-4]。
该物种分布于西太平洋海域，主要分布于印度尼西亚至琉球群岛海域，栖息于外礁坪水深20-45米处。成鱼多以浮游动物、有机物碎屑及海藻为食，幼体可投喂含螺旋藻的薄片饲料 [3-4]。饲养需足够水体，保持硝酸盐浓度低以避免尾鳍损伤，因其独特体色与优雅泳姿被广泛作为观赏鱼饲养 [3]。
月蝶鱼图片分布于印度-西太平洋区，由东非洲至所罗门群岛，北至日本琉球群岛，南至澳洲。台湾产于绿岛海域。 [1]
体卵圆形。吻圆钝。眼间隔稍凹。口小；两颌齿呈尖形。前眼眶骨具2强锯齿，后缘游离，且具深刻；前鳃盖后缘具锯齿；前鼻孔圆形，小于卵形之后鼻孔。体被中大圆鳞，头部与奇鳍较小；侧线完全，但止于尾柄。背鳍硬棘XV，软条15-16；臀鳍硬棘III，软条17-18；背鳍与臀鳍软条部后端尖形；腹鳍尖形，第一软条延长；尾鳍深凹形，上下缘延长如丝状。体乳白色，体背褐色，体侧具3-5条黑纵带。背鳍除软条部后下方外全为黑色；除腹鳍外，余鳍乳白色且具黑色小点；雄鱼腹鳍黑色，尾鳍上下叶无黑色带；雌鱼及幼鱼腹鳍灰色，尾鳍上下叶具黑色带。

波纹钩鳞鲀（学名：Balistapus undulatus）是鳞鲀科、钩鳞鲀属的珊瑚礁区底层鱼类，别称黄纹炮弹。体被骨板状鳞，第一背鳍第三鳍棘明显，体表呈绿色或褐色，布满金黄色斜纹，尾柄具6枚倒棘及暗色斑，体长可达750px，水族箱中通常保持在625px以下 [2]。
该鱼分布于印度洋至太平洋热带海域，包括西沙群岛、南沙群岛、海南岛等地，模式产地为苏门答腊，栖息于珊瑚礁外缘水深0-50米处。杂食性，主要摄食珊瑚、藻类、甲壳类等生物。幼鱼需冻鲜饵料喂养，成鱼因口裂小不易吞食小型鱼类，适合混养。性情孤僻且攻击游泳缓慢的鱼类，常单独饲养，具有观赏价值 [2]。
印度洋及太平洋的热带海内, 西南可达非洲莫三鼻给南端的德拉果阿湾, 西达红海, 西北达印度各海, 往东经马来半岛, 印度尼西亚, 菲律宾, 到密
东海鱼类志:1034-1035. 南海诸岛海域鱼类志:544-545.

凯瑟琳丝隆头鱼（学名：Cirrhilabrus katherinae）是隆头鱼科、丝隆头鱼属的鱼类 [1-2]。雄鱼体色多变，腹鳍细长，背鳍和臀鳍带有蓝色纹路；幼鱼及雌性个体体色主要为上红下白 [2]。
该鱼分布于西太平洋，包括日本伊豆群岛、关岛和马里亚纳群岛。栖息于水深10至40米的外礁区域，较少出现在潟湖或港湾。群居生活，繁殖期会成对出现 [2]。
凯瑟琳丝隆头鱼，又称凯瑟琳丝鳍鹦鲷，为辐鳍鱼纲鲈形目隆头鱼亚目隆头鱼科的其中一种，分布于西太平洋区，包括伊豆群岛、关岛、马里亚纳群岛等海域，栖息深度10-40米，体长可达7.1厘米，栖息在潟湖、珊瑚礁，生活习性不明。
幼鱼开始呈橙红色，而后变成上红下白；雌鱼在亚成期及成体阶段均呈上红下白；雄鱼体色则较为多变，腹鳍细长，背鳍和臀鳍带有蓝色纹路，部分体色可能为过渡期表现。 [2]

鸳鸯炮弹黑白交叉的鱼体，前吻有一黄带，是浅海炮弹鱼，食鱼、虾，饲养容易。饲养在水族箱里会口含碎珊瑚可掘坑取乐。会发出“咕咕“的声音。食物包括鱿鱼、虾、贝类、小鱼及硬壳虾。
叉斑锉鳞鲀（Rhinecanthus aculeatus）又称鸳鸯炮弹，毕加索炮弹，为鲀形目、鳞鲀科、锉鳞鲀属一种珊瑚礁区域生存的热带海水鱼类。叉斑锉鳞鲀产于印太海域南海，菲律宾至米可罗尼西亚岛，多活动于珊瑚礁周边地区，掠食小型猎物，亦啃食礁石上的微小有机物。可作为观赏鱼。
体形/颜色：体长20~25厘米，体呈椭圆形，头大，嘴尖，眼睛位于背鳍的前方并紧靠背部边缘，与其它品种不同。体色蓝绿，体中央有一块大的黑褐色斑块，格外明显，在它的周围有数条彩色条纹向背部和腹部延伸，嘴部有黄色条纹环绕，眼部有一蓝色条纹。
鳃盖后身体中央有一块大的暗黑色圆斑，第一背鳍可自由伏卧，第二背鳍基部有二条暗黑色环带到达身体中央黑斑，臀鳍基部有7-8条黑白相间的环带到达身体中央黑斑。鸳鸯炮弹图册

刺盖鱼属（学名：Pomacanthus）是鲈形目刺盖鱼科的海洋鱼类，分布于印度-西太平洋及大西洋的热带珊瑚礁海域，范围涵盖非洲东岸至太平洋诸岛，部分物种见于红海、波斯湾和大西洋沿岸 [1] [3]。其幼鱼与成鱼体色差异显著：幼体多为蓝白条纹或环形斑，成鱼则随生长逐渐形成复杂纹路或色带，体长最大可达50厘米。代表物种包括皇后神仙（P. imperator）、法国神仙（P. paru）等，其中紫月神仙体侧具独特黄色月斑 [3]。
该属物种栖息于水深1-100米的珊瑚礁洞或岩架，幼鱼独居浅水区，成鱼常成对活动。食性以海绵、海藻、小型甲壳类为主，部分幼鱼具有清洁大型鱼类寄生虫的行为。繁殖时直接将卵散播于水域中。因体色艳丽，蓝环神仙、皇后神仙等种类被作为观赏鱼，具有一定经济价值 [2-3]。尽管目前未列入濒危名录，其生存仍受珊瑚礁生态系统退化的潜在威胁 [1]。
刺盖鱼属（学名：Pomacanthus）在生物分类学上属于鲈形目刺盖鱼科 [1] [3]。刺盖鱼是刺盖鱼科7个属所有鱼类的统称。其名称“刺盖”源于前鳃盖骨有一枚向后的尖锐硬棘 [4]。
该属包含多个物种，例如环纹刺盖鱼（Pomacanthus annularis）、主刺盖鱼（Pomacanthus imperator）、半环刺盖鱼（Pomacanthus semicirculatus）、阿拉伯刺盖鱼（Pomacanthus asfur）、马鞍刺盖鱼（Pomacanthus navarchus）等 [5]。

彩带刺尾鱼（学名：Acanthurus lineatus）平均体长25厘米，最长可达38厘米。彩带刺尾鱼身体侧面轮廓高而扁平，体形椭圆型，尾部两侧竖立着一对尖刺，背鳍和臀鳍与身体交接处极长，眼睛长在头部上方，鱼鳞末端有个小突起，显得皮肤外表粗躁的感觉。牙不能活动。尾柄两侧各具1个向前棘。体淡黄色，自眼向外放射出多条蓝灰色带纹。尾鳍后半部的横带与体色带纹同色。
彩带刺尾鱼分布于热带印度洋非洲东岸至太平洋中部、西部的夏威夷群岛和波利尼西亚，包括日本南部、台湾海域等。
栖息于珊瑚礁或岩礁之浪拂区，栖息深度在0~15米左右。该种鱼通常会不停的移动。草食性，喜食礁壁上的藻类食物，但也捕食甲壳类。具有强烈的领域性，由1尾较大雄鱼控制界限分明的摄食领地及一群雌鱼。尾柄上的直立前向棘具有毒腺，能使人产生剧痛。
彩带刺尾鱼体呈椭圆形而侧扁。头背部轮廓不特别凸出。口小，端位，上下颌各具一列扁平齿，齿固定不可动，齿缘具缺刻。背鳍及臀鳍硬棘尖锐，分别具11棘及3棘，各鳍条皆不延长；尾鳍弯月形，随著成长，上下叶逐渐延长。尾柄棘尖锐而极长。

白胸刺尾鱼（学名：Acanthurus leucosternon），形体椭圆，尾鳍叉形。全身粉蓝色或浅蓝色，背鳍鲜黄色或浅蓝色，臀鳍浅蓝色，体侧有数条暗灰色垂直环带，头部三角形，眼睛靠近头顶，尾柄两侧各有一个浅白色或浅黄色刺尾钩，鱼体体色时深时浅。白胸刺尾鱼主要分布在印度洋和太平洋，从东非至安达曼海、印尼东南部及圣诞岛等。为极具商业价值的观赏类和养殖用鱼。
白胸刺尾鱼（Acanthurus leucosternon）又称粉蓝吊或粉蓝倒吊，为鲈形目刺尾鱼科、刺尾鱼属，为一类近海活动的热带海水鱼类。白胸刺尾鱼野外产于印度洋马尔代夫、印度尼西亚、菲律宾等海域，虽然生活在礁石区附近，但它们并不算严格意义上的珊瑚礁鱼类，活动区域更加广阔。白胸刺尾鱼外观美丽，可作为观赏鱼。
白胸刺尾鱼分布区域主要分布于印度洋和太平洋中西部海域。 [1]
主要分布国家和地区：孟加拉、英属印度洋领地、圣诞岛、科科斯群岛、科摩罗、莫桑比克海峡、印度、印尼、伊朗、肯尼亚、马达加斯加、马尔代夫、毛里求斯、马约特岛、莫桑比克、缅甸、阿曼、留尼汪、塞舌尔、索马里、南非、斯里兰卡、坦桑尼亚、泰国、也门。 [1]

二色刺尻鱼（学名：Centropyge bicolor）是盖刺鱼科刺尻鱼属的硬骨鱼类，属辐鳍亚纲鲈形目。体呈椭圆形，最大全长15厘米，头部及体前部呈亮黄色，体后部为深蓝色，尾鳍黄色，头部两眼间具蓝色鞍状斑带延伸至两侧 [3] [5]。
该鱼分布于西太平洋至印度洋热带海域，包括中国南海、台湾沿海及澳大利亚、帕劳等地 [2-3]。栖息于珊瑚礁区，常见于向海礁坡或潟湖环境中。杂食性，以海藻、海绵、甲壳类为食 [1-2] [5]，常独居、成对或小群活动 [5]。作为观赏鱼类时需400升以上水体饲养，水温宜保持在24-27℃，不宜与珊瑚共存且需避免同种混养 [1-2]。可投喂螺旋藻、糠虾及专用饵料 [2] [4]，别称包括石美人、双色神仙鱼 [3-4]。
分布于印度洋、太平洋热带海域：中国的南海和台湾南部海域也有分布，栖息在珊瑚礁区，以海藻、海绵、海鞘及甲壳动物等为食。喜成对或集小群活动。体椭圆形，头部两眼间由一蓝黑色斑带相连二鱼体前半部鲜黄色，后半部蓝色，尾部黄色：成鱼最大体长15厘米。
二色刺尻鱼是价格较高的观赏品种，同种间会争斗不宜同养。饲养空间大些为好，最好400升以上，水温24～27℃，投喂各种海产肉类和藻类，也可喂人工专用饵料 [1]。

索氏尖鼻鲀（学名：Canthigaster solandri），又名细斑扁背鲀、眼斑扁背鲀、尖嘴规、规仔、花婆、蓝点鲀，属鲀形目四齿鲀科扁背鲀属，为珊瑚礁区活动的热带海水鱼。其体卵圆形侧扁，最大体长11.5厘米，体表红褐色密布镶黑边的蓝白色斑点，尾鳍具红棕色或浅蓝色斑点。头部具放射状蓝色纹，背鳍基下方有不明显黑斑 [1]。
该物种分布于印度至太平洋海域，西起非洲东岸，东至莱恩群岛，北至日本南部，南至新喀里多尼亚。栖息于潮间带礁台、潟湖等浅水区，以藻类、碎屑及小型无脊椎动物为食。内脏含弱毒，无食用价值，因体色艳丽被作为观赏鱼 [1]，饲养难度较低，适合新手入门 [2]。
命名者：(Richardson, 1844)索氏尖鼻鲀
地理分布：西起非洲东岸，东至土木土及莱恩群岛，北至日本南部，南至新加勒多尼亚及东加。

黑斑叉鼻鲀（学名：Arothron nigropunctatus）是辐鳍鱼纲鲀形目四齿鲀科叉鼻鲀属鱼类，俗称狗头鱼、黑点狗头。体表布满小棘，具叉状鼻突，鳃孔与吻部呈黑色，腹部散布黑色斑点，肛门处具明显黑斑，尾鳍深色且边缘白色，幼鱼体色随成长变化显著 [2] [4] [8]。
该物种分布于印度洋至太平洋海域，西起红海、非洲东岸，东至社会群岛，北达日本南部，南抵澳大利亚，常见于珊瑚礁区 [2] [6-7]。独居生活，以珊瑚枝芽、藻类、小型无脊椎动物及礁石碎屑为食 [2] [4] [6]。遇险时可吸入水或空气使身体膨胀自卫 [5] [8]。其肝脏、卵巢含剧毒，筋肉与皮肤亦具毒性 [2] [6]。因面部形似狗头，多作为观赏鱼饲养，但皮肤无鳞对药物敏感，需严格控制水质及盐度 [3-4] [7]。
在太平洋及印度洋内, 西达红海, 西南达非洲东岸的桑给巴尔和莫三鼻给的德拉果阿海湾, 向东经印度沿海, 马来半岛, 印度尼西亚及菲律宾, 直到
南海鱼类志:1094-1095. 南海诸岛海域鱼类志:559-560.

黄头后颌鰧（学名：Opistognathus aurifrons）是脊索动物门鱼类，体延长稍侧扁，最大体长可达12厘米。头部宽大呈淡黄色，体色由浅灰渐变至浅蓝色，分布淡蓝色斑点，背鳍前部及颈背为淡黄色，各鳍浅蓝色，下颌偶有黑点 [1-3]。
该物种分布于中、西大西洋珊瑚礁区，包括佛罗里达南端、巴哈马至南美洲北端海域。栖息于底沙或珊瑚碎屑环境，具领地意识，常垂直盘旋于洞穴附近捕食漂浮生物，能通过嘴部搬运沙粒、贝壳构筑巢穴 [1-3]。雄鱼以口孵方式保护卵群，属商业性观赏鱼种 [1] [3]。
黄头后颌鰧由乔丹与汤普森于1905年命名。黄头后颌鰧（学名：Opistognathus aurifrons）在分类上属于脊索动物门Chordata，辐鳍鱼纲Teleostei，鲈形目Ovalentaria/misc，后颌䲢科 Opistognathidae，后颌䲢属 Opistognathus [6] [8]。
该物种还有金头鰕虎、大帆鸳鸯、小白兔鰕虎、美国大帆鸳鸯等其他中文名 [1] [8]。其英文俗名为Yellowhead jawfish [1] [6]。
卡式副唇鱼，学名是Paracheilinus carpenteri (J. E. Randall et Lubbock, 1981)，是隆头鱼科副唇鱼属的一种鱼类。雄鱼最大体长8.0厘米，体色通常为橙色，雌鱼为淡红色。分布于西太平洋海域，包括菲律宾、台湾等地，栖息于热带海洋礁区水深27-45米处，形成鱼群，繁殖期配对产卵。该物种的模式产地在菲律宾。 [2]

黑刺尻鱼（学名：Centropyge nox (Bleeker, 1853)）是辐鳍鱼纲、鲈形目、鲈亚目、盖刺鱼科刺尻鱼属的硬骨鱼纲辐鳍亚纲鱼类，又称黑神仙、黑新娘、黑幽灵神仙（台湾）。鱼体侧扁呈椭圆形，体色深褐至黑色，尾鳍具白色边缘；背鳍具14-15枚硬棘及16-17枚软条，臀鳍具3枚硬棘及16-17枚软条，最大体长可达10厘米 [1]。
黑刺尻鱼分布于西太平洋日本、中国台湾、菲律宾至所罗门群岛等海域，栖息于珊瑚礁或潟湖碎石区，常成小群活动并以藻类为食。作为观赏鱼类，因其独特外观被开发利用。
黑刺尻鱼的鱼体侧扁，呈椭圆形，体深褐色或黑色；尾鳍有狭窄的白色边缘。背鳍硬棘14-15枚；背鳍软条16-17枚；臀鳍硬棘3枚；臀鳍软条16-17枚，体长可达10厘米 [2]。
分布于西太平洋区，包括日本、中国台湾、菲律宾、澳洲、新几内亚、斐济、密克罗尼西亚、新喀里多尼亚、帕劳、东加、所罗门群岛等海域。

黄刺尻鱼（学名：Centropyge heraldi）是盖刺鱼科、刺尻鱼属的珊瑚礁鱼类，体长可达94毫米，通体呈金黄色，头部具波状暗纹。其拉丁学名由Woods和Schultz于1953年命名，别名包括蓝眼黄新娘、海氏刺尻鱼，香港地区俗称“柠檬批”；不同产地个体颜色存在差异，部分呈现褐色、米黄色或带有蓝色花纹 [1]。
该物种分布于西沙群岛、中国台湾南部至琉球群岛及太平洋马绍尔群岛、菲律宾等海域，栖息于珊瑚礁区并以有机物碎屑、海藻为食。作为观赏鱼时能较快适应人工饲料，可与珊瑚混养且不伤害腔肠动物，但需在水族箱中设置隐蔽物以避免应激反应。国内市场上该鱼较为罕见，价格较高 [1]。
黄刺尻鱼，Centropyge flavissima，盖刺鱼科刺尻鱼属。特征：背鳍ⅩⅤ-15;臀鳍Ⅲ-15;胸鳍16;腹鳍Ⅰ-5。侧线鳞42;侧线上鳞8;侧线下鳞23;纵列鳞46。鳃耙5+11。体长为体高2倍；为头长3.6倍。头长为吻长2.1倍；为眼径3.2倍。尾柄高为尾柄长2倍。体长椭圆形，侧扁。头较小。吻稍长，前端钝圆。前鳃盖骨后缘具锯齿，下缘有1刺，后下角具一向后伸强棘。体呈金黄色，头部有波状暗纹和淡色小斑。臀鳍具有5条暗色纵纹。奇鳍淡色。体长94mm。
黄刺尻鱼（Centropyge flavissimus）别名蓝眼黄新娘，隶属鲈形目、刺盖鱼科、刺尻鱼属，原产西太平洋关岛至东南太平洋密克罗尼西亚的广泛海域，是较为习见的珊瑚礁鱼类。黄刺尻鱼活动于珊瑚礁丰茂的地区，觅食各类有机物碎屑及海藻、珊瑚虫等。黄刺尻鱼图册

products.title: Flameback Angelfish 1.5"
products.description: The Flameback Angelfish, also known as the African Pygmy Angelfish or Orangeback Angelfish, has striking contrasts of blue and orange-yellow colors. While the body is predominately blue, there is a broad and bright orange to yellow swatch from the head along the back to the tip of the dorsal fin. The caudal fin is yellow and somewhat transparent, which distinguishes it from the Brazilian Flameback Angelfish (also known as the Fireball Angelfish - Centropyge aurantonotus ). The Flameback Angelfish requires a minimum of a 55 gallon tank with lots of hiding places and live rock for grazing. On occasion, this fish may nip at SPS and some species of polyp corals in the reef aquarium. The diet of the Flameback Angelfish should include Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, mysis or frozen shrimp, and other meaty foods.
products.description_zh: 火背神仙鱼，也被称为非洲侏儒神仙鱼或橙背神仙鱼，具有鲜明的蓝色和橙黄色对比。虽然身体主要是蓝色，但从头部沿背部到背鳍尖端有宽阔而明亮的橙色到黄色色块。尾鳍呈黄色且有些透明，这与巴西火背神仙鱼（也称为火球神仙鱼 - Centropyge aurantonotus）区别开来。火背神仙鱼需要至少 55 加仑的水箱，其中有很多藏身之处和可供放牧的活石。有时，这种鱼可能会咬食珊瑚礁水族箱中的 SPS 和某些水螅珊瑚。的饮食火背神仙鱼应包括螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、糠虾或冷冻虾以及其他肉类食物。

products.title: Tomato Clownfish 2.5"
products.description: The Tomato Clownfish, also known as the Bridled Clownfish or Red Clownfish, is found throughout the Pacific, almost always in association with an anemone such as Bubbletip Sea Anemone ( Entacmaea quadricolor ). The Tomato Clownfish has a wider distribution than the Fire Clown, which is usually restricted to the Indo-Pacific reefs. It has also been known to use coral as a host in the absence of an anemone. The Tomato Clownfish is a bright orange-red with one white vertical stripe behind the eyes. It can attain a length in the wild of 5 inches, but it usually reaches a maximum of 3.5 inches in an aquarium. The very hardy Tomato Clownfish can be housed with most fish that will not eat it and is a good choice for tank-cycling. It should not be housed with any shy or passive feeding fish, as the Tomato Clownfish tends to be somewhat territorial and aggressive with conspecifics and as it gets older. As with all clownfish, most are born as males, and the dominant male will change to a female. An aggressive eater, the Tomato Clownfish will consume most meaty foods and herbivore preparations.
products.description_zh: 番茄小丑鱼，也被称为缰绳小丑鱼或红色小丑鱼，遍布整个太平洋，几乎总是与泡尖海葵（Entacmaea 四色）等海葵有关。番茄小丑鱼的分布范围比火小丑鱼更广泛，后者通常仅限于印度-太平洋珊瑚礁。人们还知道，在没有海葵的情况下，它会使用珊瑚作为宿主。番茄小丑鱼呈明亮的橙红色，眼睛后面有一条白色的垂直条纹。它在野外的长度可以达到 5 英寸，但在水族箱中通常最大可达 3.5 英寸。非常耐寒的番茄小丑鱼可以与大多数不吃它的鱼一起饲养，并且坦克循环的好选择。番茄小丑鱼不应该与任何害羞或被动进食的鱼一起饲养，因为随着年龄的增长，番茄小丑鱼往往对同种鱼有一定的领地意识和攻击性。与所有小丑鱼一样，大多数出生时都是雄性，占主导地位的雄性会变成雌性。番茄小丑鱼的食性极强，会吃掉大部分肉类食物和草食动物制剂。

products.title: Boxfish 2"
products.description: The Boxfish is also referred to as the Spotted Boxfish, Blue Boxfish, Black Boxfish, or Whitespotted Boxfish. The various names are due to the dimorphic appearance of the male and female. The male is the more colorful of the two, with a vibrant blue body and a wide black swath covering the top of the body like a cap. The entire body is speckled with dots, white on black and black on blue while a thin horizontal stripe of orange adorns the tail. The female is entirely black with white dots. This is a very difficult fish to keep in the aquarium setting by any other than the most experienced aquarist. It should have a minimum of a 180 gallon tank. Use caution if placing the Boxfish in a reef tank as they will often nibble at tubeworms. When stressed, the Boxfish releases a poisonous substance, called ostracitoxin, from its mucous glands which will kill other fish in the tank very quickly. Very little success has been achieved in breeding these fish in an aquarium. When first introduced, the Boxfish can be fed a diet of live brine shrimp or bloodworms. After acclimatization, chopped squid, clams, mussels, and herbivore preparations can be fed.
products.description_zh: 箱鱼也称为斑点箱鱼、蓝箱鱼、黑箱鱼或白斑箱鱼。各种名称是由于男性和女性的二态性外观而产生的。雄性是两者中颜色更丰富的，有充满活力的蓝色身体和一条宽阔的黑色带子，覆盖在身体的顶部，就像一顶帽子。整个身体上布满了黑底白字和蓝底黑字的斑点，尾巴上有一条橙色的细水平条纹。雌性全身黑色，带有白色斑点。除了最有经验的鱼友之外，这是一种非常难以在水族箱中饲养的鱼。它应该有至少 180 加仑的水箱。将箱鲀放入珊瑚礁时要小心nk，因为它们经常会啃食管虫。当受到压力时，箱鲀会从粘液腺中释放出一种叫做鸵鸟毒素的有毒物质，这种物质会很快杀死水族箱中的其他鱼。在水族馆中繁殖这些鱼几乎没有取得成功。首次引入时，箱鲀可以喂食活丰年虾或红虫。适应环境后，可以喂切碎的鱿鱼、蛤、贻贝和草食动物制剂。

products.title: Chrysurus Angelfish 3" WYSYWYG
products.description: The Chrysurus Angelfish, also referred to as the Goldtail Angelfish or Ear Spot Angelfish, is an uncommon aquarium member because very few are collected for the aquarium industry. It has a body of mottled-brown with vertical white stripes. There are several bright sapphire-blue stripes on the head, and the tail is a dull yellow rimmed in the same sapphire-blue. As a juvenile, the tail is clear in coloration until they reach 3 to 4 inches, at which time it begins to develop the yellow coloration. The Chrysurus Angelfish requires a 220 gallon or larger aquarium with multiple hiding places and large amounts of live rock for grazing. Not a good reef dweller, the Chrysurus Angelfish is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles, but may be kept with small-polyped stony corals and somewhat noxious soft corals. When stressed, the Chrysurus Angelfish makes an unusual clicking sound. As other angelfish, it is hermaphroditic, and there are no distinguishing characteristics to differentiate males and females. It is difficult to breed in an aquarium. The diet of the Chrysurus Angelfish should include Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparati

products.title: Oreni Tilefish - 4"
products.description: Be one of the few people IN THE WORLD to own an Oreni Tilefish Hoplolatilus oreni , referred to by some as the Holy Grail in aquarium keeping. A member of the Malacanthidae family, most Tilefish display shy or skittish behavior, but not this beauty. Sought after because it is rare, peaceful, photogenic, and has a lot of personality, it is relatively new to the aquarium industry. The Oreni Tilefish being offered by LiveAquaria® is from Kenya. Growing to a maximum of 8”, this marine fish displays a blue metallic zigzag line mid-body starting behind the head and ending at the base of the caudal fin. Scattered spots appear above the midline in a broken blue line on a bronze background. It possesses a torpedo-shaped body and has an ethereal presence. Demersal, it will live close to the bottom of your aquarium and create burrows or mounds in which it retreats if it feels threatened, so provide plenty of substrate. Requiring a relatively large aquarium (50 gallon minimum) because of its active nature, you will want to protect your investment by providing a cover for your aquarium. products.title: Vlamingii Tang 3.25"
products.description: The Vlamingii Tang, also known as the Vlaming's Unicornfish, or Bignose Unicornfish, has a brown to purple body color when an adult. In the juvenile, The color graduates from lighter, dorsaly, to darker, ventrally. It has vertical markings on the body and blue highlights. The dorsal fin, anal fin, tail, and face are all sparingly detailed in a brilliant bright blue. A 360 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room and places to hide. The aquarium should have a tight-fitting lid to prevent the fish from jumping out to escape. It is aggressive toward other Tangs, but peaceful with other fish, and will not harm sessile invertebrates within the reef aquarium. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use.
products.description_zh: 弗拉明独角鱼，也称为弗拉明独角鱼或大鼻独角鱼，成年后体色呈棕色至紫色。在幼鱼身上，颜色从背部的浅色逐渐过渡到腹侧的深色。它的身体上有垂直的标记和蓝色的亮点。背鳍、臀鳍、尾巴和脸部的细节都非常简洁，呈亮蓝色。需要一个 360 加仑或更大的水族箱来提供充足的游泳池和隐藏的地方。水族箱应有一个密闭的盖子，以防止鱼跳出逃跑。它对其他唐鱼具有攻击性，但与其他鱼类和平相处，并且不会伤害珊瑚礁水族箱内的固着无脊椎动物。阿尔托呃，唐鱼会和水族箱里的其他鱼一样吃肉食，重要的是要为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。

products.title: Maroon Clownfish 2.75"
products.description: The Maroon Clownfish, also known as the Spine-Cheeked Anemonefish or Maroon Anemonefish, has a bold, red body color with a broad white stripe on the forehead, and white stripes on its midsection and in front of the anal fin. A 30 gallon or larger aquarium is desirable as is a host anemone such as Bubbletip Sea Anemone ( Entacmaea quadricolor ). It is aggressive towards other clownfish, and they are difficult to maintain together in the same aquarium. The Maroon Clownfish diet consists of meaty items such as frozen shrimp and herbivore preparations. Do not move the Maroon Clownfish with a net as its cheekspines will become entangled. Use a specimen container if capture is necessary. It is difficult to maintain more than one maroon clown in the aquarium unless they are a pair. These fish like to fight among themselves.
products.description_zh: 栗色小丑鱼，也称为脊颊小丑鱼或栗色小丑鱼，体色大胆，红色，额头上有宽阔的白色条纹，中部和臀鳍前面有白色条纹。 30 加仑或更大的水族箱是理想的，因为寄主海葵如泡尖海葵 (Entacmaea 四色) 也是理想的。它对其他小丑鱼具有攻击性，并且它们很难在同一个水族箱中一起饲养。栗色小丑鱼的饮食包括肉类食品，例如冷冻虾和草食动物制剂。不要用网移动栗色小丑鱼，因为它的颊刺会被缠住。如果需要捕获，请使用样本容器。这是不同的水族箱里很难养一只以上的栗色小丑，除非它们是一对。这些鱼喜欢互相争斗。

products.title: Dusky Tilefish 5"
products.description: The Dusky Tilefish is also known as the Pastel Tilefish, and Bluehead Tilefish. The head of this fish is blue, and the body a pale yellow. A hardy fish, it needs a tank of at least 50 gallons with at least 3 inches of mixed substrate for burrowing, and a tight-fitting lid to prevent escape. It prefers to associate with members of its own species as tank mates and needs a lot of swimming room for its very active lifestyle. A diet providing a variety of marine fish, crustacean flesh, and mysis or brine shrimp will give the Dusky Tilefish the nutrition it needs when fed three times per day.
products.description_zh: 暗色方头鱼也称为粉彩方头鱼和蓝头方头鱼。这条鱼的头是蓝色的，身体是淡黄色的。作为一种耐寒的鱼，它需要一个至少 50 加仑的水箱，其中至少有 3 英寸的混合基质用于挖洞，以及一个严密的盖子以防止逃跑。它更喜欢与自己物种的成员作为坦克伙伴交往，并且需要大量的游泳池来适应其非常活跃的生活方式。每天喂食三次的暗色方头鱼，其饮食中含有各种海鱼、甲壳类动物的肉、糠虾或丰年虾，即可为暗色方头鱼提供所需的营养。

products.title: Orange Storm Clownfish 1.5"
products.description: The Captive-Bred Orange Storm Clownfish displays an appealing color and pattern that is extremely alluring. The Orange Storm Clownfish derives its lineage from a mutation that appeared during the selective breeding process. The Captive-Bred Orange Storm Clownfish demonstrates an exaggerated white body pattern with an orange and white face and black eyes. The random blotchy patterning of the Captive-Bred Orange Storm Clownfish sports a vibrant orange coloration that is beautifully highlighted by the milk-white coloration. The Orange Storm Clownfish does best, housed in an aquarium of at least 20 gallons or larger with plenty of live rock. It may form a symbiotic relationship with the following species of anemones; Carpet ( Stichodactyla sp. ), Sebae ( Heteractis crispa ), Bulb ( Entacmaea quadricolor ), or Ritteri ( Heteractis magnifica ) Anemones. Though the Orange Storm Clownfish does not require an anemone to thrive, if you choose to house an anemone, always be sure that your aquarium and lighting system will support the needs of the host anemone before incorporating one into the aquarium. products.description_zh: 圈养的橙色风暴小丑鱼呈现出极具吸引力的颜色和图案。橙色风暴小丑鱼的血统源自选择性育种过程中出现的突变。圈养的橙色风暴小丑鱼呈现出夸张的白色身体图案，橙色和白色的脸以及黑色的眼睛。圈养橙色风暴小丑鱼的随机斑点图案呈现出充满活力的橙色，在乳白色的衬托下显得更加美丽。橙色风暴小丑鱼的表现最好，饲养在至少 20 加仑或更大且有大量活石的水族箱中。它可能与以下形成共生关系g种海葵；地毯海葵 (Stichodactyla sp.)、海葵 (Heteractis Crispa)、球根海葵 (Entacmaeaquadricolor) 或海葵 (Heteractis magnifica)。尽管橙色风暴小丑鱼不需要海葵才能繁衍生息，但如果您选择饲养海葵，请务必确保您的水族箱和照明系统能够满足宿主海葵的需求，然后再将海葵放入水族箱中。人工饲养的小丑鱼比野生捕获的小丑鱼具有优势。其一，圈养繁殖的 C

products.title: Carberryi Anthias 3.5"
products.description: The Carberryi Anthias (Nemanthias carberryi) also known as the Threadfin Anthias is a very striking fish that originates from Indian Ocean reefs from the Maldives to Eastern Africa. Carberryi Anthias are very colorful with vibrant purple coloration on the head and abdomen area with a cheerful yellow coloration that beautifully paints the anterior portion of the fish. Carberryi Anthias are very active marine fish that naturally help draw out shier fish that share the aquarium with them. Carberryi Anthias tend to occupy the midwater region of a tank but appreciates the availability of several hiding places. Carberryi Anthias do best when kept in groups or shoals in a species-specific tank of at least 70-gallons. If setting up an anthias shoal, the composition of the group should consist principally of juvenile and female individuals. You should add only one male to the aquarium, unless the aquarium is large enough to accommodate more. Even in a very large marine aquarium setup, the ratio should be highly skewed toward juveniles and/or female anthias (a good rule of thumb would be one male to every four to six females/juveniles). products.title: Firefish Goby 2.5"
products.description: The Firefish is one of the more popular fish in the marine hobby. It is a magnificent fish with brilliant coloration, a unique body shape, and unparalleled personality. Also known as the Firefish Goby, Fire Goby, and Magnificent or Fire Dartfish, Nemateleotris magnifica has a yellow head, white anterior, and pinkish to orange-red posterior. The dorsal, anal, and caudal fins are highlighted in black. In addition to its striking coloration, the Firefish Goby is also heralded as a sweet-tempered fish with lots of personality. And, because of its small size, the Firefish Goby makes a great addition to the smaller reef system. In the wild, the Firefish Goby is usually found in groups hovering over the reef, harvesting planktonic food that drifts by in the current. The docile, Firefish Goby is timid and in the wild, each will have a "bolt-hole" into which it quickly ducks when threatened. In the home aquarium, the Firefish Goby needs multiple safety zones amongst rocky crags or outcroppings into which it can dart if stressed. This member of the Gobiidae family is generally not aggressive towards other fish except those of its own species. However, a mated pair can live peacefully togethe
products.description_zh: 火鱼是海洋爱好者中最受欢迎的鱼类之一。它是一种华丽的鱼，色彩绚丽，体形独特，个性无与伦比。 Nemateleotris magnifica 也称为火鱼虾虎鱼、火虾虎鱼、华丽或火镖鱼，头部呈黄色，前部白色，后部呈粉红色至橙红色。背鳍、臀鳍和尾鳍以黑色突出显示。除了其引人注目的颜色外，火鱼虾虎鱼还被认为是一种性情温和、个性十足的鱼。而且，由于体型较小，火鱼虾虎鱼对较小的珊瑚礁系统来说是一个很好的补充。在野外，火鱼虾虎鱼通常成群结队地在附近盘旋。在珊瑚礁中，收获随流漂流的浮游食物。火鱼虾虎鱼性情温顺，性格胆小，在野外，它们都有一个“避难所”，在受到威胁时会迅速躲入其中。在家庭水族箱中，火鱼虾虎鱼需要在岩石峭壁或露头之间有多个安全区域，如果受到压力，它可以冲进去。这种戈壁鱼科的成员通常不会攻击除本种以外的其他鱼类。然而，一对伴侣可以和平地生活在一起

products.title: Vanderbilt Chromis 3-Lot 1.25"
products.description: The Vanderbilt Chromis is found in schools throughout the reefs of Tonga. This chromis is yellow with beautiful blue lines and blue lining the fins. These fish are hardy fish that are ideal for a fish only, or reef aquarium. They do enjoy being kept in schools of 3 or more. It is a very hardy fish found in a variety of aquariums. It is commonly kept long term, in small schools, and used by beginners to learn the hobby. It may also be included in larger schools in show tanks. It is a peaceful fish, and adds a dramatic effect to the tank. The Vanderbilt Chromis will live from 8-15 years in an aquarium in water of good quality. The diet should be varied and consist of meaty items, herbivore flakes, and frozen preparations. Using vitamin-enriched foods may help to preserve the bright color.
products.description_zh: 范德比尔特克罗米斯鱼群遍布汤加的珊瑚礁中。这种铬鱼呈黄色，带有美丽的蓝色线条，鳍上有蓝色衬里。这些鱼是耐寒的鱼，非常适合鱼类或珊瑚礁水族馆。他们确实喜欢被留在三人或三人以上的学校里。它是一种非常耐寒的鱼，在各种水族馆中都有发现。它通常在小型学校中长期保留，并由初学者用来学习爱好。它也可能被纳入较大学校的展示池中。它是一种性情温和的鱼，给鱼缸增添了戏剧性的效果。 Vanderbilt Chromis 在水质良好的水族箱中可存活 8 至 15 年。饮食应该多样化，包括肉类、草食性食物kes和冷冻制剂。使用富含维生素的食物可能有助于保持明亮的颜色。

products.title: Midas Blenny 4.5"
products.description: The Midas Blenny is an excellent candidate for a reef tank. It is a beautiful, deep golden-yellow with a shadow of blue under the chin and bright, blue-rimmed eyes. When swimming, the motion they use is very eel-like. This blenny will appreciate a minimum tank of 30 gallons or larger with numerous rocks on which to perch. Sometimes, the Midas Blenny will vex small planktivores and has been known to nip at firefish and gobies. Larger tanks are advantageous as many of the Midas Blenny's aggressive behavior traits seem to relate to a confining tank situation. Unlike most blennies, the Midas Blenny requires a meaty diet including finely chopped crustacean flesh, mysis and vitamin-enriched brine shrimp, along with frozen herbivorous preparations, micro and blue-green algae.
products.description_zh: Midas Blenny 是珊瑚缸的绝佳候选者。它是美丽的深金黄色，下巴下有蓝色的阴影，眼睛明亮，有蓝色的眼圈。游泳时，它们的动作很像鳗鱼。这种鲶鱼会喜欢至少 30 加仑或更大的水箱，并有许多岩石可供栖息。有时，迈达斯布兰尼会惹恼小型浮游生物，并会咬火鱼和虾虎鱼。较大的水箱是有利的，因为迈达斯布兰尼的许多攻击性行为特征似乎与封闭的水箱情况有关。与大多数鲶鱼不同，迈达斯鲶鱼需要肉类饮食，包括切碎的甲壳动物肉、糠虾和富含维生素的盐水虾，以及冷冻草食性制剂、微藻和蓝绿藻。

products.title: Singapore Angelfish 2.5"
products.description: The Singapore Angelfish, also known as the Vermiculated Angelfish, has been likened to a butterflyfish in body structure. Blue lips and a yellow nose abruptly change to a black vertical band over the eyes, resembling a mask. The mask is bordered with another thin vertical band of yellow, followed by a wider vertical band of white with the body being primarily black. Dorsal and anal fins are outlined in brilliant sapphire-blue and the caudal fin is usually yellow but may be gray. Due to the increased level of care required for this particular species it has been designated as "Difficult". Some acclimate well, while others may hide and not eat. Providing a quietly-located aquarium with non-aggressive tank mates and plenty of hiding places may help. A minimum of a 120 gallon tank or larger provided with live rock for grazing will also help provide an optimal environment. The Singapore Angelfish is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles. It will also graze on microalgae, filamentous algae, and diatoms. The Singapore Angelfish is hermaphroditic, difficult to breed, and does not have distinguishable variations in color between male and female. The
products.description_zh: 新加坡神仙鱼，又名蛭形神仙鱼，其身体结构类似于蝴蝶鱼。蓝色的嘴唇和黄色的鼻子突然变成了眼睛上方的黑色垂直带，就像面具一样。面具的边缘是另一条细的黄色垂直带，后面是一条较宽的垂直白色带，身体主要是黑色。背鳍和臀鳍的轮廓呈明亮的宝蓝色，尾鳍通常是黄色的，但也可能是灰色的。由于该特定物种所需的护理水平不断提高，因此被指定为“困难”物种。有些适应得很好，而另一些则可能会躲起来而不吃东西。提供一个安静且无聚集的水族箱敏感的坦克伙伴和大量的藏身之处可能会有所帮助。至少 120 加仑或更大的水箱，配备用于放牧的活石，也将有助于提供最佳环境。新加坡神仙鱼很容易咬食石珊瑚、软珊瑚（无脊椎动物）和蛤壳。它还会吃微藻、丝状藻和硅藻。新加坡神仙鱼是雌雄同体，难以繁殖，并且雄性和雌性之间没有明显的颜色差异。这

products.title: McCosker's Flasher Wrasse
products.description: The McCosker's Flasher Wrasse is an attractive reef-safe wrasse sure to be the star of your aquarium. This hardy wrasse species adapts well to established home aquariums, making it a beautiful and active addition. The vibrantly colored male McCosker's Flasher Wrasse is predominantly red/orange with blue, horizontal stripes that complement its yellow stomach. The orange dorsal fin is accented with red, yellow, and blue and features a single elongated ray. A gorgeous, red band across the orange anal fin creates an impressive and bold color palette. The female coloration and overall appearance is more subdued. The females also do not feature the large dorsal and anal fins. The McCosker's Flasher Wrasse requires a 55 gallon aquarium (or larger) with a tight-fitting lid since it is a jumper. Often found along reef slopes and rubble zones, the McCosker's Flasher Wrasse will often swim near the bottom and tends to form small groups where a male swims back and forth between groups of females. The colors of an adult male intensifies during courtship and he may flare or "flash" his fins to attract females. We recommend only one male per aquarium display. products.description_zh: 麦考斯克闪光濑鱼是一种有吸引力的珊瑚礁安全濑鱼，一定会成为您水族箱中的明星。这种耐寒的濑鱼品种非常适合现有的家庭水族箱，使其成为美丽而活跃的补充。雄性麦考斯克闪光濑鱼颜色鲜艳，主要为红色/橙色，带有蓝色水平条纹，与其黄色腹部相得益彰。橙色的背鳍点缀着红色、黄色和蓝色，并有一条细长的射线。橙色臀鳍上有一条华丽的红色带子，营造出令人印象深刻且大胆的调色板。女性的肤色和整体外观更加柔和。雌性也没有大的背鳍和臀鳍。麦考斯克的闪光r 濑鱼需要一个 55 加仑（或更大）的水族箱，并带有紧密的盖子，因为它是跳线鱼。麦考斯克闪光濑鱼经常出现在礁石斜坡和碎石区，它们经常在水底附近游动，并倾向于形成小群体，雄性在雌性群体之间来回游动。成年雄性的颜色在求爱期间会增强，并且可能会张开或“闪烁”他的鳍来吸引雌性。我们建议每个水族箱只展示一只雄性。麦考斯克闪光濑鱼饮食sh

products.title: Boxfish
products.description: The Boxfish is also referred to as the Spotted Boxfish, Blue Boxfish, Black Boxfish, or Whitespotted Boxfish. The various names are due to the dimorphic appearance of the male and female. The male is the more colorful of the two, with a vibrant blue body and a wide black swath covering the top of the body like a cap. The entire body is speckled with dots, white on black and black on blue while a thin horizontal stripe of orange adorns the tail. The female is entirely black with white dots. This is a very difficult fish to keep in the aquarium setting by any other than the most experienced aquarist. It should have a minimum of a 180 gallon tank. Use caution if placing the Boxfish in a reef tank as they will often nibble at tubeworms. When stressed, the Boxfish releases a poisonous substance, called ostracitoxin, from its mucous glands which will kill other fish in the tank very quickly. Very little success has been achieved in breeding these fish in an aquarium. When first introduced, the Boxfish can be fed a diet of live brine shrimp or bloodworms. After acclimatization, chopped squid, clams, mussels, and herbivore preparations can be fed. Approximate Purchase Size: Small Female: 1
products.description_zh: 箱鱼也称为斑点箱鱼、蓝箱鱼、黑箱鱼或白斑箱鱼。各种名称是由于男性和女性的二态性外观而产生的。雄性是两者中颜色更丰富的，有充满活力的蓝色身体和一条宽阔的黑色带子，覆盖在身体的顶部，就像一顶帽子。整个身体上布满了黑底白字和蓝底黑字的斑点，尾巴上有一条橙色的细水平条纹。雌性全身黑色，带有白色斑点。除了最有经验的鱼友之外，这是一种非常难以在水族箱中饲养的鱼。它应该有至少 180 加仑的水箱。将箱鲀放入珊瑚礁时要小心nk，因为它们经常会啃食管虫。当受到压力时，箱鲀会从粘液腺中释放出一种叫做鸵鸟毒素的有毒物质，这种物质会很快杀死水族箱中的其他鱼。在水族馆中繁殖这些鱼几乎没有取得成功。首次引入时，箱鲀可以喂食活丰年虾或红虫。适应环境后，可以喂切碎的鱿鱼、蛤、贻贝和草食动物制剂。大约购买尺寸：小号 女性：1

products.title: Leopard Wrasse
products.description: The Leopard Wrasse is also known as the Guinea Fowl Wrasse, or Blackspotted Wrasse. This species has two different appearances depending on gender. Females are white with multiple black or brown irregular spots with white to blue margins covering the entire body. The female's fins may have accents of yellow or tan. The males have an orangish-red background color with green mottling covering the body. A 90 gallon or larger aquarium with well established live rock and a layer of live sand is recommended. They will do best when introduced in groups of three or more. It eats small invertebrates (foraminiferans and amphiopods) that grow on live rock. The Leopard Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food.<; Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1/2" to 1-1/4"; Medium: 1-1/4" to 2-1/4"; Large: 2-1/4" to 3-1/2"
products.description_zh: 豹纹濑鱼也被称为珍珠鸡濑鱼或黑斑濑鱼。该物种根据性别有两种不同的外观。雌性呈白色，有多个黑色或棕色不规则斑点，白色至蓝色边缘覆盖整个身体。雌性的鳍可能带有黄色或棕褐色的色调。雄性有橙红色的背景颜色，身体上覆盖着绿色斑点。建议使用 90 加仑或更大的水族箱，其中有成熟的活石和一层活沙。当他们以三人或三人以上为一组时，效果会最好。它吃生长在活岩石上的小型无脊椎动物（有孔虫和片足类动物）。豹纹濑鱼的饮食应包含维生素富含冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食品以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食品。大致购买尺寸：小号：1/2 英寸至 1-1/4 英寸；中号：1-1/4" 至 2-1/4"；大号：2-1/4" 至 3-1/2"

products.title: Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang
products.description: SAVE 50%! The Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang is a gorgeous color variety of the popular Blue Tang. Though it shares the attractive coloration of the Blue Tang, the Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang boasts a richer, deep-blue coloration and a brilliant yellow coloration that covers a greater portion of the body. The yellow coloration, most prominent on the caudal fin (tail), continues across the belly region, giving the Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang an exciting boost in color. Small Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tangs will not exhibit the yellow belly coloration until they mature. Combined with the signature bold black markings resembling a painter's palette, the Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang is sure to be an impressive addition to reef or fish-only aquariums. Native to reefs in the Indian Ocean, the Yellow Belly Regal Blue Tang appreciates good hiding locations amongst live rock. However, this active fish also loves to swim. Therefore, ample room to roam around your aquarium is essential for optimum health. products.description_zh: 节省 50%！黄腹富豪蓝唐丹是流行的蓝唐丹的一个华丽的颜色品种。虽然它与蓝唐丹有着迷人的颜色，但黄腹帝王蓝唐丹拥有更丰富的深蓝色和覆盖身体大部分的亮黄色。黄色在尾鳍（尾巴）上最为突出，一直延续到腹部区域，使黄腹帝王蓝唐唐的颜色更加令人兴奋。小黄腹帝王蓝唐在成熟之前不会表现出黄腹颜色。结合类似于画家调色板的标志性大胆黑色标记，黄腹富豪蓝唐肯定会成为是珊瑚礁或纯鱼水族馆的令人印象深刻的补充。黄腹帝王蓝唐丹原产于印度洋的珊瑚礁，喜欢在活石中寻找良好的藏身之处。然而，这种活跃的鱼也喜欢游泳。因此，在水族箱周围有足够的空间漫步对于最佳健康至关重要。虽然黄腹帝王蓝唐吊鱼对大多数坦克伙伴表现得很平和，但对其同类的其他鱼类却表现出攻击性行为。要保留多个标本，请引入 e

products.description: The Pipe Organ Coral is a soft coral but is often referred to as a hard coral because it produces an external calcareous skeleton that is red in coloration. Common names for the Pipe Organ Coral may include Organ Pipe Coral, Mat Polyp, or Daisy Coral. When its polyps are open, the Pipe Organ Coral is often easily confused with Star Polyp Corals or Clove Polyp Corals because of their similar appearance. However, unlike the aforementioned doppelgangers, the Pipe Organ Coral has a tight "well behaved" growth habit and will not spread aggressively across the rocks and potentially crowd neighboring corals. The ideal environment for the Pipe Organ Coral is an established reef aquarium with coral-friendly fish and invertebrates. The Pipe Organ Coral is safe to place near other peaceful corals as it lacks sweeper tentacles that can potentially damage other corals with which it may come into contact. Once established, the Pipe Organ Coral provides a fantastic living tapestry of color and movement ideal for softening the rough edges of rockwork or filling empty reef aquarium landscapes. products.description_zh: 管风琴珊瑚是一种软珊瑚，但通常被称为硬珊瑚，因为它产生红色的外部钙质骨骼。管风琴珊瑚的俗名可能包括风琴管珊瑚、席状息肉或雏菊珊瑚。当水螅体张开时，管风琴珊瑚经常很容易与星形水螅珊瑚或丁香水螅珊瑚混淆，因为它们的外观相似。然而，与上述的分身不同，管风珊瑚具有严格的“行为良好”的生长习性，不会在岩石上积极扩散并可能挤占邻近的珊瑚。管风琴珊瑚的理想环境是拥有珊瑚的成熟珊瑚礁水族馆友善的鱼类和无脊椎动物。管风琴珊瑚可以安全地放置在其他安静的珊瑚附近，因为它没有清扫触手，可能会损坏它可能接触到的其他珊瑚。一旦建立起来，管风琴珊瑚就会提供梦幻般的色彩和动感的活生生的挂毯，非常适合软化岩石的粗糙边缘或填充空的珊瑚礁水族馆景观。管风琴珊瑚将在 T-5 荧光灯、p 实现的中等到高照明条件下茁壮成长

products.title: Rock Flower Anemone, Premium 2" to 3"
products.description: The Premium Rock Flower Anemone, also known as the Rock Anemone, is a member of the Phymanthidae family. Originating from the Caribbean, these anemones are found in a wide array of colors, with the oral disc often being a different color than the rest of the anemone. The oral disc lacks tentacles, and the tentacles are often beaded in appearance. Premium Rock Flower Anemones are selected and offered for sale due to their abundance and intensity of color. The Flower Anemone can live singly or in groups. They prefer to live on shaded, vertical rock walls, or within the substrate. They will bury most of their body in the sand, with only the oral disc and tentacles showing. These are fairly hardy anemones that will adapt to a wide variety of lighting conditions. These anemones tend not to wander about the aquarium and are a great addition to a reef aquarium. The Flower Anemone is a carnivore which requires meaty foods to survive. Offer mussels and freshly chopped fish meat, as well as high quality frozen foods. Adding iodine and trace elements to the aquarium will help the Flower Anemone thrive.
products.description_zh: 优质岩花海葵，也称为岩海葵，是 Phymanthidae 科的成员。这些海葵起源于加勒比海，有多种颜色，口盘的颜色通常与海葵其他部分的颜色不同。口盘无触手，触手外观常呈串珠状。优质岩花海葵因其丰富且色彩浓烈而被挑选并出售。花海葵可以单独生活，也可以群居。它们更喜欢生活在阴凉、垂直的岩壁上或基质内。它们会将大部分身体埋在沙子里，只露出口盘和触手。这些都是相当难的y 海葵能够适应各种光照条件。这些海葵不会在水族箱中徘徊，是珊瑚礁水族箱的绝佳补充。花海葵是肉食动物，需要肉类食物才能生存。提供贻贝和新鲜切碎的鱼肉，以及高品质的冷冻食品。在水族箱中添加碘和微量元素将有助于花海葵的茁壮成长。

products.title: White Spotted Bamboo Cat Shark
products.description: The Bamboo Shark is also known as a Cat Shark because the barbels at the mouth look like cat whiskers. It is also referred to as the Whitespotted Bamboo Shark, and has a brown-colored body with broad tan stripes and spots. The Bamboo Shark is a bottom dwelling shark that is common in the home aquarium. It will eat any crustacean in the aquarium. It stays relatively small, but requires at least a 300 gallon or larger aquarium as an adult. It requires sand as the substrate as the abdomen is easily scratched by a coarser substrate, which may lead to an infection. It should never be exposed to copper-based medications. When first introduced into the aquarium, small pieces of cleaned squid or live saltwater feeder shrimp should be used to entice this fish to eat. Then it may be fed shrimp, scallops or pieces of fresh marine fish. Feeding these sharks quality foods such as whole cockle in the shell, fresh shrimp and squid, and frozen mussel are ideal.
products.description_zh: 竹鲨也被称为猫鲨，因为嘴部的触须看起来像猫须。它也被称为白斑竹鲨，身体呈棕色，带有宽大的棕褐色条纹和斑点。竹鲨是一种底栖鲨鱼，在家庭水族箱中很常见。它会吃水族馆里的任何甲壳类动物。它相对较小，但成年后至少需要 300 加仑或更大的水族箱。它需要沙子作为基质，因为腹部很容易被较粗糙的基质划伤，从而可能导致感染。切勿将其接触含铜药物。第一次放入水族箱时，将洗净的鱿鱼或活鱼小块放入水族箱中。应使用咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。然后可以喂虾、扇贝或新鲜的海鱼片。给这些鲨鱼喂食优质食物，例如带壳的整个鸟蛤、新鲜的虾和鱿鱼以及冷冻贻贝是理想的选择。

products.title: Filamentosa Barb
products.description: The Filamentosa Barb is a beautiful and active freshwater fish known for its shimmering silver to golden body, dark-edged scales, and the elongated filament-like extensions that develop on the dorsal fin of mature males. Peaceful yet energetic, this species does best when kept in schools of six or more, allowing their natural social behavior and impressive coloration to shine. Filamentosa Barbs thrive in a well-planted aquarium of at least 30 gallons with clean, well-oxygenated water and moderate water movement. Include driftwood, rocks, and hardy plants to create a natural environment while leaving plenty of open swimming space. They are peaceful community fish and can be housed with other active, similarly sized species. Breeding Filamentosa Barbs is possible in the home aquarium, although it is less common than with many other barb species. A conditioned breeding pair or small group should be placed in a separate spawning aquarium with fine-leaved plants or a spawning mop. The female will scatter adhesive eggs, which the male fertilizes. After spawning, the adults should be removed to prevent them from eating the eggs. The fry hatch within a few days and become free-swimming sho
products.description_zh: 丝状倒钩鱼是一种美丽而活跃的淡水鱼，以其闪闪发光的银色到金色的身体、深色边缘的鳞片以及成熟雄性背鳍上发育的细长丝状延伸而闻名。该物种性情平和但充满活力，当饲养在六只或六只以上的群体中时表现最佳，让它们自然的社交行为和令人印象深刻的色彩闪闪发光。丝状倒刺鱼在至少 30 加仑、清洁、含氧良好的水和适度的水流、种植良好的水族箱中茁壮成长。添加浮木、岩石和耐寒植物，营造自然环境，同时留下充足的开放游泳空间。它们是性情温和的社区鱼类，可以与其他鱼类一起饲养活跃的、大小相似的物种。丝状倒钩鱼可以在家庭水族箱中繁殖，尽管与许多其他倒钩鱼品种相比不太常见。应将经过调节的繁殖对或小群体放置在单独的产卵水族箱中，并放置细叶植物或产卵拖把。雌性会散布有粘性的卵，雄性则使卵受精。产卵后，应将成虫移走，防止成虫吃卵。鱼苗在几天内孵化并成为自由游泳的鱼

products.title: Red Discus
products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. Depending on sub-species, the natural range of the Discus extends from the Amazon to the Rio Negro Regions of South America. Discus require an advanced level of care due to its feeding habits and water filtration requirements. Territorial during spawning, this otherwise peaceful fish is among the schooling group, forming a well-defined nuclear family. Becoming slightly territorial when breeding, it is best to breed an established pair, or maintain a group of young Discus and allow them to pair themselves. Warm, soft, slightly acidic water is required for spawning. The pair will clean a flat surface (usually a broad leaf or the side of the aquarium) prior to spawning. The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus. Largely carnivorous, Discus prefer freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, pellet food designed for Discus, high-quality flake food, and meaty frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 七彩神仙的整体颜色会根据鱼的情绪和整体健康状况而变化。七彩神仙鱼已超越神仙鱼成为最受欢迎的淡水观赏鱼。根据亚种的不同，七彩神仙的自然分布范围从亚马逊延伸到南美洲的里奥内格罗地区。由于其进食习惯和水过滤要求，七彩神仙需要高级护理。这种原本性情温和的鱼在产卵期间会成为鱼群中的领地，形成一个明确的核心家庭。繁殖时会变得稍微有领地意识，最好繁殖成对，或者养一群年轻的七彩神仙，让它们自己配对。温暖、柔软、产卵需要微酸性水。产卵前，它们会清洁平坦的表面（通常是阔叶或水族箱的侧面）。不得将亲本从鱼苗中取出；鱼苗以父母的粘液为食。七彩神仙主要是肉食性的，喜欢冻干红虫和红虫、专为七彩神仙设计的颗粒食品、优质片状食品和肉质冷冻食品。

products.title: Red Pigeon Blood Discus
products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. Depending on sub-species, the natural range of the Discus extends from the Amazon to the Rio Negro Regions of South America. Discus require an advanced level of care due to its feeding habits and water filtration requirements. Territorial during spawning, this otherwise peaceful fish is among the schooling group, forming a well-defined nuclear family. Becoming slightly territorial when breeding, it is best to breed an established pair, or maintain a group of young Discus and allow them to pair themselves. Warm, soft, slightly acidic water is required for spawning. The pair will clean a flat surface (usually a broad leaf or the side of the aquarium) prior to spawning. The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus. Largely carnivorous, Discus prefer freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, pellet food designed for Discus, high-quality flake food, and meaty frozen foods.

products.title: Black Saddle Grouper
products.description: The Black Saddle Grouper, also known as Black Saddled Grouper, or Saddled Grouper, is primarily white in color. The fins are yellow, and black to brown dots often cover the entire body. The back has four black to brown saddles. A 250 gallon or larger aquarium is required due to the size and feeding habits of this fish. It is extremely aggressive and may eat its tank mates as well as crustaceans. The Black Saddle Grouper prefers a diet of meaty foods such as krill, shrimp, and other small fish.
products.description_zh: 黑鞍石斑鱼，也称为黑鞍石斑鱼或鞍石斑鱼，主要颜色为白色。鳍是黄色的，黑色到棕色的斑点经常覆盖整个身体。背部有四个黑色至棕色的鞍座。由于这种鱼的体型和食性，需要 250 加仑或更大的水族箱。它极具攻击性，可能会吃掉它的坦克同伴以及甲壳类动物。黑鞍石斑鱼喜欢吃肉类食物，如磷虾、虾和其他小鱼。

products.title: Rock Flower Anemone, Premium 2" to 3"
products.description: The Premium Rock Flower Anemone, also known as the Rock Anemone, is a member of the Phymanthidae family. Originating from the Caribbean, these anemones are found in a wide array of colors, with the oral disc often being a different color than the rest of the anemone. The oral disc lacks tentacles, and the tentacles are often beaded in appearance. Premium Rock Flower Anemones are selected and offered for sale due to their abundance and intensity of color. The Flower Anemone can live singly or in groups. They prefer to live on shaded, vertical rock walls, or within the substrate. They will bury most of their body in the sand, with only the oral disc and tentacles showing. These are fairly hardy anemones that will adapt to a wide variety of lighting conditions. These anemones tend not to wander about the aquarium and are a great addition to a reef aquarium. The Flower Anemone is a carnivore which requires meaty foods to survive. Offer mussels and freshly chopped fish meat, as well as high quality frozen foods. Adding iodine and trace elements to the aquarium will help the Flower Anemone thrive.
products.description_zh: 优质岩花海葵，也称为岩海葵，是 Phymanthidae 科的成员。这些海葵起源于加勒比海，有多种颜色，口盘的颜色通常与海葵其他部分的颜色不同。口盘无触手，触手外观常呈串珠状。优质岩花海葵因其丰富且色彩浓烈而被挑选并出售。花海葵可以单独生活，也可以群居。它们更喜欢生活在阴凉、垂直的岩壁上或基质内。它们会将大部分身体埋在沙子里，只露出口盘和触手。这些都是相当难的y 海葵能够适应各种光照条件。这些海葵不会在水族箱中徘徊，是珊瑚礁水族箱的绝佳补充。花海葵是肉食动物，需要肉类食物才能生存。提供贻贝和新鲜切碎的鱼肉，以及高品质的冷冻食品。在水族箱中添加碘和微量元素将有助于花海葵的茁壮成长。

products.title: Rock Flower Anemone, Premium 2" to 3"
products.description: The Premium Rock Flower Anemone, also known as the Rock Anemone, is a member of the Phymanthidae family. Originating from the Caribbean, these anemones are found in a wide array of colors, with the oral disc often being a different color than the rest of the anemone. products.title: Silver Scat 3-Lot 1.25"
products.description: The Silver Scat fish is a popular brackish water aquarium fish that is native to the Indo-Pacific region also known as the Spotbanded Scat, Barred Scat, and Striped Butterfish. Silver Scat fish are a hardy schooling fish that should be kept in a minimum tank size of 125 gallons. When introducing a school of Silver Scat's it is best to introduce all individuals at the same time as they establish a hierarchical system. Silver Scats have a uniquely-shaped silver or dark body with black stripes and spots, as the fish matures many of these characteristics are lost. Silver Scats are opportunistic omnivores that require a varied diet in vegetable matter as they mature. As they mature their diet switches to a more herbivorous, favoring filamentous algae and plant material. Provide a varied diet that includes blanched spinach, kale and seaweed while also offering a variety of frozen foods such as brine shrimp, bloodworms, mysis shrimp or krill. If you are offering a pellet or flake food ensure it is rich in vegetable based ingredients. The dorsal and ventral fins of the Silver scat are venomous, if stung it is similar to a bee sting but more potent.
products.description_zh: 银鱼是一种流行的咸水观赏鱼，原产于印度太平洋地区，也称为斑带鱼、条纹鱼和条纹鲳鱼。银鲶鱼是一种耐寒的鱼群，应饲养在最小 125 加仑的水箱中。在介绍银星猫的学校时，最好同时介绍所有个体，因为他们建立了等级制度。银鱼的身体呈独特的银色或深色，带有黑色条纹和斑点，随着鱼的成熟，这些特征中的许多特征都会消失。银鲫鱼是机会主义的杂食动物，在成熟时需要多样化的植物性饮食。随着他们的饮食逐渐成熟更适合草食性，更喜欢丝状藻类和植物材料。提供多样化的饮食，包括焯水菠菜、羽衣甘蓝和海藻，同时还提供各种冷冻食品，如丰年虾、红虫、糠虾或磷虾。如果您提供颗粒或片状食品，请确保其富含蔬菜成分。银粪的背鳍和腹鳍有毒，如果被蛰的话，其效果类似于蜜蜂蜇，但威力更强。

products.title: Twin Spot Wrasse 3"
products.description: The Twin Spot Wrasse is also referred to as the Clown Coris, or Twinspot Coris. The juvenile is silver with dark spots on the face. The dorsal fin has a pair of dark spots with yellow highlights on the body. The adult becomes blue-green with a white or light green band around the midsection. When courting, the male will display an increased color intensity. It requires a 300 gallon or larger aquarium with a 4-6 inch layer of sand in which to bury itself. A single male can be kept with a group of females that is introduced prior to or at the same time as the male. The Twin Spot Wrasse will eat urchins, crabs, shrimp, and small invertebrates. It is an excellent hunter and will leave no rock unturned (literally), in search of food. The Twin Spot Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food.
products.description_zh: 双斑濑鱼也被称为小丑科里斯，或双斑科里斯。少年全身银色，脸上有黑斑。背鳍有一对黑色斑点，身体上有黄色亮点。成虫呈蓝绿色，中部周围有白色或浅绿色带。求爱时，雄性会表现出增加的颜色强度。它需要一个 300 加仑或更大的水族箱，并有 4-6 英寸厚的沙层来将自己埋在其中。单个雄性可以与在雄性之前或同时引入的一组雌性一起饲养。双斑濑鱼会吃海胆、螃蟹、虾和小型无脊椎动物。它是一位出色的猎人，不会留下任何岩石转向（字面意思），寻找食物。双斑濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食品以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食品。

products.title: Teira Batfish
products.description: Also known as the Longfin Batfish, Longfin Platax, and Round-faced Batfish, the body and fins have wide vertical alternate bands of black and a pale yellow or tan. A relatively easy Batfish to keep, the Teira Batfish can grow to an impressive size of 24 inches, measuring from the tip of the dorsal to the tip of the anal fin. Not a good reef dweller, it will eat many types of sessile invertebrates including corals and anemones. The Teira needs a minimum of a 360 gallon tank with plenty of unobstructed room to swim. As with all Batfish, the Teira is susceptible to ich. A varied diet of meaty foods such as shrimp, scallops, vitamin-enriched brine shrimp and frozen herbivore preparations is recommended, and it is best to feed it three times a day. This species of Batfish can become very tame, sometimes feeding from its owner's fingers. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 2-1/2" to 3-1/2"; Medium: 3-1/2" to 5"; Large: 5" to 7"
products.description_zh: 也称为长鳍蝙蝠鱼、长鳍蝙蝠鱼和圆脸蝙蝠鱼，身体和鳍上有宽阔的垂直交替的黑色和浅黄色或棕褐色带。泰拉蝙蝠鱼是一种相对容易饲养的蝙蝠鱼，从背鳍顶端到臀鳍顶端测量，可以长到令人印象深刻的 24 英寸。它不是一个好的珊瑚礁居民，它会吃多种类型的固着无脊椎动物，包括珊瑚和海葵。 Teira 至少需要一个 360 加仑的水箱，并有足够的畅通无阻的游泳空间。与所有蝙蝠鱼一样，Teira 很容易感染白斑病。建议饮食多样化，包括虾、扇贝、富含维生素的丰年虾和冷冻草食动物制剂等肉类食品建议，最好一天喂3次。这种蝙蝠鱼会变得非常温顺，有时会从主人的手指上进食。大致购买尺寸：小号：2-1/2 英寸至 3-1/2 英寸；中号：3-1/2" 至 5"；大号：5 英寸至 7 英寸

products.title: Pinnatus Batfish -
products.description: Known by several names, including Red-Stripe, Pinnate, Shaded, Dusky, Red-Faced, Long-Finned or Red-Finned Batfish, the Pinnatus can reach up to 20 inches in length. Juveniles have a striking red border on their body and fins; however, this generally fades with adulthood. The body has alternating vertical bands of brown and a silver-tan. The Pinnatus Batfish is very difficult to maintain in an aquarium, often refusing to eat. The Pinnatus must be provided with a deep, 200 gallon tank and plenty of unobstructed room to swim. Unlike other batfish, the Pinnatus is very shy and needs numerous hiding places. Not a good reef dweller, it will eat many types of sessile invertebrates including corals and anemones. As with all Batfish, the Pinnatus is susceptible to ich. A varied diet of meaty foods such as shrimp, scallops, vitamin-enriched brine shrimp, and frozen herbivore preparations should be provided. The Pinnatus should be fed three times a day. Please Note: We guarantee that ALL aquatic life we offer will arrive alive and in good condition. However, because of the increased level of care required for this particular species, it has been designated as "Expert Only," (R) and we cannot
products.description_zh: 羽状蝙蝠鱼有多个名称，包括红条纹蝙蝠鱼、羽状蝙蝠鱼、阴影蝙蝠鱼、暗色蝙蝠鱼、红脸蝙蝠鱼、长鳍蝙蝠鱼或红鳍蝙蝠鱼，其长度可达 20 英寸。幼鱼的身体和鳍上有醒目的红色边框；然而，这种情况通常会随着成年而消失。身体有棕色和银棕色交替的垂直条纹。蝙蝠鱼在水族箱中很难饲养，经常拒绝进食。 Pinnatus 必须配备一个 200 加仑的深水箱和充足的无障碍游泳空间。与其他蝙蝠鱼不同，羽蝠非常害羞，需要许多藏身之处。不是一个好的珊瑚礁居民，它会吃许多类型的固着无脊椎动物，包括珊瑚和海葵。与所有蝙蝠鱼一样，羽蝠很容易感染白斑病。应提供多样化的肉类食物，如虾、扇贝、富含维生素的丰年虾和冷冻草食动物制剂。羽扇豆每天应喂食3次。请注意：我们保证我们提供的所有水生生物到达时都是活着且状况良好。然而，由于该特定物种所需的护理水平提高，它已被指定为“仅限专家”(R)，我们无法

products.title: Banded Longfin Basslet
products.description: The Banded Longfin Basslet originates from the reefs of the Indo-Pacific. They have an elongated, dark body with prominent vertical lines. The dorsal fin extends the entire length of the body and is highlighted in red. They make a great addition to the saltwater fish only or reef aquarium. The Banded Longfin Basslet does well in a saltwater aquarium of at least 30 gallons with plenty of live rock for hiding places and for supplemental nutrition. It will tend to swim in the open after it has become acclimated to its new environment. Only house one of this species per aquarium, unless the aquarium is very large, and they are acclimated at the same time. They will not bother invertebrates, and are a great fish for the reef aquarium. They may also help control bristleworm populations in the aquarium. The diet consists of meaty foods including; vitamin enriched brine and mysis shrimp, chopped fish and a quality flake food. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: Less than 1"; Medium: 1" to 1-1/2"; Large: 1-1/2" or larger
products.description_zh: 带状长鳍鲈起源于印度太平洋的珊瑚礁。它们的身体细长、深色，有明显的垂直线条。背鳍延伸到身体的整个长度，并以红色突出显示。它们对咸水鱼或珊瑚礁水族馆来说是一个很好的补充。带状长鳍鲈鱼在至少 30 加仑的咸水水族箱中表现良好，水族箱中有大量活石作为藏身之处和补充营养。当它适应了新环境后，它会倾向于在开阔的地方游泳。每个水族箱只能饲养一种这种物种，除非水族箱很大，并且它们同时适应环境。它们不会打扰无脊椎动物，并且是珊瑚礁水族馆的绝佳鱼类。它们还可以帮助控制水族箱中的刚毛虫数量。饮食包括肉类食物，包括：富含维生素的盐水虾和糠虾、切碎的鱼和优质片状食品。大致购买尺寸：小号：小于 1 英寸；中号：1 英寸至 1-1/2 英寸；大号：1-1/2 英寸或更大

products.title: Candy Cane Coral Indonesia
products.description: The Caulastrea Candy Cane Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as the Trumpet, Torch, Candy, or Bullseye Coral. Its genus name, Caulastrea , comes from the Latin kaulos (stalk), and aster (star) describing its skeletal structure consisting of tubular stalks with stars on each tip. The plump circular polyps are vibrant green, yellow, or blue and brown, with the Candy Cane Coral from Tonga being a brilliant translucent green to teal and brown, and each tip is white. Under actinic light its colorful polyps will stand out from most other corals. It is hardy and a relatively peaceful reef inhabitant, with very short sweeper tentacles. It requires moderate lighting and moderate water movement, along with the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: Caulastrea 糖蔗珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为喇叭珊瑚、火炬珊瑚、糖果珊瑚或牛眼珊瑚。它的属名 Caulastrea 源自拉丁语 kaulos（茎）和 aster（星星），描述其骨骼结构，由管状茎组成，每个尖端都有星星。丰满的圆形水螅体呈鲜艳的绿色、黄色或蓝色和棕色，来自汤加的糖蔗珊瑚呈明亮的半透明绿色到青色和棕色，每个尖端都是白色的。在光化光下，其色彩缤纷的水螅体将从大多数其他珊瑚中脱颖而出。它是一种耐寒且相对安静的珊瑚礁居民，具有非常短的清扫触角。它需要适度的照明和适度的水的运动，同时向水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Albino Glass Cleaner Plecostomus
products.description: Albino Glass Cleaner Plecostomus The Albino Glass Cleaner Plecostomus is a striking captive-bred color variety of the Common Pleco, Hypostomus plecostomus . Renowned for its exceptional algae-grazing abilities and peaceful temperament, this hardy armored catfish is a favorite among aquarists looking for both beauty and function in larger freshwater aquariums. Unlike the wild Common Pleco, which displays mottled shades of brown and tan, the Albino Glass Cleaner Plecostomus features a brilliant golden-yellow to creamy white body with light pinkish eyes. Its vibrant coloration stands out beautifully against plants, driftwood, and dark aquarium décor, making it an eye-catching addition while tirelessly helping to keep aquarium glass and surfaces free of algae. This species thrives in a well-established aquarium with excellent filtration, high oxygen levels, and moderate water movement. Driftwood, rocks, and caves provide ideal hiding places and mimic its natural habitat. As this fish can reach a substantial adult size, a minimum aquarium of 125 gallons is recommended for long-term care. The Albino Glass Cleaner Plecostomus is known to spawn in caves and protected crevices under the rig

Juveniles do start out lighter with hazy white shapes but as they mature the rich black and vibrant orange tones become more prevalent.

products.description: The Proaquatix Captive-Bred Super Storm comes from the Storm clownfish brood line. The resulting fish is white masked face and smooth, exaggerated connecting barring covering almost the whole body in white, with black margins are found on the edges of all fins and thin black lines bordering the white. Holes of color between the bars not connecting can be orange, mocha or black. Like all clownfish, Amphiprion ocellaris is a sequential hermaphrodite. The largest individual present will exert dominance and become reproductively female. The next largest fish will become reproductively male. Remaining smaller individuals are usually tolerated but will not be reproductively active. The Captive-Bred Proaquatix Super Storm Clownfish has unique advantages over wild-harvested species. For one, the Captive-Bred Ocellaris Clownfish is very hardy and more accustomed to conditions found in home aquariums. Therefore, it makes a great choice for novices and seasoned aquarists alike. products.description: You've never seen a captive-bred clownfish like this before! The Platinum Percula is a magnificent white variation of the Percula Clownfish, developed through years of selective breeding of the famous Clownfish. These striking fish do not exhibit the characteristic striping of the species. Instead, they are typically pure white from head to tail. As Platinums mature, they develop beautiful black fins that stand out against their white body and orange face. Amphiprion percula embodies true beauty. However, it is the famous symbiotic relationship between the Percula Clownfish and various anemones that truly captures the imagination of most aquarists. In the wild, Percula Clownfish are commonly associated with anemones such as Heteractis magnifica and Stichodactyla mertensii. Native to reefs across Oceania, the Indo-Pacific, and off the coast of Australia, the Percula Clownfish is also known as the Clown Anemonefish. In the wild, this member of the Pomacentridae family grows to about 4-1/2 inches, but captive specimens rarely exceed 3 inches in length. products.title: Black Longnose Tang 7"
products.description: The Black Longnose Tang, also known as the Longnose Sailfin Tang or the Longnose Surgeonfish, has a jet black oval body with blue pectoral fins, and an obvious white spot at the peduncle spines near the tail. A 180 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. It should be the only Tang in the community tank and should be the last fish added to the aquarium. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use.

products.description: The Coral Hogfish, also known as Eclipse Hogfish or Mesothorax Hogfish. Juveniles are burgundy with yellow spots and as they develop into adults they loose the spots and have a burgundy face with rosy-yellow posterior, separated by a black stripe. It is a beneficial fish for cleaning parasites off of its tank mates. The Coral Hogfish needs to be kept in a 70 gallon or larger fish-only tank, or the reef will become its buffet. It is aggressive towards smaller, docile fish that are easily bullied. The mature adult Coral Hogfish will eat snails, worms, mussels, small fish, shrimp, and squid.

These highly adaptable shrimp do well in any freshwater aquarium with good filtration and water quality. However, shrimp will thrive in planted aquariums where food and shelter are abundant. If there is a male and female in your aquarium shrimp will most likely breed. The female will carry a clutch of yellowish eggs under her tail until they hatch in about 30 days. The newly born shrimp will look like miniature adult shrimp and will eat the same thing as the adults. products.title: Tomato Clownfish 2.5"
products.description: The Tomato Clownfish, also known as the Bridled Clownfish or Red Clownfish, is found throughout the Pacific, almost always in association with an anemone such as Bubbletip Sea Anemone ( Entacmaea quadricolor ). The Tomato Clownfish has a wider distribution than the Fire Clown, which is usually restricted to the Indo-Pacific reefs. It has also been known to use coral as a host in the absence of an anemone. The Tomato Clownfish is a bright orange-red with one white vertical stripe behind the eyes. It can attain a length in the wild of 5 inches, but it usually reaches a maximum of 3.5 inches in an aquarium. The very hardy Tomato Clownfish can be housed with most fish that will not eat it and is a good choice for tank-cycling. It should not be housed with any shy or passive feeding fish, as the Tomato Clownfish tends to be somewhat territorial and aggressive with conspecifics and as it gets older. As with all clownfish, most are born as males, and the dominant male will change to a female. An aggressive eater, the Tomato Clownfish will consume most meaty foods and herbivore preparations.

products.title: Silver Scat
products.description: The Silver Scat fish is a popular brackish water aquarium fish that is native to the Indo-Pacific region also known as the Spotbanded Scat, Barred Scat, and Striped Butterfish. Silver Scat fish are a hardy schooling fish that should be kept in a minimum tank size of 125 gallons. When introducing a school of Silver Scat's it is best to introduce all individuals at the same time as they establish a hierarchical system. Silver Scats have a uniquely-shaped silver or dark body with black stripes and spots, as the fish matures many of these characteristics are lost. Silver Scats are opportunistic omnivores that require a varied diet in vegetable matter as they mature. As they mature their diet switches to a more herbivorous, favoring filamentous algae and plant material. Provide a varied diet that includes blanched spinach, kale and seaweed while also offering a variety of frozen foods such as brine shrimp, bloodworms, mysis shrimp or krill. If you are offering a pellet or flake food ensure it is rich in vegetable based ingredients. The dorsal and ventral fins of the Silver scat are venomous, if stung it is similar to a bee sting but more potent.
products.description_zh: 银鱼是一种流行的咸水观赏鱼，原产于印度太平洋地区，也称为斑带鱼、条纹鱼和条纹鲳鱼。银鲶鱼是一种耐寒的鱼群，应饲养在最小 125 加仑的水箱中。在介绍银星猫的学校时，最好同时介绍所有个体，因为他们建立了等级制度。银鱼的身体呈独特的银色或深色，带有黑色条纹和斑点，随着鱼的成熟，这些特征中的许多特征都会消失。银鲫鱼是机会主义的杂食动物，在成熟时需要多样化的植物性饮食。随着他们的饮食逐渐成熟更适合草食性，更喜欢丝状藻类和植物材料。提供多样化的饮食，包括焯水菠菜、羽衣甘蓝和海藻，同时还提供各种冷冻食品，如丰年虾、红虫、糠虾或磷虾。如果您提供颗粒或片状食品，请确保其富含蔬菜成分。银粪的背鳍和腹鳍有毒，如果被蛰的话，其效果类似于蜜蜂蜇，但威力更强。

products.description_zh: 红宝石鱼是一种流行的咸水观赏鱼，原产于印度太平洋地区。红宝石鱼是一种耐寒的鱼群，应饲养在最小 125 加仑的水箱中。在介绍红宝石鱼流派时，最好同时介绍所有个体，因为他们建立了等级制度。红宝石鱼具有形状独特的银色或深色身体，带有黑色条纹和不同程度的红色，随着鱼的成熟，许多这些特征都会消失。红宝石粪便是机会主义的杂食动物，在成熟时需要多样化的植物性饮食。随着它们的成熟，它们的饮食会转向更加草食性的、偏爱长丝的食物附着的藻类和植物材料。提供多样化的饮食，包括焯水菠菜、羽衣甘蓝和海藻，同时还提供各种冷冻食品，如丰年虾、红虫、糠虾或磷虾。如果您提供颗粒或片状食品，请确保其富含蔬菜成分。红宝石粪便的背鳍和腹鳍有毒，如果被蛰的话，其效果与蜜蜂蜇相似，但威力更强。

products.title: Snowflake Eel 9"
products.description: The Snowflake Eel, also known as the Snowflake Moray Eel, Clouded Moray, or Starry Moray, is one of the most beautiful morays, and inhabits caves and crevices throughout the Indo-Pacific reefs. In the wild, it can grow to 39 inches; most captive specimens will not exceed 24 inches. This is a very hardy eel, but an escape artist. A 50 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of live rock and a tightly fit canopy is ideal. Most of the eels that are lost in an aquarium are due to poorly sealed tanks. The Snowflake Eel is safe to house with any fish it cannot easily swallow. It can be housed with some invertebrates, like anemones and corals, but not crustaceans. The wild Snowflake Eel is a nocturnal predator, ambushing fish and crustaceans. In the tank, it will take frozen or freeze-dried krill, fish, shrimp, and most meaty foods. It can be taught to hand feed, although this should be done with caution, as it can inflict a painful bite.
products.description_zh: 雪花鳗鱼，也被称为雪花海鳗、云海鳗或星光海鳗，是最美丽的海鳗之一，栖息在整个印度太平洋珊瑚礁的洞穴和裂缝中。在野外，它可以长到39英寸；大多数圈养样本不会超过 24 英寸。这是一条非常顽强的鳗鱼，但却是一位逃脱艺术家。 50 加仑或更大的水族箱，有大量活石和紧密配合的天篷是理想的选择。水族箱中大部分鳗鱼的损失都是由于水箱密封不良造成的。雪花鳗鱼可以安全地与任何无法轻易吞咽的鱼一起饲养。它可以与一些无脊椎动物一起生活，例如海葵和珊瑚，但不能与甲壳类动物一起生活。野生雪花鳗是夜行动物l 捕食者，伏击鱼类和甲壳类动物。在水箱中，它会盛放冷冻或冻干的磷虾、鱼、虾和大多数肉类食物。可以教它用手喂食，尽管这应该小心谨慎，因为它可能会造成痛苦的咬伤。

products.title: Giant Angler 3"
products.description: The Giant Angler Fish is a member of the Antennariidae family. They are mainly white in color with brown or black irregular markings. Anglers can alter their coloration, which helps them in blending into their surroundings. They received their name from the fleshy appendage on their nose, which they use to lure prey within their reach. These are very interesting fish that should not be housed with fish or invertebrates that are small enough to fit into their mouth. A good reef dweller, the Giant Angler Fish enjoys perching on coral ledges and requires an aquarium of at least 20 gallons. The Giant Angler Fish feeds by ambush, lying in wait for an unsuspecting fish or crustacean to go by and then lunging forward, grabbing and swallowing the victim whole. These Angler Fish has been known to devour fish nearly equal to its own size. When first introduced into the aquarium, live saltwater feeder shrimp should be used to entice this fish to eat. A diet of feeder fish and shrimp should be provided. Do not overfeed, as the Giant Angler Fish may stop eating.
products.description_zh: 巨型琵琶鱼是触角鱼科的成员。它们的颜色主要是白色，带有棕色或黑色的不规则斑纹。钓鱼者可以改变它们的颜色，这有助于它们融入周围的环境。它们因鼻子上的肉质附属物而得名，它们用它来引诱猎物进入它们的范围。这些是非常有趣的鱼，不应该与小到可以放进嘴里的鱼或无脊椎动物一起饲养。巨型琵琶鱼是良好的珊瑚礁居民，喜欢栖息在珊瑚礁上，需要至少 20 加仑的水族箱。巨型琵琶鱼通过伏击进食，等待毫无戒心的鱼类或甲壳类动物经过并袭击它们。母鸡向前猛扑，抓住并整个吞下受害者。众所周知，这些琵琶鱼会吞食几乎与自身大小相同的鱼。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活的咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。应提供饲料鱼和虾的饮食。不要喂得过多，因为巨型琵琶鱼可能会停止进食。

products.title: Lieutenant Tang
products.description: The Lieutenant Tang is also known as the Doubleband Surgeonfish. Known for the two dark, curved bands behind its gills. The tail takes on a lyre shape. A 180 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. It is not aggressive towards other Tangs. If housing more than one, it is best to add a juvenile to the aquarium that contains an adult. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use. Approximate Purchase Size : Small: 1" to 2"; Small/Medium: 2" to 3"; Medium: 3" to 4-1/2"; Medium/Large: 4-1/2" to 5 1/2"; Large: 5 1/2" to 7"; X-Large: 7" to 9"
products.description_zh: 唐中尉也被称为双带刺尾鱼。以其鳃后面的两条黑色弯曲带而闻名。尾巴呈七弦琴形状。需要 180 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳空间。它对其他唐族没有攻击性。如果饲养不止一只，最好在有成年鱼的水族箱中添加一只幼鱼。虽然唐鱼和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。提供绑在岩石上的干海藻或使用蔬菜夹，并喂至少 3 个每周几次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。大约购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；小/中：2 英寸至 3 英寸；中号：3" 至 4-1/2"；中/大号：4-1/2" 至 5 1/2"；大号：5 1/2" 至 7"； XL：7 英寸至 9 英寸

products.title: Dusky Tilefish
products.description: The Dusky Tilefish is also known as the Pastel Tilefish, and Bluehead Tilefish. The head of this fish is blue, and the body a pale yellow. A hardy fish, it needs a tank of at least 50 gallons with at least 3 inches of mixed substrate for burrowing, and a tight-fitting lid to prevent escape. It prefers to associate with members of its own species as tank mates and needs a lot of swimming room for its very active lifestyle. A diet providing a variety of marine fish, crustacean flesh, and mysis or brine shrimp will give the Dusky Tilefish the nutrition it needs when fed three times per day.
products.description_zh: 暗色方头鱼也称为粉彩方头鱼和蓝头方头鱼。这条鱼的头是蓝色的，身体是淡黄色的。作为一种耐寒的鱼，它需要一个至少 50 加仑的水箱，其中至少有 3 英寸的混合基质用于挖洞，以及一个严密的盖子以防止逃跑。它更喜欢与自己物种的成员作为坦克伙伴交往，并且需要大量的游泳池来适应其非常活跃的生活方式。每天喂食三次的暗色方头鱼，其饮食中含有各种海鱼、甲壳类动物的肉、糠虾或丰年虾，即可为暗色方头鱼提供所需的营养。

products.title: White Cap Goby
products.description: The White Cap Goby is prized for its unusual and beautiful, stark coloration. Its body is a black color, but it is the thick white band on it's head, that place Lotilia graciliosa in a class of elegance wholly its own. Native to the relatively shallow reefs , wild specimens of the White Cap Goby inhabit open sand areas dotted with rubble near the base of reef structures. In the home aquarium, the White Cap Goby does best when housed in similar habitats. Like other Shrimp Gobies in the Gobiidae family, the White Cap Goby digs shallow burrows in sandy substrate and seldom strays far from its claimed territory. Instead, most prefer to perch on the sand just outside or hover in the water column directly above the burrow entrance. While poised outside its burrow, the White Cap Goby keeps a watchful eye for both predators and prey. If a larger or aggressive fish approaches, the White Cap Goby will dart back into its burrow to hide. If prey is found floating in the water column, however, Lotilia graciliosa will quickly burst upwards and snatch it before returning almost directly to the mouth of its burrow. products.description_zh: 白冠虾虎鱼因其不寻常、美丽、鲜明的颜色而备受推崇。它的身体是黑色的，但它头上有一条厚厚的白色带子，使 Lotilia graciliosa 具有一种完全属于它自己的优雅。白帽虾虎鱼原产于相对较浅的珊瑚礁，野生的白冠虾虎鱼栖息在珊瑚礁结构底部附近散布着碎石的开阔沙地。在家庭水族箱中，白冠虾虎鱼在相似的栖息地中表现最好。与戈壁科中的其他虾虎鱼一样，白帽虾虎鱼在沙质基质中挖掘浅洞，很少远离其声称的领地。相反，大多数人更喜欢栖息在外面的沙子上或悬停在水柱中就在洞穴入口的正上方。当白冠虾虎鱼在洞穴外保持平衡时，它会密切关注捕食者和猎物。如果有更大或更具攻击性的鱼靠近，白冠虾虎鱼就会飞回洞穴隐藏起来。然而，如果发现猎物漂浮在水柱中，Lotilia graciliosa 会迅速向上爆发并抓住它，然后几乎直接返回其洞穴口。白帽虾虎鱼与其他虾虎鱼共有的另一个特征是

products.title: Flower Pot Coral, Red 2.25"
products.description: The Red Flower Pot Coral is a showy sculptural variety of Goniopora coral commonly known as the Daisy Coral, Ball Coral, or Sunflower Coral due to its lovely floral appearance when all of the polyps are opened. As its name implies, the Red Flower Pot Coral has elongated polyps that give it a full, bushy appearance. The Red Flower Pot Coral is sure to introduce fantastic visual interest full of beautiful color and architecture to your reef aquarium landscape. Caring for the Red Flower Pot Coral is moderately difficult and as such, it is generally not recommended for the novice or beginning reef aquarist. The Red Flower Pot Coral should be housed in an established reef aquarium with high water quality. In the wild, Goniopora corals are often found in nutrient-rich shallows near the shore or in lagoons with turbid water conditions. To best replicate these conditions, the Red Flower Pot Coral requires moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or more intense metal halide light fixtures combined with medium water movement within the aquarium. products.title: Red and Green War Coral 4.5"
products.description: The Red and Green Favites War Coral injects an impressive burst of color sure to command attention in any reef aquarium. The Red and Green Favites War Coral represents a new generation of exotic color varieties that is transforming the reef hobby. The deep red coloration sets off the green eyes to dramatic effect sure to put any avid coral collector on a warpath to obtain this beauty. The Red and Green Favites War Coral is an exceptional color variety of Favites , a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as Moon, Pineapple, Brain, Closed Brain, Star, Worm, or Honeycomb Coral. Favites are the most common and prolific corals in the world and often share the same common names with their close relative, the corals from the genus Favia . Though very similar in appearance, the easiest way to distinguish corals from the Genus Favites from corals from the Genus Favia is to examine the corallites. The individual corallites of Favites corals share common walls that create a honeycomb appearance. products.title: Elegance Coral 4.5"
products.description: The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) often referred to as Elegant Coral, Wonder Coral, or Ridge Coral. It is truly the most unique and interesting stony coral known. Its polyps are extended during the day showing off its vast array of color-tipped tentacles. Under actinic lighting, the fluorescent qualities are beautiful with lime green, blue, orange, or purple-tipped tentacles which vary between branched or round and bulbous shapes. The most common color variety available to aquarists is gold with pink or purple-tipped polyps. The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is moderate to maintain in the reef aquarium and makes an excellent choice for the beginner to expert hobbyist. Provide ample space in the aquarium between it and other neighboring corals as it will expand to twice its usual size during the day and will sting other corals in close proximity to it. It is best to place the skeleton of the coral into a soft substrate. The soft substrate is less likely to irritate the fleshy underside of the coral when compared to the rockwork.
