products.description_zh: Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS)，通常被称为优雅珊瑚、神奇珊瑚或山脊珊瑚。它确实是已知的最独特、最有趣的石珊瑚。它的水螅体在白天会伸展开来，展示出大量的彩色触须。在光化照明下，荧光品质非常美丽，具有柠檬绿、蓝色、橙色或紫色尖端的触手，形状在分支、圆形和球状之间变化。水族爱好者最常见的颜色是金色，带有粉红色或紫色尖端的水螅体。 Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚在珊瑚礁水族箱中的养护效果适中，是初学者到专家爱好者的绝佳选择英石。在水族箱中为它和其他邻近的珊瑚之间提供足够的空间，因为它在白天会膨胀到平时大小的两倍，并会刺伤靠近它的其他珊瑚。最好将珊瑚的骨架放置在柔软的基质中。与岩石相比，柔软的基质不太可能刺激珊瑚的肉质底部。如果没有海葵存在，小丑鱼可能会接受这种珊瑚作为其宿主。处理时请小心，因为它非常脆弱，可能会损坏

products.title: Bubble Coral 4.5"
products.description: The Bubble Coral is a beautiful LPS coral that originates from the reefs of the Indo-Pacific. It has a green or white-ridged hard skeleton that can be seen when the polyps are deflated. When inflated, the large fleshy polyps will cover the entire skeleton, and are green, white or yellowish in color. Like many other LPS corals, they do posses sweeper tentacles that can harm other corals within reach. The Bubble Coral requires a moderate level of lighting combined with low to moderate water movement in the aquarium. Too much water flow may impede the coral from fully expanding. The fleshy polyps of Bubble Corals are very fragile and will puncture easily. Be careful when handling these corals, to only handle them by the hard skeleton. Because they can form long sweeper tentacles, be sure to provide plenty of room to prevent damage being done to its neighbors. For continued good health, it will also need the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: 气泡珊瑚是一种美丽的 LPS 珊瑚，起源于印度太平洋的珊瑚礁。它有一个绿色或白色脊状的硬骨架，当息肉缩小时可以看到。膨胀后，大的肉质息肉会覆盖整个骨骼，颜色为绿色、白色或淡黄色。与许多其他 LPS 珊瑚一样，它们确实拥有清洁触手，可以伤害触手可及的其他珊瑚。气泡珊瑚需要中等水平的照明以及水族箱中低至中等的水流运动。过多的水流可能会阻碍珊瑚充分扩张。气泡珊瑚的肉质息肉非常脆弱，很容易被刺破。处理这些珊瑚时要小心，只能用坚硬的骨架来对付它们。因为它们可以形成长长的清扫触手，所以一定要提供足够的空间，以防止对其邻居造成伤害。为了持续保持健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.description: The Tiger Mosaic Cobra Male Guppy is a spectacular selectively bred variety of Poecilia reticulata admired for its vivid coloration and intricate patterning. Its active personality, peaceful nature, and exceptional beauty make it an outstanding addition to freshwater community aquariums. The Tiger Mosaic Cobra Male Guppy requires an aquarium of at least 10 gallons and thrives in a well-maintained environment with stable water parameters. Guppies are prolific livebearers and are among the easiest freshwater fish to breed. products.title: Black Balloon Molly
products.description: The Black Balloon Molly, Poecilia sphenops , is a selectively bred variety of the Common Molly prized for its rounded body shape and velvety black coloration. Peaceful, hardy, and active, this attractive livebearer is an excellent choice for both beginning and experienced aquarists. It adapts well to a wide range of water conditions and can be maintained in freshwater or lightly brackish aquariums. The Black Balloon Molly requires an aquarium of at least 20 gallons with plenty of open swimming space and hardy plants. Dense vegetation provides shelter for fry and complements the fish's natural behavior. Peaceful in temperament, the Black Balloon Molly is an ideal addition to a community aquarium with other non-aggressive fish of similar size. Male Black Balloon Mollies are smaller than females and are distinguished by their modified anal fin, called a gonopodium. Females are larger with a rounded anal fin and fuller body. As livebearers, females produce fully formed, free-swimming fry approximately every 4 to 6 weeks. Providing floating plants or dense vegetation will improve fry survival. products.title: Blackberry Silver Dollar
products.description: The Blackberry Silver Dollar, Myleus schomburgkii , is a stunning South American characin known for its deep, rounded body shape and shimmering silver coloration accented with dark black markings that develop more prominently as the fish matures. Growing larger than many other silver dollar species, this active and hardy fish is an excellent choice for experienced aquarists with a large community aquarium. The Blackberry Silver Dollar requires an aquarium of at least 180 gallons with ample swimming space and strong filtration to accommodate its adult size and active nature. This peaceful schooling fish should be kept in groups of five or more to help reduce stress and encourage natural behavior. Driftwood, rocks, and hardy plants can be used to replicate its natural environment, though soft-leaved plants may be consumed due to its herbivorous diet. They thrive in soft to moderately acidic water with excellent filtration and stable water conditions. The Blackberry Silver Dollar may occasionally breed in the aquarium environment. products.title: Cobalt Ice Blue Cichlid
products.description: The Cobalt Ice Blue Cichlid, Maylandia callainos , comes from the rocky shorelines of Lake Malawi, Africa. Both males and females display a brilliant icy blue to cobalt blue coloration, although males are generally larger and exhibit more intense coloration, especially during breeding. The Cobalt Ice Blue Cichlid does well in an aquarium that is at least 50 gallons with plenty of rocks to establish territories and a sandy substrate. As a typical mbuna, this species is territorial and can be aggressive toward other fish with similar coloration or body shape. It is best maintained in a ratio of three to four females for every male to help reduce aggression and encourage natural behavior. The male Cobalt Ice Blue Cichlid's coloration becomes more vibrant during breeding as he establishes and defends a spawning territory. The female is a maternal mouthbrooder, collecting the fertilized eggs in her mouth where they incubate for approximately three weeks before she releases free-swimming fry. Newly hatched brine shrimp and finely crushed flake or cichlid foods are excellent first foods for the young. The Cobalt Ice Blue Cichlid should be fed a diet consisting primarily of vegetable-based

products.title: Lemon Cichlid
products.description: The Lemon Cichlid, Neolamprologus leleupi , is a brilliantly colored African cichlid native to the rocky shorelines of Lake Tanganyika. Its vibrant yellow to deep orange coloration makes it one of the most recognizable Tanganyikan cichlids. Both males and females display similar coloration, although males are typically slightly larger and develop more pointed dorsal and anal fins. An aquarium of at least 30 gallons is recommended for a single pair, while larger aquariums are ideal for communities of Lake Tanganyika cichlids. Provide plenty of rockwork arranged to create caves and crevices, as these fish establish territories and seek shelter among the rocks. A sandy or fine gravel substrate closely replicates their natural habitat. Although generally peaceful toward similarly sized Tanganyikan species, the Lemon Cichlid becomes territorial during breeding and should not be housed with overly aggressive tankmates. The Lemon Cichlid is a cave-spawning species that forms monogamous breeding pairs. Eggs are deposited on the walls or ceiling of a secluded cave, where the female guards and fans the eggs while the male protects the surrounding territory. The eggs hatch in approximately 2
products.description_zh: 柠檬丽鱼科鱼（Neolamprologus leleupi）是一种色彩鲜艳的非洲丽鱼科鱼，原产于坦噶尼喀湖的岩石海岸线。其鲜艳的黄色到深橙色使其成为最知名的坦噶尼喀慈鲷之一。雄性和雌性都表现出相似的颜色，尽管雄性通常稍大一些，并且背鳍和臀鳍更尖。建议一对鱼使用至少 30 加仑的水族箱，而较大的水族箱则适合坦噶尼喀湖慈鲷群落。提供大量的岩石结构来形成洞穴和裂缝，因为这些鱼会建立领地并在岩石中寻求庇护。沙质或细砾石基质紧密地复制了它们的自然栖息地。虽然柠檬慈鲷对体型相似的坦噶尼喀物种通常很和平，但在繁殖过程中会变得有领地意识，不应该与过于攻击性的同伴一起生活。柠檬慈鲷是一种洞穴产卵物种，形成一夫一妻制的繁殖对。卵产在僻静洞穴的墙壁或天花板上，雌性守卫并扇动卵，而雄性则保护周围的领地。卵大约 2 小时内孵化

products.title: Elegance Coral 5"
products.description: The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) often referred to as Elegant Coral, Wonder Coral, or Ridge Coral. It is truly the most unique and interesting stony coral known. Its polyps are extended during the day showing off its vast array of color-tipped tentacles. Under actinic lighting, the fluorescent qualities are beautiful with lime green, blue, orange, or purple-tipped tentacles which vary between branched or round and bulbous shapes. The most common color variety available to aquarists is gold with pink or purple-tipped polyps. The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is moderate to maintain in the reef aquarium and makes an excellent choice for the beginner to expert hobbyist. Provide ample space in the aquarium between it and other neighboring corals as it will expand to twice its usual size during the day and will sting other corals in close proximity to it. It is best to place the skeleton of the coral into a soft substrate. The soft substrate is less likely to irritate the fleshy underside of the coral when compared to the rockwork. Clownfish may accept this coral as its host if no anemone is present. Use caution when handling, as it is very fragile and can al
products.description_zh: Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS)，通常被称为优雅珊瑚、神奇珊瑚或山脊珊瑚。它确实是已知的最独特、最有趣的石珊瑚。它的水螅体在白天会伸展开来，展示出大量的彩色触须。在光化照明下，荧光品质非常美丽，具有柠檬绿、蓝色、橙色或紫色尖端的触手，形状在分支、圆形和球状之间变化。水族爱好者最常见的颜色是金色，带有粉红色或紫色尖端的水螅体。 Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚在珊瑚礁水族箱中的养护效果适中，是初学者到专家爱好者的绝佳选择英石。在水族箱中为它和其他邻近的珊瑚之间提供足够的空间，因为它在白天会膨胀到平时大小的两倍，并会刺伤靠近它的其他珊瑚。最好将珊瑚的骨架放置在柔软的基质中。与岩石相比，柔软的基质不太可能刺激珊瑚的肉质底部。如果没有海葵存在，小丑鱼可能会接受这种珊瑚作为其宿主。处理时请小心，因为它非常脆弱，可能会损坏

products.title: Blastomussa Coral Indonesia 3.5"
products.description: The Blastomussa Coral is also referred to as a Pineapple or Branched Cup coral. They can be confused with the Candy Cane coral ( Caulastrea sp. ), but has a more compact and a more dome-like appearance. The neon green centers of this species will glow under actinic lighting, adding further appeal to your reef aquarium. The Blastomussa Coral does well in an established reef aquarium being a moderately hardy coral. A low water current combined with a moderate light level will make a wonderful home for this species. It is not aggressive, and does not contain long sweeper tentacles, so it may be placed in close proximity to other peaceful corals or invertebrates. It benefits from the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Its body contains the symbiotic algae zooxanthellae from which it receives the majority of its nutritional requirements through photosynthesis. It does not require additional food to maintain its health in the reef aquarium, but it will feed on zooplankton or foods designed for filter feeding invertebrates.
products.description_zh: 芽生珊瑚也称为菠萝珊瑚或分支杯珊瑚。它们可能与甘蔗珊瑚（Caulastrea sp.）混淆，但它们具有更紧凑且更像圆顶的外观。该物种的霓虹绿色中心会在光化照明下发光，为您的珊瑚礁水族箱增添更多吸引力。芽生珊瑚是一种中等耐寒的珊瑚，在成熟的珊瑚礁水族馆中表现良好。低水流和适度的光照水平将为该物种创造一个美好的家园。它不具有攻击性，并且不包含长的清扫触手，因此可以将其放置在靠近其他和平珊瑚或无脊椎动物的地方。它受益于添加水中的钙、锶等微量元素。它的身体含有共生藻类虫黄藻，通过光合作用从中获得大部分营养需求。它不需要额外的食物来维持其在珊瑚礁水族箱中的健康，但它会以浮游动物或专为滤食无脊椎动物设计的食物为食。

products.title: Alveopora Coral 3"
products.description: The Alveopora Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral also referred to as the Alveopora Daisy, Flowerpot, Sunflower, or Ball Coral. The flower references are due to its appearance when all of its polyps are open. It then takes on the visage of a bouquet of flowers. It has 12 tentacles on each polyp and is often green; when displayed under actinic lighting, it will glow. It is not an overly aggressive coral, but space should still be provided between itself and other corals. Its polyps can extend far past its base into the reef aquarium, where it can sting other species of corals. Clownfish are in direct association with the Alveopora Coral and will often play in its polyps if no anemone can be found in the reef aquarium. Being easier to care for than Goniopora , any of the Alveopora species make a good alternate for the novice reef aquarist, who is seeking a coral similar to the hard to maintain Goniopora . The Alveopora Coral requires low to moderate lighting combined with low water movement. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The diet of this coral should consist of micro-plankton or brine sh
products.description_zh: Alveopora 珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，也称为 Alveopora 雏菊、花盆、向日葵或球珊瑚。花的参考是由于它的所有息肉都打开时的外观。然后它呈现出一束鲜花的面貌。每个水螅体上有 12 条触手，通常是绿色的；当在光化照明下显示时，它会发光。它不是一种过度攻击性的珊瑚，但仍应在其与其他珊瑚之间提供空间。它的水螅体可以延伸到珊瑚礁水族馆的底部，在那里它可以蜇其他种类的珊瑚。小丑鱼与 Alveopora 珊瑚有直接关系，如果没有海葵，它们经常会在珊瑚虫中玩耍。可以在珊瑚礁水族馆中找到。与 Goniopora 相比，任何一种 Alveopora 物种都比 Goniopora 更容易照顾，对于那些正在寻找与难以维护的 Goniopora 类似的珊瑚的新手珊瑚礁养殖者来说，这是一个很好的替代品。 Alveopora Coral 需要低至中等的光照和低水流。为了持续保持身体健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。这种珊瑚的饮食应该包括微型浮游生物或盐水鱼

products.title: Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral 3.25"
products.description: This eye-catching color variety exhibits a bold autumn color palette featuring rust-red tentacles and bronze-orange "eyes." The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral offers reef aquarium hobbyists a fantastic coral sure to inject incredible visual interest to any reef aquarium landscape thanks to its encrusting growth habit and vibrant coloration. The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral can thrive under moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or the more intense metal halide light fixtures. For best care, it is imperative to maintain high water quality for the Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral ensuring proper pH, alkalinity, and calcium levels while keeping phosphate and nitrate levels as close to zero as possible. Along with proper lighting and water quality, the Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral will thrive when provided medium, intermittent water flow within the aquarium. This can be easily achieved with the addition of powerheads, wavemakers, or water circulation pumps. The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral is aggressive in temperament and will expand its sweeper tentacles at night well beyond the base. It is important to leave space between the Orange Eye Leptastrea and neighbors
products.description_zh: 这种引人注目的颜色品种展现了大胆的秋季调色板，具有铁锈红色的触手和古铜橙色的“眼睛”。橙眼细珊瑚为珊瑚礁水族馆爱好者提供了一种梦幻般的珊瑚，由于其坚硬的生长习性和鲜艳的色彩，一定能为任何珊瑚礁水族馆景观注入令人难以置信的视觉兴趣。橙眼细珊瑚可以在 T-5 荧光灯、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物灯具实现的适度照明条件下茁壮成长。为了获得最佳护理，必须保持橙眼细珊瑚的高水质，确保适当的 pH 值、碱度和钙水平，同时保持磷酸盐和硝酸盐水平尽可能接近于零。除了适当的照明和水质外，当水族箱内提供中等、间歇性的水流时，橙眼细珊瑚会茁壮成长。通过添加动力头、造波器或水循环泵可以轻松实现这一点。橙眼细珊瑚的性情非常好斗，在夜间会将其清扫触手伸到底部以外的地方。在橙眼 Leptastrea 和邻居之间留出空间很重要

products.title: Red and Green War Coral 5.25"
products.description: The Red and Green Favites War Coral injects an impressive burst of color sure to command attention in any reef aquarium. The Red and Green Favites War Coral represents a new generation of exotic color varieties that is transforming the reef hobby. The deep red coloration sets off the green eyes to dramatic effect sure to put any avid coral collector on a warpath to obtain this beauty. The Red and Green Favites War Coral is an exceptional color variety of Favites , a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as Moon, Pineapple, Brain, Closed Brain, Star, Worm, or Honeycomb Coral. Favites are the most common and prolific corals in the world and often share the same common names with their close relative, the corals from the genus Favia . Though very similar in appearance, the easiest way to distinguish corals from the Genus Favites from corals from the Genus Favia is to examine the corallites. The individual corallites of Favites corals share common walls that create a honeycomb appearance. In addition, the corallite walls of Favites corals are generally more raised and tend to be more uneven, accentuating the geometric appearance of the Favites corals. The Red and Green Favite
products.description_zh: 红色和绿色的最爱战珊瑚注入令人印象深刻的色彩，肯定会在任何珊瑚礁水族馆中引起注意。最喜欢的红色和绿色战珊瑚代表了新一代的异国色彩品种，正在改变人们对珊瑚礁的爱好。深红色的颜色衬托出绿色的眼睛，产生戏剧性的效果，肯定会让任何狂热的珊瑚收藏家为获得这种美丽而战。红色和绿色最爱战珊瑚是最爱颜色的特殊品种，是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为月珊瑚、菠萝珊瑚、脑珊瑚、闭脑珊瑚、星珊瑚、蠕虫珊瑚或蜂窝珊瑚。最喜欢的珊瑚是世界上最常见和最多产的珊瑚，并且通常与它们具有相同的通用名称其近亲是蚕豆属珊瑚。虽然外观非常相似，但区分最爱属珊瑚和蚕豆属珊瑚的最简单方法是检查珊瑚。 Favites 珊瑚的各个珊瑚体共享共同的壁，形成蜂窝状外观。此外，Favites 珊瑚的珊瑚壁通常更加凸起，并且往往更加不平坦，突出了 Favites 珊瑚的几何外观。最喜欢的红色和绿色

products.title: Flower Pot Coral, Metallic Green 5"
products.description: The Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is an exquisite color variety of Goniopora coral commonly known as the Daisy Coral, Ball Coral, or Sunflower Coral due to its lovely floral appearance when all of the polyps are opened. The soothing green coloration of the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is sure to introduce an unexpected pop of color without overwhelming the design of your reef aquarium landscape. Caring for the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is moderately difficult and as such, it is generally not recommended for the novice or beginning reef aquarist. The Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral should be housed in an established reef aquarium with high water quality. In the wild, Goniopora corals are often found in nutrient-rich shallows near the shore or in lagoons with turbid water conditions. To best replicate these conditions, the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral requires moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or more intense metal halide light fixtures combined with medium water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral will benefit from the addition of calcium, strontium, iodine, magnesium and tra
products.description_zh: 金属绿色花盆珊瑚是一种精致的颜色的 Goniopora 珊瑚品种，通常被称为雏菊珊瑚、球珊瑚或向日葵珊瑚，因为当所有珊瑚虫都打开时，它会呈现出可爱的花朵外观。金属绿色花盆珊瑚的舒缓绿色一定会带来意想不到的流行色彩，而不会压倒您的珊瑚礁水族馆景观的设计。照顾金属绿色花盆珊瑚是相当困难的，因此，通常不建议新手或刚开始的珊瑚礁水族爱好者这样做。金属绿色花盆珊瑚应饲养在水质良好的成熟礁石水族箱中。在野外，Goniopora cora它们经常出现在海岸附近营养丰富的浅滩或水质浑浊的泻湖中。为了最好地复制这些条件，金属绿色花盆珊瑚需要通过 T-5 荧光灯、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物灯具结合水族箱内中等水流来实现适度的照明条件。为了持续保持身体健康，金属绿花盆珊瑚将受益于钙、锶、碘、镁和特拉的添加。

products.title: Xanthurus Cream Angelfish 3.5"
products.description: The Xanthurus Cream Angelfish is also referred to as the Indian Yellowtail Angelfish, Cream Angelfish, or Yellowtail Black Angelfish. True to its Latin name, the caudal fin is yellow. The dorsal fin is outlined with a silvery-white line. The Xanthurus Cream Angelfish adapts readily to aquarium life. It requires a minimum of a 125 gallon tank or larger with lots of hiding places and live rock for grazing will offer an environment in which to thrive. It is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles. Only one specimen should be kept per tank. It is hermaphroditic, and there are no distinguishing features which differentiate males from females. As with other angelfish, the diet should include Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, mysis or frozen shrimp, and other meaty items.
products.description_zh: Xanthurus 奶油神仙鱼也称为印度黄尾神仙鱼、奶油神仙鱼或黄尾黑神仙鱼。顾名思义，尾鳍是黄色的。背鳍有银白色线勾勒。 Xanthurus 奶油神仙鱼很容易适应水族箱的生活​​。它至少需要一个 125 加仑或更大的水箱，并有许多藏身之处和可供放牧的活石，将为它提供一个茁壮成长的环境。它很容易咬食石珊瑚、软珊瑚（无柄无脊椎动物）和蛤蜊外套膜。每个水箱只能保留一个样本。它是雌雄同体，没有区分男性和女性的区别特征。与其他一个神仙鱼的饮食应包括螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、糠虾或冷冻虾以及其他肉类食品。

products.title: Green Polyp Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral 2.75"
products.description: The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral is referred to as Sarcophyton Coral, Mushroom, Leather, or Trough Corals. They are found in various shades of brown, tan or green, with white or gold polyps. It is difficult to identify many species because they all have the similar appearance of a mushroom or toadstool, each with a distinct stalk and capitulum (cap). As they grow older, they develop a folded appearance. The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals are relatively peaceful, but adequate space should be provided between them and other corals in the reef aquarium. Some can produce toxins which are harmful to other reef inhabitants. The brown Sarcophyton Leather Corals from Idonesia and Tonga are easy to maintain in the reef aquarium and make an excellent coral for the beginning through expert reef aquarist. Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals require medium to high lighting combined with medium to strong water movement. For continued good health, they will also require the addition of iodine, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Culturing by the experienced hobbyist is often accomplished by cutting off a portion of the Coral's crown and attaching that piece to live rock or plac
products.description_zh: 毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚被称为肉藻珊瑚、蘑菇、皮革或槽珊瑚。它们呈各种深浅的棕色、棕褐色或绿色，有白色或金色的息肉。许多物种很难识别，因为它们都具有蘑菇或伞菌的相似外观，每种都有独特的茎和头状花序（帽子）。随着年龄的增长，它们会出现折叠的外观。伞菌皮珊瑚相对安静，但它们与珊瑚礁水族箱中的其他珊瑚之间应提供足够的空间。有些会产生对其他珊瑚礁居民有害的毒素。来自印度尼西亚和汤加的棕色肉藻皮珊瑚很常见sy 在珊瑚礁水族箱中进行维护，并通过专家珊瑚礁水族箱开始制作优质珊瑚。毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚需要中到高的光照以及中到强的水流。为了持续保持身体健康，他们还需要在水中添加碘、锶和其他微量元素。经验丰富的爱好者通常通过切下珊瑚冠的一部分并将其固定在活石或陆地上来完成培养

products.title: Candy Cane Coral 1.5"
products.description: The Caulastrea Candy Cane Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as the Trumpet, Torch, Candy, or Bullseye Coral. Its genus name, Caulastrea , comes from the Latin kaulos (stalk), and aster (star) describing its skeletal structure consisting of tubular stalks with stars on each tip. The plump circular polyps are vibrant green, yellow, or blue and brown, with the Candy Cane Coral from Tonga being a brilliant translucent green to teal and brown, and each tip is white. Under actinic light its colorful polyps will stand out from most other corals. It is hardy and a relatively peaceful reef inhabitant, with very short sweeper tentacles. It requires moderate lighting and moderate water movement, along with the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: Caulastrea 糖蔗珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为喇叭珊瑚、火炬珊瑚、糖果珊瑚或牛眼珊瑚。它的属名 Caulastrea 源自拉丁语 kaulos（茎）和 aster（星星），描述其骨骼结构，由管状茎组成，每个尖端都有星星。丰满的圆形水螅体呈鲜艳的绿色、黄色或蓝色和棕色，来自汤加的糖蔗珊瑚呈明亮的半透明绿色到青色和棕色，每个尖端都是白色的。在光化光下，其色彩缤纷的水螅体将从大多数其他珊瑚中脱颖而出。它是一种耐寒且相对安静的珊瑚礁居民，具有非常短的清扫触手。它需要适度的照明和适度的水的运动，同时向水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Elegance Coral 4"
products.description: The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) often referred to as Elegant Coral, Wonder Coral, or Ridge Coral. It is truly the most unique and interesting stony coral known. Its polyps are extended during the day showing off its vast array of color-tipped tentacles. Under actinic lighting, the fluorescent qualities are beautiful with lime green, blue, orange, or purple-tipped tentacles which vary between branched or round and bulbous shapes. The most common color variety available to aquarists is gold with pink or purple-tipped polyps. The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is moderate to maintain in the reef aquarium and makes an excellent choice for the beginner to expert hobbyist. Provide ample space in the aquarium between it and other neighboring corals as it will expand to twice its usual size during the day and will sting other corals in close proximity to it. It is best to place the skeleton of the coral into a soft substrate. The soft substrate is less likely to irritate the fleshy underside of the coral when compared to the rockwork. Clownfish may accept this coral as its host if no anemone is present. Use caution when handling, as it is very fragile and can al
products.description_zh: Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS)，通常被称为优雅珊瑚、神奇珊瑚或山脊珊瑚。它确实是已知的最独特、最有趣的石珊瑚。它的水螅体在白天会伸展开来，展示出大量的彩色触须。在光化照明下，荧光品质非常美丽，具有柠檬绿、蓝色、橙色或紫色尖端的触手，形状在分支、圆形和球状之间变化。水族爱好者最常见的颜色是金色，带有粉红色或紫色尖端的水螅体。 Catalaphyllia 优雅珊瑚在珊瑚礁水族箱中的养护效果适中，是初学者到专家爱好者的绝佳选择英石。在水族箱中为它和其他邻近的珊瑚之间提供足够的空间，因为它在白天会膨胀到平时大小的两倍，并会刺伤靠近它的其他珊瑚。最好将珊瑚的骨架放置在柔软的基质中。与岩石相比，柔软的基质不太可能刺激珊瑚的肉质底部。如果没有海葵存在，小丑鱼可能会接受这种珊瑚作为其宿主。处理时请小心，因为它非常脆弱，可能会损坏

products.title: Bubble Coral 4.5"
products.description: The Bubble Coral is a beautiful LPS coral that originates from the reefs of the Indo-Pacific. It has a green or white-ridged hard skeleton that can be seen when the polyps are deflated. When inflated, the large fleshy polyps will cover the entire skeleton, and are green, white or yellowish in color. Like many other LPS corals, they do posses sweeper tentacles that can harm other corals within reach. The Bubble Coral requires a moderate level of lighting combined with low to moderate water movement in the aquarium. Too much water flow may impede the coral from fully expanding. The fleshy polyps of Bubble Corals are very fragile and will puncture easily. Be careful when handling these corals, to only handle them by the hard skeleton. Because they can form long sweeper tentacles, be sure to provide plenty of room to prevent damage being done to its neighbors. For continued good health, it will also need the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: 气泡珊瑚是一种美丽的 LPS 珊瑚，起源于印度太平洋的珊瑚礁。它有一个绿色或白色脊状的硬骨架，当息肉缩小时可以看到。膨胀后，大的肉质息肉会覆盖整个骨骼，颜色为绿色、白色或淡黄色。与许多其他 LPS 珊瑚一样，它们确实拥有清洁触手，可以伤害触手可及的其他珊瑚。气泡珊瑚需要中等水平的照明以及水族箱中低至中等的水流运动。过多的水流可能会阻碍珊瑚充分扩张。气泡珊瑚的肉质息肉非常脆弱，很容易被刺破。处理这些珊瑚时要小心，只能用坚硬的骨架来对付它们。因为它们可以形成长长的清扫触手，所以一定要提供足够的空间，以防止对其邻居造成伤害。为了持续保持健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Alveopora Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Alveopora Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral also referred to as the Alveopora Daisy, Flowerpot, Sunflower, or Ball Coral. The flower references are due to its appearance when all of its polyps are open. It then takes on the visage of a bouquet of flowers. It has 12 tentacles on each polyp and is often green; when displayed under actinic lighting, it will glow. It is not an overly aggressive coral, but space should still be provided between itself and other corals. Its polyps can extend far past its base into the reef aquarium, where it can sting other species of corals. Clownfish are in direct association with the Alveopora Coral and will often play in its polyps if no anemone can be found in the reef aquarium. Being easier to care for than Goniopora , any of the Alveopora species make a good alternate for the novice reef aquarist, who is seeking a coral similar to the hard to maintain Goniopora . The Alveopora Coral requires low to moderate lighting combined with low water movement. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The diet of this coral should consist of micro-plankton or brine sh
products.description_zh: Alveopora 珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，也称为 Alveopora 雏菊、花盆、向日葵或球珊瑚。花的参考是由于它的所有息肉都打开时的外观。然后它呈现出一束鲜花的面貌。每个水螅体上有 12 条触手，通常是绿色的；当在光化照明下显示时，它会发光。它不是一种过度攻击性的珊瑚，但仍应在其与其他珊瑚之间提供空间。它的水螅体可以延伸到珊瑚礁水族馆的底部，在那里它可以蜇其他种类的珊瑚。小丑鱼与 Alveopora 珊瑚有直接关系，如果没有海葵，它们经常会在珊瑚虫中玩耍。可以在珊瑚礁水族馆中找到。与 Goniopora 相比，任何一种 Alveopora 物种都比 Goniopora 更容易照顾，对于那些正在寻找与难以维护的 Goniopora 类似的珊瑚的新手珊瑚礁养殖者来说，这是一个很好的替代品。 Alveopora Coral 需要低至中等的光照和低水流。为了持续保持身体健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。这种珊瑚的饮食应该包括微型浮游生物或盐水鱼

products.title: Flower Pot Coral, Metallic Green 4"
products.description: The Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is an exquisite color variety of Goniopora coral commonly known as the Daisy Coral, Ball Coral, or Sunflower Coral due to its lovely floral appearance when all of the polyps are opened. The soothing green coloration of the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is sure to introduce an unexpected pop of color without overwhelming the design of your reef aquarium landscape. Caring for the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral is moderately difficult and as such, it is generally not recommended for the novice or beginning reef aquarist. The Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral should be housed in an established reef aquarium with high water quality. In the wild, Goniopora corals are often found in nutrient-rich shallows near the shore or in lagoons with turbid water conditions. To best replicate these conditions, the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral requires moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or more intense metal halide light fixtures combined with medium water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, the Metallic Green Flower Pot Coral will benefit from the addition of calcium, strontium, iodine, magnesium and tra
products.description_zh: 金属绿色花盆珊瑚是一种精致的颜色的 Goniopora 珊瑚品种，通常被称为雏菊珊瑚、球珊瑚或向日葵珊瑚，因为当所有珊瑚虫都打开时，它会呈现出可爱的花朵外观。金属绿色花盆珊瑚的舒缓绿色一定会带来意想不到的流行色彩，而不会压倒您的珊瑚礁水族馆景观的设计。照顾金属绿色花盆珊瑚是相当困难的，因此，通常不建议新手或刚开始的珊瑚礁水族爱好者这样做。金属绿色花盆珊瑚应饲养在水质良好的成熟礁石水族箱中。在野外，Goniopora cora它们经常出现在海岸附近营养丰富的浅滩或水质浑浊的泻湖中。为了最好地复制这些条件，金属绿色花盆珊瑚需要通过 T-5 荧光灯、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物灯具结合水族箱内中等水流来实现适度的照明条件。为了持续保持身体健康，金属绿花盆珊瑚将受益于钙、锶、碘、镁和特拉的添加。

products.description: This eye-catching color variety exhibits a bold autumn color palette featuring rust-red tentacles and bronze-orange "eyes." The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral offers reef aquarium hobbyists a fantastic coral sure to inject incredible visual interest to any reef aquarium landscape thanks to its encrusting growth habit and vibrant coloration. The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral can thrive under moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or the more intense metal halide light fixtures. For best care, it is imperative to maintain high water quality for the Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral ensuring proper pH, alkalinity, and calcium levels while keeping phosphate and nitrate levels as close to zero as possible. Along with proper lighting and water quality, the Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral will thrive when provided medium, intermittent water flow within the aquarium. This can be easily achieved with the addition of powerheads, wavemakers, or water circulation pumps. The Orange Eye Leptastrea Coral is aggressive in temperament and will expand its sweeper tentacles at night well beyond the base. It is important to leave space between the Orange Eye Leptastrea and neighbors
products.description_zh: 这种引人注目的颜色品种展现了大胆的秋季调色板，具有铁锈红色的触手和古铜橙色的“眼睛”。橙眼细珊瑚为珊瑚礁水族馆爱好者提供了一种梦幻般的珊瑚，由于其坚硬的生长习性和鲜艳的色彩，一定能为任何珊瑚礁水族馆景观注入令人难以置信的视觉兴趣。橙眼细珊瑚可以在 T-5 荧光灯、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物灯具实现的适度照明条件下茁壮成长。为了获得最佳护理，必须保持橙眼细珊瑚的高水质，确保适当的 pH 值、碱度和钙水平，同时保持磷酸盐和硝酸盐水平尽可能接近于零。除了适当的照明和水质外，当水族箱内提供中等、间歇性的水流时，橙眼细珊瑚会茁壮成长。通过添加动力头、造波器或水循环泵可以轻松实现这一点。橙眼细珊瑚的性情非常好斗，在夜间会将其清扫触手伸到底部以外的地方。在橙眼 Leptastrea 和邻居之间留出空间很重要

products.title: Red and Green War Coral 4.5"
products.description: The Red and Green Favites War Coral injects an impressive burst of color sure to command attention in any reef aquarium. The Red and Green Favites War Coral represents a new generation of exotic color varieties that is transforming the reef hobby. The deep red coloration sets off the green eyes to dramatic effect sure to put any avid coral collector on a warpath to obtain this beauty. The Red and Green Favites War Coral is an exceptional color variety of Favites , a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as Moon, Pineapple, Brain, Closed Brain, Star, Worm, or Honeycomb Coral. Favites are the most common and prolific corals in the world and often share the same common names with their close relative, the corals from the genus Favia . Though very similar in appearance, the easiest way to distinguish corals from the Genus Favites from corals from the Genus Favia is to examine the corallites. The individual corallites of Favites corals share common walls that create a honeycomb appearance. In addition, the corallite walls of Favites corals are generally more raised and tend to be more uneven, accentuating the geometric appearance of the Favites corals. The Red and Green Favite
products.description_zh: 红色和绿色的最爱战珊瑚注入令人印象深刻的色彩，肯定会在任何珊瑚礁水族馆中引起注意。最喜欢的红色和绿色战珊瑚代表了新一代的异国色彩品种，正在改变人们对珊瑚礁的爱好。深红色的颜色衬托出绿色的眼睛，产生戏剧性的效果，肯定会让任何狂热的珊瑚收藏家为获得这种美丽而战。红色和绿色最爱战珊瑚是最爱颜色的特殊品种，是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为月珊瑚、菠萝珊瑚、脑珊瑚、闭脑珊瑚、星珊瑚、蠕虫珊瑚或蜂窝珊瑚。最喜欢的珊瑚是世界上最常见和最多产的珊瑚，并且通常与它们具有相同的通用名称其近亲是蚕豆属珊瑚。虽然外观非常相似，但区分最爱属珊瑚和蚕豆属珊瑚的最简单方法是检查珊瑚。 Favites 珊瑚的各个珊瑚体共享共同的壁，形成蜂窝状外观。此外，Favites 珊瑚的珊瑚壁通常更加凸起，并且往往更加不平坦，突出了 Favites 珊瑚的几何外观。最喜欢的红色和绿色

products.title: Multibar Angelfish 2.75"
products.description: The Multibar Angel, also known as the Many Banded Angelfish and Multibarred Angelfish, has individual black and yellow vertical bands arranged in an "every other" fashion, with a thin stripe of white bordering each black band. The tail is white to yellow with small black speckles. A juvenile can be distinguished by a blue eyespot at the back of the dorsal fin. The Multibar Angel requires a minimum tank size of 70 gallons with plenty of hiding places and live rock for grazing. This angelfish is best kept as the only species member in a tank. The Multibar Angel, like other dwarf angels, are hermaphroditic, difficult to breed, and indistinguishable in color variations from male to female. The Multibar Angel can be a finicky eater; it prefers a variety of small meaty items, angelfish and herbivore preparations, and live sponges. These eating habits and the trait of becoming somewhat territorial upon acclimatization, make this a challenging fish to keep. Please note: We guarantee that ALL aquaria species we offer will arrive alive and in good condition. products.title: Dampiera Dottyback 5.5"
products.description: The Dampiera Dottyback is also known as the Firetail Dottyback, and the Red Dottyback. It is highly variable in coloring with red and yellow being predominate with purple markings on the body. A 75 gallon or larger aquarium with many hiding places provides a good environment. This Pseudochromis should be housed with aggressive fish larger than itself. It will eat ornamental shrimp. The diet consists of meaty foods including brine shrimp and prepared frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 丹皮埃拉斑背犬也被称为火尾斑背犬和红斑背犬。它的颜色变化很大，以红色和黄色为主，身体上有紫色斑纹。 75加仑或更大的水族箱有很多藏身之处，可以提供良好的环境。这种拟色鱼应与比其体型大的攻击性鱼类一起饲养。它会吃观赏虾。饮食包括肉类食物，包括丰年虾和预制冷冻食品。

products.title: Whip Fin Fairy Wrasse 2.5"
products.description: The Whip Fin Fairy Wrasse, originates from the waters of the Indian Ocean. Theis species is a very distinctive wrasse with its long dorsal fin that may exceed the length of the fish. The main body of this wrasse is a brilliant red color while the lower half of the body is white. The dorsal fin is brightly colored yellow and is outlined in blue. The male during courting will display its brilliantly colored fins in an attempt to persuade its mate. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood. The Whip Fin Wrasse is a peaceful, active fish that will bring both color and activity to a fish-only or reef aquarium of 55 gallons or larger. When maintained with other Cirrhilabrus or Paracheilinus wrasse, they can become territorial, and dominate similar species. Whip Fin Fairy Wrasse will not harm any corals or invertebrates making them a perfect fish for the reef aquarium. These wrasses like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is recommended. The Whip Fin Fairy Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food.
products.description_zh: 鞭鳍仙女濑鱼，起源于印度洋水域。濑鱼是一种非常独特的濑鱼，其背鳍很长，可能超过鱼的长度。濑鱼的主体呈鲜红色，下半身呈白色。背鳍呈亮黄色，轮廓为蓝色。雄性在求爱期间会展示其色彩鲜艳的鳍，试图说服它的伴侣。颜色可能会根据鱼的心情而变化。鞭鳍濑鱼是一种性情温和、活跃的鱼类，可为 55 加仑或更大的纯鱼或珊瑚礁水族箱带来色彩和活力。当与其他 Cirrilabrus 或 Paracheilinus wra 一起维护时sse，它们可以变得有领地性，并统治相似的物种。鞭鳍仙女濑鱼不会伤害任何珊瑚或无脊椎动物，使它们成为珊瑚礁水族馆的完美鱼类。这些濑鱼喜欢跳跃，因此建议使用紧身的顶篷。鞭鳍仙濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食品以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食品。

products.description: The Max Coverage Clean-Up Pack delivers full-system maintenance with four efficient species that complement each other. This bundle includes 10 Cat Eye Turbo Snails for algae on hard surfaces, 10 Bumble Bee Snails to clean hard-to-reach crevices, 10 Margarita Snails for broad algae grazing, and 10 Scarlet Reef Hermit Crabs to handle detritus. A perfect all-in-one solution for reef keepers who want top-tier tank hygiene.

products.title: Half Black Angelfish 2.5"
products.description: The Half Black Angelfish, like its name is half black and half pearled in coloration. It requires at least a 70 gallon tank with lots of hiding places. The Half Black Angelfish should be the only dwarf angelfish in the tank. It is not a good reef dweller and may eat soft coral polyps, clam mantles, and zoanthids. It is very difficult to breed in an aquarium, and has no distinguishable differences in color between male to female. The diet of the Half Black Angelfish should include Spirulina , marine algae, mysis shrimp along with other meaty fare, and live rock for grazing.

products.description: The Red Flower Pot Coral is a showy sculptural variety of Goniopora coral commonly known as the Daisy Coral, Ball Coral, or Sunflower Coral due to its lovely floral appearance when all of the polyps are opened. As its name implies, the Red Flower Pot Coral has elongated polyps that give it a full, bushy appearance. The Red Flower Pot Coral is sure to introduce fantastic visual interest full of beautiful color and architecture to your reef aquarium landscape. Caring for the Red Flower Pot Coral is moderately difficult and as such, it is generally not recommended for the novice or beginning reef aquarist. The Red Flower Pot Coral should be housed in an established reef aquarium with high water quality. In the wild, Goniopora corals are often found in nutrient-rich shallows near the shore or in lagoons with turbid water conditions. To best replicate these conditions, the Red Flower Pot Coral requires moderate lighting conditions achieved by T-5 fluorescent, powerful LED, or more intense metal halide light fixtures combined with medium water movement within the aquarium. products.description_zh: 红花盆珊瑚是一种艳丽的雕塑珊瑚，通常被称为雏菊珊瑚、球珊瑚或向日葵珊瑚，因为当所有珊瑚虫都张开时，它会呈现出可爱的花朵外观。顾名思义，红花盆珊瑚具有细长的水螅体，使其外观饱满、浓密。红色花盆珊瑚一定会给您的珊瑚礁水族箱景观带来充满美丽色彩和建筑的奇妙视觉兴趣。照顾红花盆珊瑚是相当困难的，因此，通常不建议新手或刚开始的珊瑚礁水族爱好者这样做。红花盆珊瑚应饲养在水位较高的已建珊瑚礁水族箱中质量。在野外，Goniopora 珊瑚经常出现在海岸附近营养丰富的浅滩或水质浑浊的泻湖中。为了最好地复制这些条件，红花盆珊瑚需要通过 T-5 荧光灯、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物灯具结合水族箱内中等水流来实现适度的照明条件。为了持续保持身体健康，红花盆珊瑚将受益于钙、锶、碘、镁的添加。

products.description: The Acan Brain Coral wakes up tired reef aquariums with a jolt of exhilarating orange or red coloration. This color morph of the popular large polyp stony (LPS) coral demonstrates the exceptional range of vivid coloration displayed by Acanthastrea echinata. The Acan Brain Coral boasts coloration inspired by pop-culture featuring contrasting gradients of teal, orange, and sometimes red. Intense pops of caffeine-induced coloration transforms barren regions of your substrate and other lack-luster regions of the reef aquarium with visual excitement. products.description: The Lobophyllia Brain Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as a Lobed, Colored, Carpet, Flat, or Open Brain Coral, Meat Coral, Modern Coral, or Large Flower Coral. It requires moderate to strong lighting combined with a moderate water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The symbiotic algae zooxanthellae hosted within its body provides the majority of its nutritional requirements through photosynthesis. It will also benefit from additional food in the form of micro-plankton or brine shrimp fed in the evening w
products.description_zh: 叶叶珊瑚是一种大型水螅体石珊瑚 (LPS)，通常被称为裂片珊瑚、彩色珊瑚、地毯珊瑚、扁平珊瑚或开脑珊瑚、肉珊瑚、现代珊瑚或大花珊瑚。它有肉质息肉，隐藏着钙质骨骼。它有多种质地和颜色形式。有的很光滑，有的则有疙瘩，看起来像地毯。颜色有鲜红色、绿色、橙色、灰色、棕褐色或棕色等。它的行为是半攻击性的，它会在夜间用伸出的清扫触手刺其他珊瑚。在它和其他邻近的珊瑚之间提供足够的空间。它很容易在珊瑚礁水族箱中维护，使其成为初学者的绝佳选择。通过专家珊瑚礁水族师。它需要中等到强的照明以及水族箱内适度的水运动。为了持续保持身体健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。其体内的共生藻类虫黄藻通过光合作用提供其大部分营养需求。它还将受益于晚上喂食的微型浮游生物或丰年虾等额外食物。

products.title: Favites Brain Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Favites Corals are large polyp stony (LPS) corals often referred to as Moon, Pineapple, Brain, Closed Brain, Star, Worm, or Honeycomb Coral. They are the most common and prolific coral in the world, and are very similar to the genus Favia , sharing many of the same common names, and sometimes being very difficult to differentiate. Favites Corals are found in various color forms and polyp shapes. "Pineapple Coral" is the name commonly given to those that have smaller circular patterns. The Favites Corals are aggressive, expanding their sweeper tentacles at night well beyond the base. It is important to leave space between them and neighbors in the reef aquarium. Maintenance for the Favites Corals is relatively easy, making them excellent choices for the beginner to expert hobbyist. They require moderate lighting combined with moderate water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, calcium, strontium, and other trace elements should be added to the water. It will also benefit from the addition of supplemental food in the form of micro-plankton or brine shrimp, fed twice per week in the evening while its tentacles are visible.

products.title: Lavender Mushroom Coral 2.75"
products.description: The Lavender Mushroom is a member of the Rhodactis genus, formerly called Discosoma . It generally grows larger and has shorter tentacles than other mushroom corals. The Lavender Mushroom is easy to maintain in the reef aquarium, and a good choice for the beginner hobbyist. It is somewhat aggressive, however, and can harm sessile invertebrates and overgrow other inhabitants of the reef. It requires a low to medium light level combined with a medium water movement within the aquarium. It may reproduce in the home aquarium provided that water conditions are adequate, sometimes causing over-population. A small portion of the base or mouth will separate from the parent polyp and grow into a full sized mushroom within a few months. The symbiotic algae zooxanthellae hosted within its body provide some of its nutritional requirements, but it also eats plankton and some larger organisms. It ships as several individual mushrooms attached to one rock.

products.title: Merulina Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Merulina Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral also known as Lettuce, Cabbage, Ridge, or Ruffled Coral. Most aquarists will receive the species M. ampliata that commonly lives in lagoons and other sheltered areas of the reef. Merulina Coral colonies begin life as an encrusting coral. With time, growth, and prevailing conditions, they start to develop the more spectacular structures that have made them famous with reef aquarists everywhere. It is normal to see the intricate skeleton frame through its skin. Fan-like plates are usually the first to form. More plates then form in the center of the fan, creating a ruffled appearance that truly resembles a head of cabbage or lettuce. The Merulina Coral will need a high light level and placement at mid-level or higher in the aquarium with a medium water movement. While it rarely exposes its polyps, they may occasionally be seen at night. The sweeper tentacles that are used to gather food will reach about three inches in length. products.title: Green Spaghetti Finger Leather Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Spaghetti Finger Leather Coral is commonly referred to as Flexible Leather Coral, Soft Finger Coral, or Thin Finger Coral. It can be recognized from other members of the genus by its long, thin, flexible fingers that are often available in stunning iridescent shades of yellow, gold, green or tan. It may be slimy to the touch. It is a semi-aggressive soft coral and needs space between itself and other corals. It can be toxic to some species of hard corals, so care should be taken when added to a reef aquarium, taking into account its placement and size relative to the size of the aquarium. It is moderately difficult to maintain in the reef aquarium, but makes an unusual coral for the established reef aquarium. It requires medium to high lighting, and medium to strong water movement, along with the addition of iodine, strontium, and trace elements to the water. It obtains the majority of its nutrition from symbiotic algae zooxanthellae, but will benefit from additional food such as micro-plankton, baby brine shrimp, or foods designed for filter feeding invertebrates. It is normally shipped attached to a small piece of live rock or rubble.

products.description: The Lobophyllia Brain Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as a Lobed, Colored, Carpet, Flat, or Open Brain Coral, Meat Coral, Modern Coral, or Large Flower Coral. It has fleshy polyps that hide its calcareous skeleton. It is found in a variety of textures and color forms. Some are smooth, while others are pimply, and look like carpet. Colors vary from bright red, green, orange, gray, tan, or brown. Its behavior is semi-aggressive and it will sting other corals with its extended sweeper tentacles during the night. Provide plenty of space between it and other neighboring corals. It is easy to maintain in the reef aquarium, making it an excellent candidate for the beginning through expert reef aquarist. It requires moderate to strong lighting combined with a moderate water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The symbiotic algae zooxanthellae hosted within its body provides the majority of its nutritional requirements through photosynthesis. products.description: The Catalaphyllia Elegance Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) often referred to as Elegant Coral, Wonder Coral, or Ridge Coral. It is truly the most unique and interesting stony coral known. Its polyps are extended during the day showing off its vast array of color-tipped tentacles. Under actinic lighting, the fluorescent qualities are beautiful with lime green, blue, orange, or purple-tipped tentacles which vary between branched or round and bulbous shapes. The most common color variety available to aquarists is gold with pink or purple-tipped polyps. Provide ample space in the aquarium between it and other neighboring corals as it will expand to twice its usual size during the day and will sting other corals in close proximity to it. It is best to place the skeleton of the coral into a soft substrate. The soft substrate is less likely to irritate the fleshy underside of the coral when compared to the rockwork. products.description: The Red and Green Favites War Coral injects an impressive burst of color sure to command attention in any reef aquarium. products.description: Formerly known as “Acans” or Acanthastrea and now remamed to Homophyllia bowerbanki, “Bankies” can have similar color patterns to that of other corals such as Warpaint and UFO along with many other color combinations. This variety of LPS coral will not disappoint in color and shape. Homophyllia bowerbanki is an encrusting coral found from Australia to Japan in the Pacific and Indian Oceans. It is a relatively common coral that can fall prey to the destructive Crown of Thorns Starfish on the reef. This coral can also be found in the trade as more hobbyists are having success with aquaculture and propagation of this species. Care is relatively straight forward for Bankies. Place in the middle of the aquarium with moderate to strong water flow. These corals will appreciate larger foods such as brine shrimp and mysis shrimp.
products.description_zh: “Bankies”以前被称为“Acans”或“Acanthastrea”，现在被重新命名为“Homophyllia Bowerbanki”，它可以具有与其他珊瑚（例如 Warpaint 和 UFO）相似的颜色图案以及许多其他颜色组合。这种 LPS 珊瑚的颜色和形状不会令人失望。 Homophyllia Bowerbanki 是一种结壳珊瑚，分布于从澳大利亚到日本的太平洋和印度洋。它是一种相对常见的珊瑚，可能会成为珊瑚礁上破坏性的荆棘冠海星的猎物。随着越来越多的爱好者在水产养殖和繁殖该物种方面取得成功，这种珊瑚也可以在贸易中找到。对于 Bankies 来说，护理相对简单。放在中间具有中等到强水流的水族箱。这些珊瑚会喜欢较大的食物，例如丰年虾和糠虾。

products.title: Alveopora Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Alveopora Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral also referred to as the Alveopora Daisy, Flowerpot, Sunflower, or Ball Coral. The flower references are due to its appearance when all of its polyps are open. It then takes on the visage of a bouquet of flowers. It has 12 tentacles on each polyp and is often green; when displayed under actinic lighting, it will glow. It is not an overly aggressive coral, but space should still be provided between itself and other corals. Its polyps can extend far past its base into the reef aquarium, where it can sting other species of corals. Clownfish are in direct association with the Alveopora Coral and will often play in its polyps if no anemone can be found in the reef aquarium. Being easier to care for than Goniopora , any of the Alveopora species make a good alternate for the novice reef aquarist, who is seeking a coral similar to the hard to maintain Goniopora . The Alveopora Coral requires low to moderate lighting combined with low water movement. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The diet of this coral should consist of micro-plankton or brine sh
products.description_zh: Alveopora 珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，也称为 Alveopora 雏菊、花盆、向日葵或球珊瑚。花的参考是由于它的所有息肉都打开时的外观。然后它呈现出一束鲜花的面貌。每个水螅体上有 12 条触手，通常是绿色的；当在光化照明下显示时，它会发光。它不是一种过度攻击性的珊瑚，但仍应在其与其他珊瑚之间提供空间。它的水螅体可以延伸到珊瑚礁水族馆的底部，在那里它可以蜇其他种类的珊瑚。小丑鱼与 Alveopora 珊瑚有直接关系，如果没有海葵，它们经常会在珊瑚虫中玩耍。可以在珊瑚礁水族馆中找到。与 Goniopora 相比，任何一种 Alveopora 物种都比 Goniopora 更容易照顾，对于那些正在寻找与难以维护的 Goniopora 类似的珊瑚的新手珊瑚礁养殖者来说，这是一个很好的替代品。 Alveopora Coral 需要低至中等的光照和低水流。为了持续保持身体健康，还需要在水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。这种珊瑚的饮食应该包括微型浮游生物或盐水鱼

products.title: Australian Bowerbanki Coral, Red/Orange 3"
products.description: Formerly known as “Acans” or Acanthastrea and now remamed to Homophyllia bowerbanki, “Bankies” can have similar color patterns to that of other corals such as Warpaint and UFO along with many other color combinations. This variety of LPS coral will not disappoint in color and shape. Homophyllia bowerbanki is an encrusting coral found from Australia to Japan in the Pacific and Indian Oceans. It is a relatively common coral that can fall prey to the destructive Crown of Thorns Starfish on the reef. This coral can also be found in the trade as more hobbyists are having success with aquaculture and propagation of this species. Care is relatively straight forward for Bankies. Place in the middle of the aquarium with moderate to strong water flow. These corals will appreciate larger foods such as brine shrimp and mysis shrimp.
products.description_zh: “Bankies”以前被称为“Acans”或“Acanthastrea”，现在被重新命名为“Homophyllia Bowerbanki”，它可以具有与其他珊瑚（例如 Warpaint 和 UFO）相似的颜色图案以及许多其他颜色组合。这种 LPS 珊瑚的颜色和形状不会令人失望。 Homophyllia Bowerbanki 是一种结壳珊瑚，分布于从澳大利亚到日本的太平洋和印度洋。它是一种相对常见的珊瑚，可能会成为珊瑚礁上破坏性的荆棘冠海星的猎物。随着越来越多的爱好者在水产养殖和繁殖该物种方面取得成功，这种珊瑚也可以在贸易中找到。对于 Bankies 来说，护理相对简单。放在中间具有中等到强水流的水族箱。这些珊瑚会喜欢较大的食物，例如丰年虾和糠虾。

products.title: Reef Cleaner Bundle
products.description: Marine invertebrates are more than just colorful additions to your reef tank—they're an essential part of a healthy, balanced aquarium ecosystem. Often referred to as your tank's "clean-up crew," these hardworking animals help control algae, remove waste, and keep your aquarium looking its best. Many snails spend their day grazing on algae that grows on rocks, glass, and substrate. By constantly feeding, they help prevent nuisance algae from taking over your aquarium while reducing the need for manual cleaning. Scavengers like cleaner shrimp and Nassarius snails consume leftover fish food and decaying organic matter before it can break down into harmful nutrients. This helps maintain better water quality and reduces excess nitrate and phosphate buildup. Adding a variety of marine invertebrates creates a more natural reef environment. Each species performs a unique job, working together to maintain balance and support the overall health of your aquarium. Bundle includes: 25 Margarita Snails 10 Dwarf Red Tip Hermit Crabs 10 Nassarius Snails 25 Bumble Bee Snails 1 Medium Scarlet Skunk Cleaner Shrimp
products.description_zh: 海洋无脊椎动物不仅仅是珊瑚缸中色彩缤纷的点缀，它们还是健康、平衡的水族箱生态系统的重要组成部分。这些勤劳的动物通常被称为水族箱的“清洁工”，有助于控制藻类、清除废物并保持水族箱的最佳状态。许多蜗牛整天吃生长在岩石、玻璃和基质上的藻类。通过不断喂食，它们有助于防止讨厌的藻类占领您的水族箱，同时减少手动清洁的需要。像清洁虾和织纹螺这样的食腐动物会吃掉剩下的鱼食和腐烂的有机物，然后再分解成有害的营养物质。这有助于更好地保持水质并减少过量的硝酸盐和磷酸盐的积累。添加各种海洋无脊椎动物创造了更自然的珊瑚礁环境。每个物种都执行着独特的工作，共同努力保持平衡并支持水族箱的整体健康。套装包括： 25 只玛格丽塔蜗牛 10 只矮红尖寄居蟹 10 只织纹蜗牛 25 只大黄蜂蜗牛 1 只中号猩红色臭鼬清洁虾

products.title: Bristletooth Tomini Tang 3.75"
products.description: The Bristletooth Tomini Tang, also known as the Tomini Surgeonfish is tan combined with yellow, blue, and white highlights as a juvenile. When mature, the body color solidifies, the tail becomes blue, and the dorsal and anal fins are tipped with a golden-yellow hue. The area above the eyes has small golden flecks while sporting a golden half circle beneath. A 70 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. It is aggressive towards other Tangs, but peaceful with other fish. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use.
products.description_zh: 刚齿托米尼唐鱼，也称为托米尼刺尾鱼，幼鱼时呈棕褐色，并带有黄色、蓝色和白色的亮点。成熟时，体色凝固，尾巴变成蓝色，背鳍和臀鳍尖端呈金黄色。眼睛上方的区域有金色的小斑点，下方有一个金色的半圆。需要 70 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳空间。它对其他唐鱼具有攻击性，但对其他鱼却很和平。虽然唐鱼和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫力系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。

products.title: Regal Angelfish 4.25"
products.description: With vivid vertical striations of blue, white, yellow, or orange on the body and pelvic fin, the Regal Angelfish deserves this distinctive name. Regal Angelfish from the Maldives and the Red Sea have a distinctive yellow breast, where their Indo-Pacific, Coral Sea, New Caledonia and Tahitian relatives normally have a blue/gray breast. This coloration is more prevalent in specimens that are more mature and are at least 4" in length. Juveniles will have a "False Eye Spot" on their dorsal fins that fades and the fish matures. Regal Angelfish from the Red Sea, Maldives, Coral Sea, Fiji and Tahiti are good shippers and are harvested and handled with care, and normally will adapt more easily than their Indo-Pacific counterparts to the home aquarium. The Regal Angelfish is more difficult to maintain than other species of angels so it should be introduced first so that it may stake out its territory in advance of other fish. A minimum of a 125 gallon tank with plenty of hiding places and live rock for grazing will offer a good environment. The Regal Angelfish may nip at large-polyped stony corals, an occasional soft coral and clam mantles, but may be kept with small-polyped stony corals an
products.description_zh: 帝王神仙鱼的身体和腹鳍上有生动的蓝色、白色、黄色或橙色的垂直条纹，它配得上这个独特的名字。来自马尔代夫和红海的帝王神仙鱼有一个独特的黄色胸部，而它们的印度太平洋、珊瑚海、新喀里多尼亚和大溪地亲戚通常有蓝色/灰色的胸部。这种颜色在较成熟且长度至少为 4 英寸的标本中更为普遍。幼鱼的背鳍上会出现“假眼斑”，随着鱼的成熟，该斑点会逐渐消失。来自红海、马尔代夫、珊瑚海、斐济和塔希提岛的帝王神仙鱼是良好的托运者，捕捞和处理时要小心，通常比鱼更容易适应。他们的印度太平洋地区的水族馆与家庭水族馆相似。帝王神仙鱼比其他种类的神仙鱼更难饲养，因此应首先引入它，以便它可以先于其他鱼标出自己的领地。至少 125 加仑的水箱，有足够的藏身之处和可供放牧的活石，将提供良好的环境。帝王神仙鱼可能会咬食大水螅体石珊瑚，偶尔也会吃软珊瑚和蛤蜊，但也可能与小水螅体石珊瑚和蛤蜊一起饲养。

products.title: Sponge Crab
products.description: The Sponge Crab, also known as a Decorator Crab, is an interesting crustacean that carries a sponge upon its back for camouflage. They are comical looking crabs that have small front pinches that they use for feeding. They are best housed in a reef aquarium with plenty of live rock for hiding and food. The Sponge Crab is mostly nocturnal, feeding at night. They will typically harvest sponge for camouflage, but may also harvest tunicates or even polyp corals. This activity may cause harm to some soft or polyp corals, but in the large reef aquarium, this activity actually helps spread and propagate these same corals throughout the aquarium. The diet of the Sponge Crab should include meaty foods such as frozen brine or mysis shrimp, cockle and pieces of fish. Approximate Purchase Size: 1-1/2" to 2"
products.description_zh: 海绵蟹，也称为装饰蟹，是一种有趣的甲壳类动物，背上有一块海绵用于伪装。它们是一种看起来很滑稽的螃蟹，它们的前部有小捏，可以用来喂食。它们最好饲养在珊瑚礁水族箱中，那里有大量的活石可供藏身和食物。海绵蟹大多是夜间活动，在夜间进食。他们通常会收获海绵用于伪装，但也可能收获被囊类动物甚至水螅珊瑚。这种活动可能会对一些软珊瑚或水螅珊瑚造成伤害，但在大型珊瑚礁水族馆中，这种活动实际上有助于在整个水族馆中传播和繁殖这些相同的珊瑚。海绵蟹的饮食应包括肉类食物例如冷冻盐水虾或糠虾、鸟蛤和鱼片。大约购买尺寸：1-1/2" 至 2"

products.title: Common Hermit Crab
products.description: The Common Hermit Crab has hairy red legs and unequal-sized claws (the left one is larger) which it will use to catch food. It lives inside empty gastropod shells and will attain a maximum size of approximately 8 inches. The Common Hermit Crab is not safe for a reef aquarium because it will eat tube worms, mollusks, and fish. It will also eat algae. In a community tank, however, it will keep the sand sifted with its constant search for food. It is best to keep just one specimen per tank, since it is aggressive towards other Hermit Crabs. As the Hermit Crab grows, it will need larger shells to inhabit. It is most active at night. It is a very hardy animal, and an interesting addition to an aquarium. If there is insufficient algae, the diet should be supplemented with dried seaweed, tablet foods, and earthworms. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1/2" to 1"; Medium: 1" to 2"; Large: 2" to 3"
products.description_zh: 寄居蟹有毛茸茸的红色腿和大小不等的爪子（左边的爪子较大），用来捕捉食物。它生活在空的腹足动物壳内，最大尺寸约为 8 英寸。寄居蟹对于珊瑚礁水族箱来说并不安全，因为它会吃管虫、软体动物和鱼类。它也会吃藻类。然而，在社区水箱中，它会通过不断寻找食物来保持沙子的筛分。每个水箱最好只保留一个标本，因为它对其他寄居蟹具有攻击性。随着寄居蟹的生长，它需要更大的壳来栖息。它在晚上最活跃。它是一种非常顽强的动物，也是水族的有趣补充。铀。如果藻类不足，饮食中应补充干海藻、片剂食品、蚯蚓等。大致购买尺寸：小号：1/2 英寸至 1 英寸；中号：1" 至 2"；大号：2 英寸至 3 英寸

products.title: Symphyllia Brain Coral, Red
products.description: The Symphyllia Red Brain Coral is a fantastic colored variety of the large polyp stony (LPS) coral also referred to as the Closed Brain Coral or the Dented Brain Coral. This beautiful coral is closely related to the popular Lobophyllia Open Brain Corals and is found in a variety of textures and color forms. Some are smooth, while others are pimply, and look like carpet. Symphyllia Brain Corals are naturally found in the Indo-Pacific Ocean, typically occurring in a range of habitats from protected reef slopes in shallow water to upper reef slope regions, as well as fringing reefs. Though sharing similar appearance and relative care requirements to Lobophyllia corals, Symphyllia Brain Corals make less frequent appearances in the aquarium industry, making them a fantastic choice for LPS coral aficionados. Caring for the Red Symphyllia Brain Coral is relatively easy, making it an excellent choice for the beginner to expert hobbyist. The Red Symphyllia Brain Coral requires moderate to high lighting conditions achieved by T-5s, powerful LEDs or the more intense metal halides combined with moderate water movement within the aquarium. products.description_zh: Symphyllia 红脑珊瑚是一种色彩绚丽的大型水螅体石珊瑚 (LPS) 珊瑚，也称为封闭脑珊瑚或凹状脑珊瑚。这种美丽的珊瑚与流行的叶叶珊瑚密切相关，具有多种纹理和颜色形式。有的很光滑，有的则有疙瘩，看起来像地毯。脑珊瑚天然存在于印度洋-太平洋中，通常出现在从浅水受保护的礁坡到上礁坡区域以及岸礁的一系列栖息地。尽管与叶叶珊瑚具有相似的外观和相关护理要求，但合叶脑珊瑚它们在水族行业中出现的频率较低，这使它们成为 LPS 珊瑚爱好者的绝佳选择。照顾红色合叶脑珊瑚相对容易，使其成为初学者到专家爱好者的绝佳选择。红心脑珊瑚需要通过 T-5、强大的 LED 或更强烈的金属卤化物以及水族箱内适度的水运动来实现中等到高的照明条件。为了持续保持良好的健康，红色 Symphyllia Brain Cor

products.description: The Proaquatix Royal Gramma Basslet brings a burst of color to any saltwater aquarium. It has a bright purple to violet colored anterior contrasted by a vibrant yellow posterior. Coveted for both its unique color pattern and relatively small adult size, Gramma loreto is a great beginner fish that well suited for small nano reef systems. Native to the deep-water reefs of the Caribbean, this member of the Grammidae family prefers extensive rockwork caves in which to hide and somewhat subdued lighting. Since it demonstrates territorial aggression towards its own kind, the Royal Gramma Basslet should be housed singly. However, most Royal Gramma Basslets are peaceful towards tankmates of similar size and temperament. For the best care, keep the Royal Gramma Basslet in reef systems of at least 30 gallons. Since it is a carnivore, feed a varied diet of meaty fare, including brine shrimp, mysis shrimp, and quality frozen preparations. products.title: Cuvier Bichir, Captive-Bred 4.75"
products.description: The Cuvier Bichir, also called the Senegal Bichir, Gray Bichir, or Dragonfin, is a member of the Polypteridae , or Lobe-Finned Pike family. This species is Captive-Bred, but is endemic to the streams and rivers of Africa. As with other members of the primitive Polypteridae family, the Cuvier Bichir has the unique ability to survive out of water. With a lung-like paired swim bladder and gills to help breathing, the Cuvier Bichir can spend short periods of time on land, but must soon return to its water environment for adequate respiration. This species is brown in color with an elongated snakelike body. The Cuvier Bichir does best in a large "oddball" aquarium with other large, passive fish. When provided with plenty of open swimming areas, rocks and crevices, the Cuvier Bichir is not usually aggressive toward tank mates. This species is semi-aggressive in the fact that they will swallow any fish or invertebrate that they can fit into their mouth. Be careful in choosing passive tank mates for the Bichir, as they are very passive towards other large fish. Prone to jumping, a tight, well-sealed aquarium lid is required. A carnivore, Polypterus senegalus can be offered a varied diet of
products.description_zh: 居维叶比奇鱼（Cuvier Bichir），也称为塞内加尔比奇鱼、灰比奇鱼或龙鳍鱼，是多鳍梭鱼科或叶鳍梭鱼科的成员。该物种是圈养繁殖的，但是非洲溪流和河流的特有物种。与原始Polypteridae家族的其他成员一样，Cuvier Bichir具有离开水生存的独特能力。居维叶比齐尔鱼拥有像肺一样的成对鱼鳔和鳃来帮助呼吸，它可以在陆地上停留很短的时间，但必须很快返回水环境进行充分的呼吸。该物种呈棕色，身体细长，像蛇一样。居维叶比齐尔鱼在与其他大型、被动鱼一起的大型“奇怪”水族箱中表现最好。当有足够的开放游泳区、岩石和裂缝时，居维叶比齐尔通常不会对坦克伙伴有攻击性。该物种具有半攻击性，因为它们会吞下任何可以放进嘴里的鱼或无脊椎动物。为比齐尔鱼选择被动的鱼缸伙伴时要小心，因为它们对其他大型鱼类非常被动。容易跳跃，需要一个紧密且密封良好的水族箱盖。塞内加尔多鳍鱼是一种食肉动物，可以提供多种食物

products.title: White Cichlid 3-Lot 3"
products.description: Contrary to its name, the White Cichlid Paraneetroplus argenteus actually has a silvery white background with black undertones in the fins. This tropical freshwater fish can display aggression toward smaller fish, so keep them in a tank with other larger fish with similar temperament. Provide plenty of room to swim and have many hiding places to establish territories in to help ease aggression. Growing to about 10 ½” when fully mature, they are difficult to sex, but males are usually larger than the females. To create a tank environment that White Cichlids will thrive in, good filtration is necessary, as these fish produce a lot of waste. A tropical fish, they prefer water temperature between 78-86 degrees with pH levels of approximately 7.0 in a tank of at least 75 gallons in size. The White Cichlid likes to uproot plants, so select hardy options for the tank bottom. They also use floating plants as cover. White Cichlids spawn on cleaned rocks and can lay up to 1000 eggs. Cichlids parents may eat their spawn. White Cichlids are omnivores that will eat most prepared and frozen foods, including freeze-dried bloodworms, brine shrimp, and tubifex, as well as flake food and Cichlid pel
products.description_zh: 与它的名字相反，白色丽鱼科鱼Paraneetroplus argenteus实际上有银白色的背景，鳍上有黑色的底色。这种热带淡水鱼会对较小的鱼表现出攻击性，因此请将它们与其他性情相似的较大鱼放在一个鱼缸中。提供足够的游泳空间，并有许多藏身之处来建立领地，以帮助缓解攻击性。完全成熟时长到约 10 ½ 英寸，很难进行性交，但雄性通常比雌性大。为了创造白慈鲷能够茁壮成长的水箱环境，良好的过滤是必要的，因为这些鱼会产生大量废物。热带鱼，它们喜欢介于在至少 75 加仑大小的水箱中，温度为 78-86 度，pH 值约为 7.0。白慈鲷喜欢将植物连根拔起，因此请为水箱底部选择耐寒的材料。他们还使用漂浮植物作为掩护。白慈鲷在干净的岩石上产卵，最多可产 1000 个卵。慈鲷的父母可能会吃掉它们的卵。白慈鲷是杂食动物，会吃大多数准备好的和冷冻的食物，包括冻干红虫、丰年虾和水母，以及片状食物和慈鲷鱼片

products.title: Banana Wrasse 2.75"
products.description: The Banana Wrasse is also known as the Yellow-brown Wrasse, Sunset Wrasse, or Yellow Wrasse. As an adult, it takes on a yellow appearance if female, and a blue appearance if male. Both sexes have facial markings in green and fine vertical striping along the body. The fins are very colorfully marked. It should reside in a 125 gallon or larger aquarium, with other aggressive tank mates, such as Tangs, Puffers and small Triggers and Angels. They are active fish and require plenty of rocks for hiding and a tight-fitting lid. It will become territorial and harass any new additions to the community, therefore, it should be added last to the tank. It may be kept with a mate, if the aquarium is 125 gallons or larger. It may eat mantis shrimp and bristleworms. It does not eat corals or live plants. The Banana Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food.
products.description_zh: 香蕉濑鱼也被称为黄棕色濑鱼、日落濑鱼或黄濑鱼。成年后，雌性呈黄色，雄性呈蓝色。男女都有绿色的面部斑纹和沿着身体的细垂直条纹。鳍的颜色非常鲜艳。它应该生活在 125 加仑或更大的水族箱中，与其他好斗的水族伙伴一起生活，例如唐鱼、河豚、小型扳机鱼和天使鱼。它们是活跃的鱼类，需要大量的岩石来隐藏和密封的盖子。它会成为领地并骚扰社区中的任何新成员，因此，它应该最后添加到坦克中。如果水族箱尺寸为 125，则可以与伴侣一起饲养加仑或更大。它可能吃螳螂虾和刚毛虫。它不吃珊瑚或活植物。香蕉濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食品以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食品。

products.title: Striped Squirrelfish 4"
products.description: The Striped Squirrelfish, also known as the Hawaiian Squirrelfish, is one of the most common squirrelfish seen by scuba divers. It is bright red with thin, white horizontal stripes. A 70 gallon or larger aquarium with large amounts of live rock, hiding places, and swimming room is recommended. It will do well with others of its own species as long as there is adequate hiding locations and adequate space. It will eat invertebrates such as worms, crustaceans, and serpent stars. It is a nocturnal fish and hides while the lights are on. When first introduced into the aquarium, live saltwater feeder shrimp should be used to entice this fish to eat. The diet should vary between live feeder shrimps, freeze-dried shrimps, chopped marine meats.
products.description_zh: 条纹松鼠鱼，也称为夏威夷松鼠鱼，是水肺潜水员最常见的松鼠鱼之一。它呈鲜红色，带有细细的白色水平条纹。建议使用 70 加仑或更大的水族箱，其中有大量活石、藏身之处和游泳池。只要有足够的隐藏地点和空间，它就能很好地与同类相处。它会吃无脊椎动物，如蠕虫、甲壳类动物和蛇星。它是一种夜行性鱼类，在灯光亮起时会隐藏起来。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活的咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。活虾的饮食应有所不同、冻干虾、切碎的海产肉类。

products.title: Emperor Angelfish Adult 4.5"
products.description: The adult Emperor Angelfish, also called the Imperator Angelfish, has a bold, blue body covered with bright yellow horizontal stripes culminating in a bright yellow to orange caudal fin. A striking blue-black mask covers the eyes and a similarly-colored vertical band extends from the pectoral fin two-thirds of the way up the body. This band is highlighted in a sapphire-blue in front, and bright yellow, caudally. The mouth is white. The juvenile is black with circular white and blue stripes starting at the tail. Although sought after for its colors, in captivity, the adult coloration may not be as striking or brilliant. The changing angelfish will vary in coloration and pattern as it transforms from juvenile to the adult coloration. The Emperor Angelfish requires a 220 gallon or larger tank with live rock for grazing and hiding. They also require extensive rockwork and deep caves to feel secure. It will nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles, but may be kept with small-polyped stony corals and somewhat noxious soft corals. It should be fed a diet of Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, mysis or frozen shrimp, and other meaty i
products.description_zh: 成年帝王神仙鱼，也称为帝王神仙鱼，有一个醒目的蓝色身体，上面覆盖着亮黄色的水平条纹，最后是亮黄色到橙色的尾鳍。醒目的蓝黑色面具遮盖了眼睛，一条颜色相似的垂直带从胸鳍延伸到身体三分之二处。该带的前面呈宝石蓝色，尾部呈亮黄色。嘴巴是白色的。幼鱼是黑色的，从尾巴开始有圆形的白色和蓝色条纹。尽管因其颜色而受到追捧，但在圈养状态下，成体的颜色可能不会那么引人注目或绚丽。变化的神仙鱼在变换时颜色和图案会有所不同从幼年到成年的着色。帝王神仙鱼需要一个 220 加仑或更大的水箱，并有活石用于放牧和隐藏。他们还需要大量的岩石和深邃的洞穴才能感到安全。它会咬食石珊瑚和软珊瑚（无柄无脊椎动物）和蛤套，但可能与小水螅体石珊瑚和有些有毒的软珊瑚一起饲养。应饲喂螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、糠虾或冷冻虾以及其他肉质饲料。

products.title: Indian Vagabond Butterflyfish 2.75"
products.description: The Vagabond Butterflyfish is primarily white with diagonal stripes forming chevron-like markings. It has a black eye band, and the dorsal, caudal, and anal fins are yellow with two black vertical bands. The Vagabond Butterflyfish should be kept in a 125 gallon or larger aquarium and may be kept with most other butterflyfish, holding its own against more aggressive tank mates. The Vagabond Butterflyfish is not reef safe. It feeds on algae, anemones, and coral polyps in the wild, and will accept most meaty preparations and graze on filamentous algae.
products.description_zh: 流浪蝴蝶鱼主要是白色的，带有斜条纹，形成人字形斑纹。它有一条黑色的眼带，背鳍、尾鳍和臀鳍是黄色的，有两条黑色的垂直带。流浪蝴蝶鱼应该饲养在 125 加仑或更大的水族箱中，并且可以与大多数其他蝴蝶鱼一起饲养，以抵御更具攻击性的鱼缸同伴。流浪蝴蝶鱼对珊瑚礁并不安全。它在野外以藻类、海葵和珊瑚虫为食，接受大多数肉类食物并以丝状藻类为食。

products.title: Pastel Ring Wrasse 3.25"
products.description: The Pastel Ring Wrasse Hologymnosus doliatus is known by several other names: the Candy Cane Wrasse, Longface Wrasse, and the Ringed Rainbowfish. Changing colors throughout their life, our juvenile Pastel Ring Wrasse is white with red stripes. This Wrasse is a good candidate for a fish-only marine aquarium with fish larger than it is because it will see crustaceans and other inverts as food. A lidded aquarium with rocks or other places to hide will make a good environment for the Pastel Ring Wrasse. A deep sandy substrate will provide not only a place to sleep, but a place to hide to escape danger. This member of the Labridae family is a carnivore and its diet should include meaty frozen and dry food, Mysis shrimp and brine shrimp.
products.description_zh: 淡环濑鱼 Hologymnosus doliatus 还有其他几个名字：糖蔗濑鱼、长面濑鱼和环纹彩虹鱼。我们的幼年淡环濑鱼在一生中颜色不断变化，呈白色，带有红色条纹。濑鱼非常适合养鱼的海洋水族馆，因为它会以甲壳类动物和其他无脊椎动物为食，因此鱼体比它大。一个有盖的水族箱，里面有岩石或其他可以隐藏的地方，将为粉彩环濑鱼创造一个良好的环境。深厚的沙质基质不仅可以提供睡觉的地方，而且可以提供躲避危险的藏身之处。这种Labridae家族的成员是肉食动物，其饮食应包括肉类、冷冻食品和肉类。干粮、糠虾和丰年虾。

products.title: Bristletooth Tomini Tang 4.5"
products.description: The Bristletooth Tomini Tang, also known as the Tomini Surgeonfish is tan combined with yellow, blue, and white highlights as a juvenile. When mature, the body color solidifies, the tail becomes blue, and the dorsal and anal fins are tipped with a golden-yellow hue. The area above the eyes has small golden flecks while sporting a golden half circle beneath. A 70 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. It is aggressive towards other Tangs, but peaceful with other fish. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use.
products.description_zh: 刚齿托米尼唐鱼，也称为托米尼刺尾鱼，幼鱼时呈棕褐色，并带有黄色、蓝色和白色的亮点。成熟时，体色凝固，尾巴变成蓝色，背鳍和臀鳍尖端呈金黄色。眼睛上方的区域有金色的小斑点，下方有一个金色的半圆。需要 70 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳空间。它对其他唐鱼具有攻击性，但对其他鱼却很和平。虽然唐鱼和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫力系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。

products.title: Miniatus Grouper 6"
products.description: The Miniatus Grouper, also known as the Miniata Grouper, Coral or Blue-Spot Rockcod, Coral Hind, and Coral Grouper, is a common and popular fish along the coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific, and it makes a most spectacular addition to a large home aquarium. In the wild, it can attain sizes up to 18", but tank specimens rarely exceed a foot in length. The Miniatus Grouper is a large and very hardy fish which requires a large aquarium of 180 gallons or more when full grown. It can be compatible with other fish provided they are too large to be eaten. It should not be trusted around invertebrates or small fish. In the wild this reef predator commonly attacks schools of reef-dwelling fish. In the aquarium, freeze-dried krill soaked in Selcon, feeder goldfish, or squid are acceptable.
products.description_zh: 迷你石斑鱼，也称为迷你石斑鱼、珊瑚或蓝点石斑鱼、珊瑚鹿和珊瑚石斑鱼，是印度太平洋珊瑚礁中常见且受欢迎的鱼类，它为大型家庭水族箱增添了最壮观的色彩。在野外，它的尺寸可达 18 英寸，但水箱标本的长度很少超过一英尺。迷你石斑鱼是一种大型且非常耐寒的鱼类，完全长大后需要 180 加仑或更多的大型水族箱。只要它们太大而无法食用，它就可以与其他鱼类兼容。在无脊椎动物或小鱼周围不应信任它。在野外，这种珊瑚礁捕食者通常会攻击珊瑚礁鱼类群。水族馆、浸泡在 Selcon 中的冻干磷虾、饲养金鱼或鱿鱼都是可以接受的。

products.title: Gray (Black) Angelfish Juvenile 2.25"
products.description: The adult Gray Black Angelfish, which may also be called the Gray Angelfish, has a gray body with dusky blue polka-dots and the same dusky blue highlights on the caudal, dorsal, and anal fins. The face is a clear, pale silvery-gray. The juvenile is black with yellow stripes. The Gray Black Angelfish is hardy, and can reach a length of 20 inches as an adult. It therefore requires a 250 gallon or larger tank. The tank should contain large amounts of live rock for hiding and grazing. Gray Black Angelfish is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles. A varied diet should be provided which includes Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, and mysis or frozen shrimp. The Small Juvenile will contain the Juvenile colorations or may be color shifting to a young adult, while the Medium will be a sub-adult, and the Large will be in Adult coloration.
products.description_zh: 成年灰黑神仙鱼，也可称为灰神仙鱼，身体呈灰色，带有暗蓝色圆点，尾鳍、背鳍和臀鳍上也有同样的暗蓝色亮点。脸色清晰，呈淡银灰色。幼体呈黑色，带有黄色条纹。灰黑神仙鱼生命力顽强，成年后体长可达 20 英寸。因此需要 250 加仑或更大的水箱。水箱中应含有大量活石，用于隐藏和放牧。灰黑神仙鱼很容易咬食石珊瑚、软珊瑚（无脊椎动物）和蛤壳。应提供多样化的饮食，包括螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、以及糠虾或冷冻虾。小幼体将包含幼体颜色，或者可能会变色为年轻成体，而中体将是亚成体，而大体将是成体颜色。

products.title: Emperor Angelfish Adult 5"
products.description: The adult Emperor Angelfish, also called the Imperator Angelfish, has a bold, blue body covered with bright yellow horizontal stripes culminating in a bright yellow to orange caudal fin. A striking blue-black mask covers the eyes and a similarly-colored vertical band extends from the pectoral fin two-thirds of the way up the body. This band is highlighted in a sapphire-blue in front, and bright yellow, caudally. The mouth is white. The Emperor Angelfish requires a 220 gallon or larger tank with live rock for grazing and hiding. They also require extensive rockwork and deep caves to feel secure. It will nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles, but may be kept with small-polyped stony corals and somewhat noxious soft corals. It should be fed a diet of Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, mysis or frozen shrimp, and other meaty items.
products.description_zh: 成年帝王神仙鱼，也称为帝王神仙鱼，有一个醒目的蓝色身体，上面覆盖着亮黄色的水平条纹，最后是亮黄色到橙色的尾鳍。醒目的蓝黑色面具遮盖了眼睛，一条颜色相似的垂直带从胸鳍延伸到身体三分之二处。该带的前面呈宝石蓝色，尾部呈亮黄色。嘴巴是白色的。帝王神仙鱼需要一个 220 加仑或更大的水箱，并有活石用于放牧和隐藏。他们还需要大量的岩石和深邃的洞穴才能感到安全。它会咬住石珊瑚、软珊瑚（无柄无脊椎动物）和蛤蜊外套膜，但可能会保持机智h 小水螅体石珊瑚和有些有毒的软珊瑚。应喂食螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、糠虾或冷冻虾以及其他肉类食品。

products.title: Multibar Angelfish 3"
products.description: The Multibar Angel, also known as the Many Banded Angelfish and Multibarred Angelfish, has individual black and yellow vertical bands arranged in an "every other" fashion, with a thin stripe of white bordering each black band. The tail is white to yellow with small black speckles. A juvenile can be distinguished by a blue eyespot at the back of the dorsal fin. The Multibar Angel requires a minimum tank size of 70 gallons with plenty of hiding places and live rock for grazing. This angelfish is best kept as the only species member in a tank. The Multibar Angel, like other dwarf angels, are hermaphroditic, difficult to breed, and indistinguishable in color variations from male to female. The Multibar Angel can be a finicky eater; it prefers a variety of small meaty items, angelfish and herbivore preparations, and live sponges. These eating habits and the trait of becoming somewhat territorial upon acclimatization, make this a challenging fish to keep. Please note: We guarantee that ALL aquaria species we offer will arrive alive and in good condition. However, because of the increased level of care required for this particular species, it has been designated as "Expert Only." This spe
products.description_zh: 多条纹天使鱼，也称为多条纹天使鱼和多条纹天使鱼，有单独的黑色和黄色垂直条纹，以“每隔一个”的方式排列，每个黑色条纹周围有一条细细的白色条纹。尾巴呈白色至黄色，带有黑色小斑点。幼鱼可以通过背鳍背面的蓝色眼点来区分。 Multibar Angel 需要至少 70 加仑的水箱，并有足够的藏身之处和可供放牧的活石。这种神仙鱼最好作为水族箱中唯一的物种成员饲养。与其他矮天使一样，多条天使是雌雄同体，难以繁殖，并且雄性和雌性的颜色变化难以区分。他们ultibar Angel 可能是个挑食者；它喜欢各种小肉制品、神仙鱼和草食动物制品以及活海绵。这些饮食习惯以及在适应环境后变得有些领地意识的特征，使得这种鱼很难饲养。请注意：我们保证我们提供的所有水族箱物种在到达时都是活着且状况良好的。然而，由于该特定物种所需的护理水平提高，因此已被指定为“仅限专家”。这个特

products.title: Sleeper Banded Goby 2"
products.description: The Sleeper Banded Goby, also known as the Brownbarred Goby and Bullet Goby, was first discovered in the Indo-Pacific Ocean by Valenciennes in 1837. It has a greenish-yellow head with blue and orange dots and dashes. The remainder of the body is yellow with brown bands. It should be housed in a 30 gallon or larger aquarium with a substrate of loose coral rubble and a tight-fitting lid to prevent it from jumping out of the tank. It will rarely become aggressive towards other fish, but is territorial and will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It feeds on a variety of tiny crustaceans in the substrate as well as filamentous algae. In the home aquarium, offer a varied diet consisting of vitamin-enriched brine shrimp (live or frozen), mysis shrimp, prepared foods for herbivores, as well as nori strips of the aquarium lacks macro algae growth. It should be fed three times per day, depending on the amount of natural live food found within the aquarium.
products.description_zh: 卧带虾虎鱼，也称为棕斑虾虎鱼和子弹虾虎鱼，是瓦朗谢纳于 1837 年在印度太平洋首次发现的。它的头部呈黄绿色，上面有蓝色和橙色的点和划线。身体的其余部分是黄色的，带有棕色条纹。它应该被安置在一个 30 加仑或更大的水族箱中，水族箱的底层是松散的珊瑚碎石，并有一个紧密的盖子，以防止它跳出水箱。它很少会对其他鱼类产生攻击性，但具有领地意识，会与同类发生战斗，除非它们是配对的。它以基质中的各种微小甲壳类动物以及丝状藻类为食。在家庭水族箱中，提供多样化的饮食富含维生素的丰年虾（活的或冷冻的）、糠虾、食草动物的预制食品以及水族箱中的紫菜条缺乏大型藻类的生长。每天应该喂三次，具体取决于水族箱内天然活体食物的数量。

products.title: Dampiera Dottyback 4"
products.description: The Dampiera Dottyback is also known as the Firetail Dottyback, and the Red Dottyback. It is highly variable in coloring with red and yellow being predominate with purple markings on the body. A 75 gallon or larger aquarium with many hiding places provides a good environment. This Pseudochromis should be housed with aggressive fish larger than itself. It will eat ornamental shrimp. The diet consists of meaty foods including brine shrimp and prepared frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 丹皮埃拉斑背犬也被称为火尾斑背犬和红斑背犬。它的颜色变化很大，以红色和黄色为主，身体上有紫色斑纹。 75加仑或更大的水族箱有很多藏身之处，可以提供良好的环境。这种拟色鱼应与比其体型大的攻击性鱼类一起饲养。它会吃观赏虾。饮食包括肉类食物，包括丰年虾和预制冷冻食品。

products.title: Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish
products.description: SAVE 44%! The Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish originates within Lake Tanganyika, Africa. It is silver to gold in color with many black spots arranged in a leopard-like pattern. This species is also known as an upside-down catfish, as it will hang in an inverted position. They are a beautiful catfish and are wonderful scavengers that are not overly aggressive. The Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish will appreciate a fine sandy bottom with large caves and crevices for hiding places in an aquarium of 50 gallons or more. Sensitive to nitrates, good water conditions are necessary. It prefers a current in the aquarium. It can be kept as a schooling fish or in a tank with other Synodontis species. The Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish may also be maintained with most African Cichlids of similar size. The Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish has a rather unusual breeding habit. They will use a pair of surrogate fish as parents to incubate their eggs.
