products.description_zh: 节省 44%！多点鲶鱼起源于非洲坦噶尼喀湖。它的颜色是银色到金色，有许多黑色斑点排列成豹子图案。该物种也被称为倒置鲶鱼，因为它会以倒置的位置悬挂。它们是一种美丽的鲶鱼，也是出色的清道夫，但不太具有攻击性。 Synodontis Multipunctatus Catfish 喜欢在 50 加仑或以上的水族箱中使用带有大洞穴和裂缝的细沙底部作为藏身之处。对硝酸盐敏感，需要良好的水质条件。它更喜欢水族箱中的水流。它可以作为群鱼饲养，也可以与其他 Synodontis 物种一起饲养在水族箱中。多点鲶鱼也可以与大多数大小相似的非洲慈鲷一起饲养。多点鲶鱼有一个相当不寻常的繁殖习性。他们将使用一对代孕鱼作为父母来孵化它们的卵。当一对正在产卵的丽鱼科鱼正在产卵时，这些鲶鱼就会猛冲过来，吃掉刚产下的卵。在此期间，它们会很方便地产下自己的卵，从而使丽鱼科鱼的父母陷入困境。

products.title: Coral Hogfish 4.25"
products.description: The Coral Hogfish, also known as Eclipse Hogfish or Mesothorax Hogfish. Juveniles are burgundy with yellow spots and as they develop into adults they loose the spots and have a burgundy face with rosy-yellow posterior, separated by a black stripe. It is a beneficial fish for cleaning parasites off of its tank mates. The Coral Hogfish needs to be kept in a 70 gallon or larger fish-only tank, or the reef will become its buffet. It is aggressive towards smaller, docile fish that are easily bullied. The mature adult Coral Hogfish will eat snails, worms, mussels, small fish, shrimp, and squid.
products.description_zh: 珊瑚猪鱼，也称为日食猪鱼或中胸猪鱼。幼鱼呈酒红色，带有黄色斑点，当它们发育成成虫时，斑点就会消失，脸呈酒红色，后部呈玫瑰黄色，中间有一条黑色条纹。它是一种有益的鱼，可以清除同伴身上的寄生虫。珊瑚猪鱼需要饲养在 70 加仑或更大的鱼缸中，否则珊瑚礁将成为它的自助餐。它对容易被欺负的较小、温顺的鱼具有攻击性。成熟的珊瑚猪鱼会吃蜗牛、蠕虫、贻贝、小鱼、虾和鱿鱼。

products.title: Fijian Mimic Lemon Peel Tang 3.5"
products.description: The Mimic Lemon Peel Tang, also known as the Mimic Surgeon, or Chocolate Surgeonfish, has an oval, yellow body while a juvenile. It has blue highlights around the eyes and gill covers, mimicking the Lemonpeel Angelfish ( Centropyge flavissimus ). (Many of the Acanthurus sp. mimic angelfish.) When mature, the body color darkens towards tan with red highlights forming around the eyes and pectoral fins. The dorsal, anal, and caudal fins take on the hues of green but remain tipped with the tan body color. A 130 gallon or larger aquarium with large amounts of live rock is necessary to provide both plenty of swimming room, and territories within the live rock. It is aggressive towards other Tangs and Surgeonfish, but is peaceful with other fish. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. products.description_zh: 拟态柠檬皮唐鱼，也被称为拟态外科医生或巧克力外科医生鱼，幼鱼时有椭圆形、黄色的身体。它的眼睛和鳃盖周围有蓝色亮点，模仿柠檬皮神仙鱼（Centropyge flavissimus）。 （许多 Acanthurus sp. 模仿神仙鱼。）成熟时，身体颜色变暗为棕褐色，眼睛和胸鳍周围形成红色亮点。背鳍、臀鳍和尾鳍呈绿色，但尖端仍保持棕褐色的体色。需要有大量活石的 130 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳池和活石内的区域。它对其他唐族具有攻击性和刺尾鱼，但与其他鱼类和平相处。虽然唐鱼和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。这些阿

products.title: Bicolor Goatfish 3.25"
products.description: The Bicolor Goatfish has a burgundy anterior and yellow posterior divided by a white band. There is a black dot on the posterior portion and a pair of white stripes on the anterior portion giving it the name Dash and Dot Goatfish. Both head and tail also have blue markings. Goatfish are relatively new to the hobby, but fast growing in popularity. If you’re looking for the unexpected, consider the Bicolor Goatfish. These hardy characters introduce energetic activity to the aquarium bottom as they actively patrol the sand bed to satisfy their appetites, making them a unique addition to your aquarium. An established 125 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of swimming room is recommended, and it needs non-aggressive tank mates. The bottom of the aquarium should have a moderate substrate layer so the Bicolor Goatfish may use its barbels to sift through the substrate in search of food (invertebrates, small crustaceans, worms). Because it eats the invertebrates, the nitrogen load capacity of the sand will be reduced and it will be well-oxygenated due to the sifting. Goatfish prefer to be housed with less aggressive tank mates. The diet should consist of fresh or frozen meaty preparation
products.description_zh: 双色山羊鱼的前部是酒红色的，后部是黄色的，中间被一条白色的带子分开。后部有一个黑点，前部有一对白色条纹，因此得名“点点山羊鱼”。头部和尾部也有蓝色斑纹。鲣鱼对于这项爱好来说相对较新，但越来越受欢迎。如果您正在寻找意想不到的东西，请考虑双色鲣鱼。这些顽强的角色为水族箱底部带来了充满活力的活力，因为它们积极地巡逻沙床以满足自己的食欲，使它们成为您的水族箱的独特补充。建议使用 125 加仑或更大且有充足游泳池的水族箱，并且它需要非攻击性的坦克伙伴。水族箱底部应有适中的基质层，以便双色鲣鱼可以使用其触须筛选基质来寻找食物（无脊椎动物、小型甲壳类动物、蠕虫）。由于它吃无脊椎动物，沙子的氮负载能力会降低，并且由于筛分而氧化良好。鲣鱼更喜欢与攻击性较小的同伴一起饲养。饮食应包括新鲜或冷冻肉制品

products.title: Green Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral 2.25"
products.description: The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral is referred to as Sarcophyton Coral, Mushroom, Leather, or Trough Corals. They are found in various shades of brown, tan or green, with white or gold polyps. It is difficult to identify many species because they all have the similar appearance of a mushroom or toadstool, each with a distinct stalk and capitulum (cap). As they grow older, they develop a folded appearance. The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals are relatively peaceful, but adequate space should be provided between them and other corals in the reef aquarium. Some can produce toxins which are harmful to other reef inhabitants. The brown Sarcophyton Leather Corals from Idonesia and Tonga are easy to maintain in the reef aquarium and make an excellent coral for the beginning through expert reef aquarist. Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals require medium to high lighting combined with medium to strong water movement. For continued good health, they will also require the addition of iodine, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Culturing by the experienced hobbyist is often accomplished by cutting off a portion of the Coral's crown and attaching that piece to live rock or plac
products.description_zh: 毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚被称为肉藻珊瑚、蘑菇、皮革或槽珊瑚。它们呈各种深浅的棕色、棕褐色或绿色，有白色或金色的息肉。许多物种很难识别，因为它们都具有蘑菇或伞菌的相似外观，每种都有独特的茎和头状花序（帽子）。随着年龄的增长，它们会出现折叠的外观。伞菌皮珊瑚相对安静，但它们与珊瑚礁水族箱中的其他珊瑚之间应提供足够的空间。有些会产生对其他珊瑚礁居民有害的毒素。来自印度尼西亚和汤加的棕色肉藻皮珊瑚很常见sy 在珊瑚礁水族箱中进行维护，并通过专业的珊瑚礁水族师在开始时制作出优质的珊瑚。毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚需要中到高的光照以及中到强的水流。为了持续保持身体健康，他们还需要在水中添加碘、锶和其他微量元素。经验丰富的爱好者通常通过切下珊瑚冠的一部分并将其固定在活石或平台上来完成培养

products.title: Plate Coral - Short Tentacle 3"
products.description: The Short Tentacle Plate Coral is a coral that originates from the Indo Pacific. These corals are found free living within the rubble zones of the reef, and have the ability to inflate themselves to both maximize light exposure, and to keep from being covered in sand. It is a solitary, semi-aggressive coral with shorter tentacles than its cousin the Long Tentacle Plate Coral (Fungia sp.) . Even with short tentacles, it can still damage other corals that it comes in contact with. With placement in the aquarium, keep in mind that it will often inflate itself with water and expand to twice its size. It will do best on the bottom of a reef aquarium, preferably lying on a fine sandy substrate. The Short Tentacle Plate Coral is easy to maintain in the reef aquarium and makes an excellent candidate for the beginner reef aquarist. Care should be taken in handling it however, to prevent damage. It requires moderate lighting combined with moderate water movement within the aquarium. products.title: Bicolor Goatfish 3.25"
products.description: The Bicolor Goatfish has a burgundy anterior and yellow posterior divided by a white band. There is a black dot on the posterior portion and a pair of white stripes on the anterior portion giving it the name Dash and Dot Goatfish. Both head and tail also have blue markings. Goatfish are relatively new to the hobby, but fast growing in popularity. If you’re looking for the unexpected, consider the Bicolor Goatfish. These hardy characters introduce energetic activity to the aquarium bottom as they actively patrol the sand bed to satisfy their appetites, making them a unique addition to your aquarium. An established 125 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of swimming room is recommended, and it needs non-aggressive tank mates. The bottom of the aquarium should have a moderate substrate layer so the Bicolor Goatfish may use its barbels to sift through the substrate in search of food (invertebrates, small crustaceans, worms). Because it eats the invertebrates, the nitrogen load capacity of the sand will be reduced and it will be well-oxygenated due to the sifting. Goatfish prefer to be housed with less aggressive tank mates. The diet should consist of fresh or frozen meaty preparation

products.description: The Blue Green Reef Chromis is easy to care for, beautiful, and peaceful. In fact, Chromis viridis is one of the preferred marine reef fish amongst aquarists, regardless of their experience level. This member of the Pomacentridae family is most recognizable by its gorgeous light blue dorsal side that slowly fades into a majestic pale green belly. The Blue Green Reef Chromis is desirable not only for its beauty, but also for its peaceful demeanor (despite its designation as a true damselfish) and ability to be kept with almost all other community fish, invertebrates, and corals. Native to reefs ranging from mid-depth to shallow lagoons of the Indo-Pacific and South Pacific, wild specimens prefer to school in large shoals amongst branching corals like Acropora. In the home aquarium, the Blue Green Reef Chromis does best in similar environments and will actively swim at all levels of the aquarium water column. In fact, small schools of the Blue Green Reef Chromis add a dazzling and dramatic shimmer of beauty to almost any well-established reef system. products.title: Tube Anemone
products.description: The Tube Anemone is also referred to as the Tube Dwelling Anemone, and is best kept in a reef or species-only aquarium with a soft, deep substrate. It is actually a distant relative of the true sea anemone. It creates its tube from the nematocysts that it has discharged. Their coloration is highly variable and can range from tan, pink, purple or even have shades of fluorescent green. The ideal aquarium for the Tube Anemone is one with a deep sand bed, plenty of live rock and a refugium for a natural food source. They are non-photosynthetic and do not require intense lighting. In fact, they are nocturnal in nature and will take time to begin to open during the illuminated hours. Because they are not photosynthetic, they need to be fed regularly when it is fully expanded. Feed small frozen foods such as brine or mysis shrimp, chopped pieces of fish and zooplankton. Approximate Purchase Size: Medium: 3" to 4"
products.description_zh: 管状海葵也被称为管状海葵，最好饲养在珊瑚礁或具有柔软、深层基质的纯物种水族箱中。它实际上是真正的海葵的远亲。它用排出的线虫囊形成管子。它们的颜色变化很大，可以是棕褐色、粉红色、紫色，甚至还有荧光绿色。管状海葵的理想水族箱是一个拥有深厚沙床、大量活石和天然食物来源的避难所的水族箱。它们不进行光合作用，不需要强光。事实上，它们本质上是夜间活动的，在有照明的时间内需要一段时间才能开始开放。因为他们不进行光合作用，完全展开后需要定期喂食。喂食小型冷冻食品，如盐水虾或糠虾、切碎的鱼片和浮游动物。大约购买尺寸：中号：3 英寸至 4 英寸

products.title: Blue Tang
products.description: New to the hobby? Blue Tangs are best cared for in aquariums at least 6 feet in length by experienced marine (saltwater) aquarists. If you're a beginner, we recommend a similar-looking fish such as the Marine (Saltwater) Yellowtail Damselfish or Freshwater Boesemani Rainbow. The Blue Tang boasts a vibrant electric blue body dressed with bold black markings. In fact, the black that begins at the eyes, traces the dorsal line down to the tail, and circles back above the pectoral fin to create a unique shape reminiscent of a painter's palette. This marking is why the Blue Tang is also known as the Palette Surgeonfish. It is also called the Pacific Blue Tang, and Hepatus or Regal Tang. Regardless of common name, Paracanthurus hepatus is equal parts beauty and peacefulness that suits almost any large community marine aquarium. Native to reefs across the Indo-Pacific, the Blue Tang relishes a good hiding location amongst live rock. However, this active fish also loves to swim. Therefore, ample room to roam around your aquarium is essential for optimum health. Though peaceful towards most tankmates, the Pacific Blue will become aggressive towards other fish of its own species. To keep mult
products.description_zh: 新的爱好？蓝唐鱼最好由经验丰富的海洋（咸水）水族箱饲养员在长度至少 6 英尺的水族箱中进行护理。如果您是初学者，我们推荐外观相似的鱼，例如海洋（咸水）黄尾雀鲷或淡水波塞马尼彩虹鱼。蓝唐拥有充满活力的电蓝色车身，并饰有醒目的黑色斑纹。事实上，黑色从眼睛开始，沿着背线一直延伸到尾巴，然后回到胸鳍上方，形成一个独特的形状，让人想起画家的调色板。这种标记就是蓝唐鱼也被称为调色板刺尾鱼的原因。它也被称为太平洋蓝唐、赫帕图斯或帝王唐。不管Paracanthurus hepatus 的俗名是美丽与宁静，几乎适合任何大型社区海洋水族馆。蓝唐丹原产于印度洋-太平洋的珊瑚礁，在活岩中是一个很好的藏身之处。然而，这种活跃的鱼也喜欢游泳。因此，在水族箱周围有足够的空间漫步对于最佳健康至关重要。尽管太平洋蓝对大多数同伴都很温和，但对其同种的其他鱼类却会变得具有攻击性。为了保持多

products.title: Green Long Tentacle Anemone 3.5"
products.description: The Long Tentacle Anemone is also referred to as the Corkscrew Anemone, Sand Anemone, Red Base Anemone, and Long Tentacle Red Base Anemone. It has a similar appearance to Heteractis crispa , which has more tentacles and a tougher column. Its oral disc is usually visible and can grow up to 20" in diameter. Its tentacles are spaced further apart than other similar anemones. It is found in various forms and color patterns, but its base is usually orange to red. It is a host to clownfish, usually Amphiprion perideraion and A. clarki . The Long Tentacle Anemone requires an aquarium with 4 inches of sand or rubble substrate in which it can hide. The diet should include small pieces of fish or mussel, crustaceans, and frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 长触手海葵也称为螺旋海葵、沙海葵、红基海葵和长触手红基海葵。它的外观与Heteractis Cripa相似，具有更多的触手和更坚韧的柱体。它的口盘通常是可见的，直径可达 20 英寸。它的触手间隔比其他类似的海葵更远。它有各种形式和颜色图案，但它的底部通常是橙色到红色。它是小丑鱼的宿主，通常是 Amphiprion perideraion 和 A. clarki。长触手海葵需要一个有 4 英寸厚的沙子或瓦砾基质的水族箱，它可以隐藏在其中。饮食应包括小块鱼或混乱el、甲壳类动物和冷冻食品。

products.title: Sebae Anemone 4"
products.description: Heteractis malu is known as the Sebae or Leather Anemone. It was previously named Radianthus keukenthali . Heteractis crispa may also be called the Sebae Anemone. Heteractis malu is usually light tan to brown in color and may have purple tips on its tentacles. Acclimation to aquarium life can be very difficult for this species and its care should only be attempted by the most experienced aquarists. In the aquarium it requires strong lighting, porous live rock, and a variety of sandy and rocky locations from which it can choose to live. The addition of a Clownfish, such as the Blue Striped Clown, Amphiprion chrysopterus , will immediately help with its acclimatization and improve its chances of survival. When healthy, it will become very sticky. If it grasps onto something (or someone), it will be very difficult to convince it to let go without damaging it. Once acclimated, it should be fed a diet of fish, worms, clams, shrimp, and other meaty foods once a week.
products.description_zh: Heteractis malu 被称为 Sebae 或皮革海葵。它以前被命名为 Radianthus keukenthali。 Heteractis Cripa 也可称为 Sebae Anemone。 Heteractis malu 的颜色通常为浅棕褐色至棕色，触手上可能有紫色尖端。对于这个物种来说，适应水族箱生活可能非常困难，只有最有经验的水族爱好者才能尝试照顾它。在水族箱中，它需要强烈的光照、多孔的活石以及各种沙质和岩石位置供它选择居住。添加小丑鱼，例如蓝条纹小丑、金翅双足鱼，将立即帮助其适应环境并提高其机会的生存。健康时，它会变得非常粘。如果它抓住某物（或某人），就很难说服它在不损坏它的情况下放手。一旦适应了环境，应每周喂一次鱼、虫、蛤、虾和其他肉类食物。

products.title: Haddon's Carpet Anemone 3.5"
products.description: The Haddon's Carpet Anemone lives singly, in the shallow waters of the Indo Pacific and Red Sea. Found outside of the reef it resides in soft muddy or sandy substrate and can attain a size of up to 3 feet in diameter. This colorful Anemone is also referred to as Haddon’s Anemone, Saddle Anemone, Saddle Carpet Anemone, or Saddleback Anemone. Haddon's Carpet Anemone have short, blunt tentacles with a very potent sting, and can be distinguished from their close relatives Stichodactyla gigantea and Stichodactyla mertensii by the lack of any coloration, spots or markings on the underside of the anemone and down its column. This anemone serves as a "host" for many types of Clownfish in the wild including: Amphiprion clarkii, A. sebae, A. akindynos, A. chrysogaster, A. chrysopterus, and A. polymnus. In the home aquarium, they can also serve as host for Amphiprion ocellaris, A. percula, and A. allardi. The Haddon's Carpet Anemone requires a tank with strong lighting and good water movement. The aquarium should have a variety of sandy and rocky locations as this animal oftentimes can move about and seek refuge in a place it prefers. This species of Haddon's Carpet Anemone prefers to bury it
products.description_zh: 哈顿地毯海葵单独生活在印度太平洋和红海的浅水区。它发现于珊瑚礁之外，栖息在柔软的泥质或沙质基质中，直径可达 3 英尺。这种色彩缤纷的海葵也被称为哈顿海葵、马鞍海葵、马鞍地毯海葵或马鞍海葵。哈登地毯海葵的触手短而钝，具有很强的刺痛能力，并且可以通过海葵底部和柱子下方没有任何颜色、斑点或标记来与它们的近亲 Stichodactyla gigantea 和 Stichodactyla mertensii 区分开来。这种海葵是许多野生小丑鱼的“宿主”包括：克氏双虾、sebae、A. akindynos、A. chrysogaster、A. chrysopterus 和 A. polymnus。在家庭水族箱中，它们还可以作为双眼双足鱼（Amphiprion ocellaris）、鲈鱼（A. percula）和阿拉迪双足鱼（A. allardi）的宿主。哈登地毯海葵需要一个光线充足、水流良好的水箱。水族馆应该有各种沙地和岩石位置，因为这种动物经常可以在它喜欢的地方四处走动并寻求庇护。这种哈登地毯海葵喜欢将其埋葬

products.title: Orange Angler 2.75"
products.description: The Orange Anglers are red/orange in color, with several black markings covering parts of the body, such as the fins. They can change the tone of their coloration to blend with the surrounding environment over time. They require large amounts of live rock in a 30-gallon or larger aquarium. These fish are very inactive, but make sure to provide a suitable sized aquarium for them as they grow to full size. A 30-gallon aquarium is sufficient for a fully-grown specimen. When first introduced into the aquarium, live saltwater feeder shrimp should be used to entice this fish to eat. An angler may eat any small inhabitant of the aquarium (crustacean or fish) that is lured into its mouth with the use of an esca (modified first dorsal spine) that looks like a small, tasty fish. In fact, these fish can even swallow prey their own size! It will accept most meaty meals including feeder fish.
products.description_zh: 橙色钓鱼者的颜色为红色/橙色，身体的某些部位（例如鳍）上有一些黑色斑纹。随着时间的推移，它们可以改变自己的色调以与周围环境融为一体。它们需要在 30 加仑或更大的水族箱中放置大量活石。这些鱼非常不活跃，但当它们长到最大尺寸时，请确保为它们提供合适大小的水族箱。一个 30 加仑的水族箱足以容纳一个完全长大的标本。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活的咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。钓鱼者可能会吃掉水族馆里任何被我们引诱到嘴里的小居民（甲壳类动物或鱼）。esca（改良的第一背刺）的 esca，看起来像一条美味的小鱼。事实上，这些鱼甚至可以吞下与自己大小相同的猎物！它可以接受大多数肉类食物，包括喂食鱼。

products.title: Two Spot Bristletooth Tang 5.25"
products.description: The Two Spot Bristletooth Tang is a colorful orange-brown fish with blue lines. It also has blue spots on its head and 2 black spots at the base of its dorsal and anal fins. This beautiful fish will make an excellent addition to your reef aquarium. A 70 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. It is aggressive towards other Tangs, but peaceful with other fish. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine-based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression, and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use.
products.description_zh: 二斑刚齿唐鱼是一种色彩缤纷的橙棕色鱼，带有蓝色线条。它的头部也有蓝色斑点，背鳍和臀鳍基部有 2 个黑色斑点。这种美丽的鱼将为您的珊瑚礁水族箱增添一抹亮色。需要 70 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳空间。它对其他唐鱼具有攻击性，但对其他鱼却很和平。虽然唐鱼会和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉食，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性，并改善他们的整体健康状况。提供绑在岩石上的干海藻或使用蔬菜夹子，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。

products.title: Bulgarian Seal Point Angel
products.description: The Bulgarian Sea Point Angelfish is an elegant and highly sought-after freshwater angelfish variety, prized for its striking contrast and graceful finnage. Its body displays a soft silver to pearl-white coloration, accented by dramatic dark chocolate to black markings on the dorsal, anal, and caudal fins. As the fish matures, the dark "Sea Point" pattern becomes more pronounced, creating a stunning visual contrast that makes this angelfish a standout centerpiece in any freshwater aquarium. It prefers a well-planted aquarium of at least 30 gallons with soft, slightly acidic water. Driftwood, rockwork, and aquatic plants help create a natural environment, but ample open swimming space should be maintained to accommodate its tall body shape and graceful movements. When breeding Bulgarian Sea Point Angelfish, it is best to raise a group together and allow pairs to form naturally. Once a compatible pair has bonded, provide a flat spawning surface such as a broad plant leaf, slate, or an angled flowerpot. The female will deposit eggs on the chosen surface, followed by the male fertilizing them. The eggs typically hatch within three days, and the fry become free-swimming several days lat
products.description_zh: The Bulgarian Sea Point Angelfish is an elegant and highly sought-after freshwater angelfish variety, prized for its striking contrast and graceful finnage.它的身体呈柔和的银色到珍珠白色，背鳍、臀鳍和尾鳍上有引人注目的黑巧克力色到黑色斑纹。随着鱼的成熟，深色的“海点”图案变得更加明显，形成令人惊叹的视觉对比，使这种神仙鱼成为任何淡水水族箱中的佼佼者。它更喜欢种植良好、至少有 30 加仑、软水、微酸性水的水族箱。浮木、岩石和水生植物有助于创造自然环境，但充足的开放游泳空间应该保持以适应其高大的体形和优雅的动作。 When breeding Bulgarian Sea Point Angelfish, it is best to raise a group together and allow pairs to form naturally. Once a compatible pair has bonded, provide a flat spawning surface such as a broad plant leaf, slate, or an angled flowerpot.雌性会将卵产在选定的表面上，然后雄性使它们受精。 The eggs typically hatch within three days, and the fry become free-swimming several days lat

products.title: Asfur Angelfish
products.description: The Asfur Angelfish is also called the Arabian Angelfish, or Crescent Angelfish. Originating in the Red Sea, but also found in the Indo-Pacific, the Asfur has a dark blue/purple body, black face, yellow tail, and a predominant yellow crescent bisecting the body vertically. Often confused with Pomacanthus maculosus , the Asfur Angelfish has a bright yellow tail. As with some other Pomacanthus , the coloration of the juvenile differs markedly from the adult. A shy fish that does best when not kept with other Asfurs due to territorial behavior, the Asfur Angel requires a minimum of a 150 gallon tank with numerous hiding places and live rock for grazing. The Asfur Angelfish is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles, but may be kept with small polyped stony corals and somewhat noxious soft corals. All Angelfish are hermaphroditic. The Asfur Angelfish is indistinguishable from male to female and very difficult to breed in an aquarium. In a restricted reef environment, the Asfur requires a diet of vegetables, meats, and angelfish preparations containing spongiform products. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2-1/4"; Small/Medium: 2-1/4" to 3";
products.description_zh: 阿斯福神仙鱼也称为阿拉伯神仙鱼或新月神仙鱼。阿斯福尔原产于红海，但也见于印度太平洋，其身体呈深蓝色/紫色，脸部黑色，尾巴黄色，主要的黄色新月形将身体垂直一分为二。阿斯福神仙鱼经常与 Pomacanthus maculosus 混淆，它有一条亮黄色的尾巴。与其他一些长尾草一样，幼体的颜色与成体明显不同。阿斯福天使是一种害羞的鱼，由于领地行为，最好不要与其他阿斯福鱼一起饲养，阿斯福天使需要至少 150 加仑的水箱，并有许多藏身之处和可供放牧的活石。阿斯福神仙鱼很容易被咬住ony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles, but may be kept with small polyped stony corals and somewhat noxious soft corals.所有神仙鱼都是雌雄同体。 The Asfur Angelfish is indistinguishable from male to female and very difficult to breed in an aquarium. In a restricted reef environment, the Asfur requires a diet of vegetables, meats, and angelfish preparations containing spongiform products.大约购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2-1/4 英寸；小/中：2-1/4" 至 3"；

products.title: True Percula Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Percula Clownfish, also known as the True Percula, or Clown Anemonefish, is normally found in association with anemones on the reefs of Oceania, the Indo-Pacific, and the Great Barrier Reef. It can be found individually, or more commonly, in pairs or small groups within the same anemone such as Heteractis magnifica or Stichodactyla mertensii . Captive-Bred Percula Clownfish are usually mostly orange and white when young. As the fish matures the black sections between the white stripes will darken with age. Captive-Bred specimens differ from their wild-caught counterparts in that their stripes are often irregular. These characteristics add to the uniqueness and appeal of these fish. The Ocellaris Clownfish is often confused with the Percula Clownfish. Unless you are experienced with both fish, they are difficult to tell apart. The True Percula is a very bright orange, whereas, the Ocellaris tends to be more drably colored. The Percula Clownfish also has a thicker black outline to its white body stripes. Their beautiful colors and likable personalities make them a wonderful addition to reef aquariums. Captive-bred clownfish are very hardy and durable fish making them a perfect ad
products.description_zh: 鲈鱼小丑鱼，也称为真正的鲈鱼或小丑海葵鱼，通常与大洋洲、印度太平洋和大堡礁的珊瑚礁上的海葵一起被发现。它可以单独出现，或更常见的是，在同一海葵中成对或小群出现，例如 Heteractis magnifica 或 Stichodactyla mertensii。人工饲养的小丑鱼幼年时通常呈橙色和白色。随着鱼的成熟，白色条纹之间的黑色部分会随着年龄的增长而变暗。人工饲养的标本与野生捕获的标本不同，它们的条纹通常是不规则的。这些特征增加了这些鱼的独特性和吸引力。奥cellaris 小丑鱼经常与 Percula 小丑鱼混淆。除非您对这两种鱼都有经验，否则很难区分它们。 True Percula 是一种非常明亮的橙色，而 Ocellaris 的颜色往往比较沉闷。鲈鱼小丑鱼的白色身体条纹上也有较粗的黑色轮廓。它们美丽的色彩和可爱的个性使它们成为珊瑚礁水族馆的绝妙补充。人工饲养的小丑鱼是非常耐寒和耐久的鱼，这使得它们成为完美的广告

products.title: Midnight Ocellaris Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Captive-Bred Midnight Ocellaris Clownfish is entirely black with a yellow/orange nose and face. This unique color variety of the popular Ocellaris Clownfish lacks the three white bands and makes a striking addition to the home aquarium. This member of the Pomacentridae family is an excellent addition to almost any saltwater aquarium system. Captive-bred fish have a unique advantage over wild-harvested species, as they are generally very hardy and more accustomed to conditions found in the home aquarium. Therefore, captive-bred fishes make a great choice for novices and seasoned aquarists alike. The Captive-Bred Midnight Ocellaris is easy to breed in the home aquarium. The females will be the largest of the pair and the two fish will usually stay close to each other in the aquarium. Clownfish are egg layers and will deposit the eggs on a flat surface and defend the eggs from other tank mates. The eggs will normally hatch in 8-11 days depending on the water temperature. The fry must be reared in a separate aquarium on a diet of rotifers followed by baby brine shrimp. This Clownfish is an aggressive eater. It will accept most meaty foods and frozen herbivore preparations. Approxim
products.description_zh: 圈养的午夜眼小丑鱼全身黑色，鼻子和脸呈黄色/橙色。这种流行的 Ocellaris 小丑鱼的独特颜色品种没有三个白色条纹，为家庭水族箱增添了引人注目的色彩。这种 Pomacentridae 家族的成员是几乎所有咸水水族箱系统的绝佳补充。人工饲养的鱼类比野生捕捞的鱼类具有独特的优势，因为它们通常非常耐寒，并且更适应家庭水族箱中的条件。因此，圈养鱼类对于新手和经验丰富的鱼友来说都是一个不错的选择。圈养繁殖的午夜眼珠藻很容易在家庭水族箱中繁殖。雌性将是最大的一对和两条鱼通常会在水族箱中保持靠近。小丑鱼是产蛋鱼，会将鱼卵产在平坦的表面上，并保护鱼卵免受其他鱼缸同伴的侵害。卵通常会在 8-11 天孵化，具体取决于水温。鱼苗必须在单独的水族箱中饲养，以轮虫为食，然后是丰年虾幼虫。这条小丑鱼的食性极强。它可以接受大多数肉类食物和冷冻草食动物制剂。近似值

products.title: Dusky Tilefish 4.75"
products.description: The Dusky Tilefish is also known as the Pastel Tilefish, and Bluehead Tilefish. The head of this fish is blue, and the body a pale yellow. A hardy fish, it needs a tank of at least 50 gallons with at least 3 inches of mixed substrate for burrowing, and a tight-fitting lid to prevent escape. It prefers to associate with members of its own species as tank mates and needs a lot of swimming room for its very active lifestyle. A diet providing a variety of marine fish, crustacean flesh, and mysis or brine shrimp will give the Dusky Tilefish the nutrition it needs when fed three times per day.
products.description_zh: 暗色方头鱼也称为粉彩方头鱼和蓝头方头鱼。这条鱼的头是蓝色的，身体是淡黄色的。作为一种耐寒的鱼，它需要一个至少 50 加仑的水箱，其中至少有 3 英寸的混合基质用于挖洞，以及一个严密的盖子以防止逃跑。它更喜欢与自己物种的成员作为坦克伙伴交往，并且需要大量的游泳池来适应其非常活跃的生活方式。每天喂食三次的暗色方头鱼，其饮食中含有各种海鱼、甲壳类动物的肉、糠虾或丰年虾，即可为暗色方头鱼提供所需的营养。

products.title: Blue Life™ Clear FX Pro
products.description: * Advanced all-in-one chemical filter media for aquariums of all sizes * Blend of super carbon, hybrid phosphate &; organic scavenger resin * Rapidly removes organic pollutants to keep aquariums cleaner longer Blue Life Clear FX Pro offers aquarists of all skill levels the most advanced and comprehensive filter media for freshwater, saltwater, and reef aquariums of all sizes. This proprietary chemical filter media blend combines a coal-based granular activated carbon, hybrid phosphate resin, and organic scavenger resin (controls ammonia, nitrate, and nitrite) to help ensure long-lasting health, clarity, and stability of your aquarium. Blue Life Clear FX Pro effectively targets and removes organics and other toxins, while leaving behind essential trace elements necessary for the vitality of your aquarium. It also removes harmful phosphates that cause algae growth and coral recession. Blue Life Clear FX Pro will not release organics back into your aquarium once exhausted. Simply place the included mesh filter bag in your canister filter, hang-on filter, or a high-flow area of your sump to keep your aquarium water clean, clear, and healthy for months. Blue Life Clear FX Pro Treats 225

products.title: BlueLife™ Red Cyano Rx
products.description: * Quickly treat disease-causing Cyano bacteria in your saltwater aquarium * When used as directed, Blue Life Red Cyano Rx will not harm aquarium inhabitants * Convenient Red Cyano treatment will not discolor aquarium water Blue Life Red Cyano Rx quickly, effectively treats disease-causing Cyano bacteria found on live rock, live coral, and live sand in your saltwater aquarium. When used as directed, reef-safe Blue Life Red Cyano Rx will not harm aquarium inhabitants (including beneficial bacteria) or discolor your aquarium water. 2g (.07 oz) treats 400 gallons. Directions for use For best results, siphon out as much Cyano bacteria as possible from your aquarium. Remove 1 cup of water from your aquarium. Mix 1 level scoop of Blue Life Red Cyano Rx in the cup for every 10 gallons (37.9 liters) of water in your aquarium. Dissolve thoroughly and pour solution into the aquarium. Note: The pH in your aquarium should be greater than 8.0 before you begin adding Blue Life Red Cyano Rx. You will need to discontinue the use of carbon, protein skimming, and ozone during the treatment period. The best time to start treatment is in the morning, when lighting first comes on. Do not dose in the eve

products.title: Bluespot Butterflyfish
products.description: The Bluespot Butterflyfish is a strikingly beautiful member of the Chaetodontidae family prized for its vibrant yellow body and brilliant iridescent blue blotch along the flanks. Delicate horizontal striping, a bold black eye band, and a false eyespot near the tail combine to create an elegant and highly recognizable appearance that makes this species a standout addition to larger marine aquariums. Native to the Indo-Pacific region, the Bluespot Butterflyfish inhabits coral-rich lagoons and outer reef slopes where it is commonly observed swimming alone or in pairs among rockwork and coral formations. Juveniles have even been observed acting as cleaner fish in the wild by removing parasites from larger reef fish. The Bluespot Butterflyfish is generally peaceful and should be housed with other non-aggressive tankmates. Though hardy for a butterflyfish species, it is not considered reef safe as it may nip at soft corals, stony corals, tube worms, ornamental shrimp, and anemones. Larger aquariums with ample swimming space and established rockwork are recommended. The Bluespot Butterflyfish requires a varied diet consisting of vitamin-enriched brine shrimp, mysis shrimp, spirulina, mari
products.description_zh: 蓝斑蝴蝶鱼是毛齿鱼科的一种非常美丽的成员，因其充满活力的黄色身体和沿着侧面的绚丽虹彩蓝色斑点而备受推崇。精致的水平条纹、醒目的黑色眼带和尾部附近的假眼斑结合在一起，创造出优雅且高度可识别的外观，使该物种成为大型海洋水族馆中的佼佼者。蓝斑蝴蝶鱼原产于印度-太平洋地区，栖息在珊瑚丰富的泻湖和外礁斜坡上，经常可以看到它单独或成对地在岩石和珊瑚丛中游泳。人们甚至观察到，幼鱼在野外可以充当清洁鱼，清除体内的寄生虫。rom larger reef fish.蓝斑蝴蝶鱼通常很安静，应该与其他非攻击性的同伴一起饲养。虽然蝴蝶鱼的生命力很强，但它并不被认为是珊瑚礁安全的，因为它可能会咬食软珊瑚、石珊瑚、管虫、观赏虾和海葵。建议使用具有充足游泳空间和固定岩石的较大水族箱。蓝斑蝴蝶鱼需要多样化的饮食，包括富含维生素的丰年虾、糠虾、螺旋藻、海藻

products.title: Xanthurus Cream Angelfish 4"
products.description: The Xanthurus Cream Angelfish is also referred to as the Indian Yellowtail Angelfish, Cream Angelfish, or Yellowtail Black Angelfish. True to its Latin name, the caudal fin is yellow. The dorsal fin is outlined with a silvery-white line. The Xanthurus Cream Angelfish adapts readily to aquarium life. It requires a minimum of a 125 gallon tank or larger with lots of hiding places and live rock for grazing will offer an environment in which to thrive. It is prone to nip at stony and soft corals (sessile invertebrates) and clam mantles. Only one specimen should be kept per tank. It is hermaphroditic, and there are no distinguishing features which differentiate males from females. As with other angelfish, the diet should include Spirulina , marine algae, high-quality angelfish preparations, mysis or frozen shrimp, and other meaty items.
products.description_zh: Xanthurus 奶油神仙鱼也称为印度黄尾神仙鱼、奶油神仙鱼或黄尾黑神仙鱼。顾名思义，尾鳍是黄色的。背鳍有银白色线勾勒。 Xanthurus 奶油神仙鱼很容易适应水族箱的生活​​。它至少需要一个 125 加仑或更大的水箱，并有许多藏身之处和可供放牧的活石，将为它提供一个茁壮成长的环境。它很容易咬食石珊瑚、软珊瑚（无柄无脊椎动物）和蛤蜊外套膜。每个水箱只能保留一个样本。它是雌雄同体，没有区分男性和女性的区别特征。与其他一个神仙鱼的饮食应包括螺旋藻、海藻、优质神仙鱼制剂、糠虾或冷冻虾以及其他肉类食品。

products.title: Bucktooth Parrotfish 3.5"
products.description: The name, "Parrotfish" comes from the shape of the mouth. The teeth are fused together to form a "beak" that resembles a parrot's. A 180 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of swimming room is required, due to its size. The aquarium should contain live rock and hard corals (skeletons are acceptable). The Bicolor Parrotfish will eat algae off the corals and rocks, and chew on the hard corals to eat the animals within. The diet should be supplemented with a variety of herbivore preparations, flaked foods, and meaty preparations.
products.description_zh: “鹦嘴鱼”这个名字来源于嘴巴的形状。牙齿融合在一起形成一个类似于鹦鹉的“喙”。由于其尺寸，需要 180 加仑或更大的水族箱，并有足够的游泳池。水族箱应含有活石和硬珊瑚（骨骼也可以）。双色鹦嘴鱼会吃珊瑚和岩石上的藻类，并咀嚼坚硬的珊瑚来吃里面的动物。饮食应补充各种草食动物制剂、片状食品和肉类制剂。

products.title: Sulphur Damselfish Trio (3 Damsels)
products.description: The Sulfur Damsel is a vibrant and hardy species that is native to reefs from Eastern Asia to the Red Sea. Sulfur Damsels should be added to well established aquariums with plenty of room to swim with plenty of rock work with caves and crevices. Groups of juveniles can be added to larger aquariums but can become more aggressive and territorial to fish of the same genus or size as they mature. Diet should include meaty and algae based foods to include Spirulina.
products.description_zh: 硫磺少女是一种充满活力且耐寒的物种，原产于从东亚到红海的珊瑚礁。硫磺少女应该添加到设施完善的水族箱中，该水族箱有足够的游泳空间，有大量的岩石，有洞穴和裂缝。 Groups of juveniles can be added to larger aquariums but can become more aggressive and territorial to fish of the same genus or size as they mature.饮食应包括肉类和藻类食物，其中包括螺旋藻。

products.title: Orange Banded Garden Eel |
products.description: The Garden Eel has a vibrant orange body accented by white bands resembling swaying seagrass. It requires a peaceful environment with minimal aggressive tank mates and open sandy areas. The Orange & White Garden Eel should be housed in a 40 gallon or larger aquarium with at least 6 inches of fine sand substrate to allow proper burrow formation. Gentle water movement and minimal rock work are recommended to provide the eel with a comfortable and natural environment. The diet should consist of a variety of meaty live foods such as ghost shrimp or small feeder fish. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 3" to 10", Medium: 11" to 17", Large: 18" to 26"
products.description_zh: 花园鳗鱼有一个充满活力的橙色身体，上面有白色的带子，就像摇曳的海草。它需要一个和平的环境，具有最少攻击性的坦克伙伴和开放的沙地。橙色和白色花园鳗应饲养在 40 加仑或更大的水族箱中，水族箱中至少有 6 英寸的细沙基质，以便形成适当的洞穴。建议进行温和的水流运动和最少的岩石工作，以便为鳗鱼提供舒适自然的环境。饮食应包括各种肉质活食，如幽灵虾或小型喂食鱼。大约购买尺寸：小号：3 英寸至 10 英寸，中号：11 英寸至 17 英寸，大号：18 英寸至 26 英寸

products.title: Candy Cane Coral Indonesia 2"
products.description: The Caulastrea Candy Cane Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as the Trumpet, Torch, Candy, or Bullseye Coral. Its genus name, Caulastrea , comes from the Latin kaulos (stalk), and aster (star) describing its skeletal structure consisting of tubular stalks with stars on each tip. The plump circular polyps are vibrant green, yellow, or blue and brown, with the Candy Cane Coral from Tonga being a brilliant translucent green to teal and brown, and each tip is white. Under actinic light its colorful polyps will stand out from most other corals. It is hardy and a relatively peaceful reef inhabitant, with very short sweeper tentacles. It requires moderate lighting and moderate water movement, along with the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: Caulastrea 糖蔗珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为喇叭珊瑚、火炬珊瑚、糖果珊瑚或牛眼珊瑚。它的属名 Caulastrea 源自拉丁语 kaulos（茎）和 aster（星星），描述其骨骼结构，由管状茎组成，每个尖端都有星星。丰满的圆形水螅体呈鲜艳的绿色、黄色或蓝色和棕色，来自汤加的糖蔗珊瑚呈明亮的半透明绿色到青色和棕色，每个尖端都是白色的。在光化光下，其色彩缤纷的水螅体将从大多数其他珊瑚中脱颖而出。它是一种耐寒且相对安静的珊瑚礁居民，具有非常短的清扫触角。它需要适度的照明和适度的水的运动，同时向水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Blue Diamond Discus 3"
products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. Depending on sub-species, the natural range of the Discus extends from the Amazon to the Rio Negro Regions of South America. Discus require an advanced level of care due to its feeding habits and water filtration requirements. Territorial during spawning, this otherwise peaceful fish is among the schooling group, forming a well-defined nuclear family. Becoming slightly territorial when breeding, it is best to breed an established pair, or maintain a group of young Discus and allow them to pair themselves. Warm, soft, slightly acidic water is required for spawning. The pair will clean a flat surface (usually a broad leaf or the side of the aquarium) prior to spawning. The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus. Largely carnivorous, Discus prefer freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, pellet food designed for Discus, high-quality flake food, and meaty frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 七彩神仙的整体颜色会根据鱼的情绪和整体健康状况而变化。七彩神仙鱼已超越神仙鱼成为最受欢迎的淡水观赏鱼。根据亚种的不同，七彩神仙的自然分布范围从亚马逊延伸到南美洲的里奥内格罗地区。由于其进食习惯和水过滤要求，七彩神仙需要高级护理。这种原本性情温和的鱼在产卵期间会成为鱼群中的领地，形成一个明确的核心家庭。繁殖时会变得稍微有领地意识，最好繁殖成对，或者养一群年轻的七彩神仙，让它们自己配对。温暖、柔软、slightly acidic water is required for spawning.产卵前，它们会清洁平坦的表面（通常是阔叶或水族箱的侧面）。 The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus.七彩神仙主要是肉食性的，喜欢冻干红虫和红虫、专为七彩神仙设计的颗粒食品、优质片状食品和肉质冷冻食品。

products.title: Leopard Frog (L-134) Plecostomus 3.25"
products.description: The Leopard Frog Plecostomus comes from the Amazon Basin of South America. Leopard Frog Plecos make good additions to any community aquarium. Planted aquariums with high aeration and water movement make for a healthy environment. Rocks and driftwood help to accent a natural habitat and provide hiding spaces to cut down on stress for the Leopard Frog Pleco. A recommended minimum tank of 50 gallons should be provided to house this fish. Breeding in an aquarium setting has not been successful yet, however, different methods are being used in the industry. The Leopard Frog Plecostomus is an egg-layer that tends to use plants and rocks as an anchor. Feeding the Leopard Frog Plecostomus is not difficult due to the fact that it is not a picky eater. Feeding off the bottom of the aquarium, it gets most of its nutrition from left over food and algae. If there is no algae or left over food present, supplement with high quality flake food, sinking carnivore pellets, freeze-dried bloodworms, and tubifex.
products.description_zh: 豹纹蛙 Plecostomus 来自南美洲亚马逊盆地。豹蛙 Plecos 是任何社区水族箱的绝佳补充。具有高通气性和水流动性的水草缸营造出健康的环境。岩石和浮木有助于突出自然栖息地，并提供隐藏空间以减轻豹纹蛙的压力。建议至少提供 50 加仑的水箱来容纳这种鱼。水族馆环境中的繁殖尚未成功，但业界正在使用不同的方法。豹纹蛙是一种产卵动物，倾向于使用植物和岩石作为锚点。喂养豹蛙 Plecostomus 没有什么不同由于它不挑食，所以很困难。它以水族箱底部为食，从剩余的食物和藻类中获取大部分营养。如果没有藻类或剩余食物，请补充优质片状食物、沉性食肉动物颗粒、冻干红虫和夜蛾。

products.title: Albino Yellow Discus 4"
products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. Depending on sub-species, the natural range of the Discus extends from the Amazon to the Rio Negro Regions of South America. Discus require an advanced level of care due to its feeding habits and water filtration requirements. Territorial during spawning, this otherwise peaceful fish is among the schooling group, forming a well-defined nuclear family. Becoming slightly territorial when breeding, it is best to breed an established pair, or maintain a group of young Discus and allow them to pair themselves. Warm, soft, slightly acidic water is required for spawning. The pair will clean a flat surface (usually a broad leaf or the side of the aquarium) prior to spawning. The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus. Largely carnivorous, Discus prefer freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, pellet food designed for Discus, high-quality flake food, and meaty frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 七彩神仙的整体颜色会根据鱼的情绪和整体健康状况而变化。七彩神仙鱼已超越神仙鱼成为最受欢迎的淡水观赏鱼。根据亚种的不同，七彩神仙的自然分布范围从亚马逊延伸到南美洲的里奥内格罗地区。由于其进食习惯和水过滤要求，七彩神仙需要高级护理。这种原本性情温和的鱼在产卵期间会成为鱼群中的领地，形成一个明确的核心家庭。繁殖时会变得稍微有领地意识，最好繁殖成对，或者养一群年轻的七彩神仙，让它们自己配对。温暖、柔软、产卵需要微酸性水。产卵前，它们会清洁平坦的表面（通常是阔叶或水族箱的侧面）。不得将亲本从鱼苗中取出；鱼苗以父母的粘液为食。七彩神仙主要是肉食性的，喜欢冻干红虫和红虫、专为七彩神仙设计的颗粒食品、优质片状食品和肉质冷冻食品。

products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. products.title: LiveAquaria® Assorted Platy and Decor Bundle
products.description: LiveAquaria® is happy to offer an Assorted Platy Group with decor to refresh your tank or start a new build. The Platy adds brilliant color to the aquarium and they are very easy to keep. These features make it a great fish for beginners and accomplished aquarists alike. The Platy requires an aquarium of at least 10 gallons. The Platy is a very peaceful fish and makes an excellent addition to the freshwater community aquarium. Any other peaceful fish can be housed with them The LiveAquaria® decor will offer your fish hiding places and provide movement to your tank. LiveAquaria® Assorted Platy and Decor Bundle includes: Assorted Platy Group of 12 2 LiveAquaria® 8" Secure -T Midground Plants 4 LiveAquaria® 4" Long Legged Small Leaf Plants
products.description_zh: LiveAquaria® 很高兴提供带有装饰的什锦 Platy Group，以刷新您的水族箱或开始新的建造。 Platy 为水族箱增添了绚丽的色彩，而且非常容易饲养。这些特征使其成为初学者和熟练水族爱好者的理想鱼类。 Platy 需要至少 10 加仑的水族箱。 Platy 是一种非常安静的鱼，是淡水社区水族馆的绝佳补充。任何其他性情温和的鱼都可以与它们一起饲养。LiveAquaria® 装饰将为您的鱼提供藏身之处，并为您的鱼缸提供活动空间。 LiveAquaria® 什锦平板和装饰套装包括： 什锦平板 12 组 2 LiveAquaria® 8" Secure -T 中地植物 4LiveAquaria® 4" 长腿小叶植物

products.title: Pink Bar Shrimp Goby
products.description: The Pinkbar Goby is also commonly referred to as the Shrimp Goby due to the close relationship that can form between it and various shrimp. Its body is silver marked with pink rings, and a yellowish colored tail with bright pink dots outlined in blue. It should be housed in a 10 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of loose coral rubble, and requires ample swimming room with a sand bottom for burrowing. It may try to jump out of the aquarium or other small opening, so a tight-fitting lid is required. Rarely will it become aggressive towards other fish, but will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It feeds mostly on prey suspended in the water column, but will pick food off the substrate as well. The Pinkbar Goby diet should include mysis shrimp, brine shrimp, table shrimp, and frozen food preparations for carnivores. It should be fed at least three times per day. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 3"; Large: 3" to 4"
products.description_zh: 粉红虾虎鱼通常也被称为虾虎鱼，因为它和各种虾之间可以形成密切的关系。它的身体是银色的，上面有粉红色的环，黄色的尾巴上有蓝色轮廓的亮粉色圆点。它应该被安置在一个 10 加仑或更大的水族箱中，里面有大量松散的珊瑚碎石，并且需要足够的游泳池和沙底用于挖洞。它可能会尝试跳出水族箱或其他小开口，因此需要一个紧密配合的盖子。它很少会对其他鱼产生攻击性，但会与同类打架，除非它们是配对的。它主要以悬浮在水柱中的猎物为食，但也会拾取食物基材也是如此。 Pinkbar 虾虎鱼的饮食应包括糠虾、丰年虾、食用虾和食肉动物的冷冻食品。每天至少应喂食3次。大致购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；中号：2" 至 3"；大号：3 英寸至 4 英寸

products.title: Lemon Tang
products.description: The Lemon Tang has a yellow oval body and can reach up to 10 inches in length. A 180 gallon or larger aquarium is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room for the Lemon Tang. It is aggressive towards other Tangs, Surgeonfish, and fish with similar body shapes and color. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use. Approximate Purchase Size: Juvenile: Small: 1" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 2-3/4"; Large: 2-3/4" to 3-1/2"; Adult: Small: 1-1/2" to 2-1/2"; Small/Medium: 2-1/2" to 3-1/4"; Medium: 3-1/4" to 4"; Large: 4" to 6"
products.description_zh: 柠檬唐有黄色椭圆形身体，长度可达 10 英寸。需要 180 加仑或更大的水族箱才能为 Lemon Tang 提供充足的游泳空间。它对其他唐鱼、刺尾鱼以及体形和颜色相似的鱼类具有攻击性。虽然唐鱼和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但重要的是为它们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，并且非常适合非常容易使用。大致购买尺寸：青少年：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；中号：2" 至 2-3/4"；大号：2-3/4" 至 3-1/2"；成人：小号：1-1/2" 至 2-1/2"；小/中：2-1/2" 至 3-1/4"；中号：3-1/4" 至 4"；大号：4 英寸至 6 英寸

products.title: Cuban Hogfish
products.description: The Cuban Hogfish, also called the Spotfin Hogfish, has a pinkish-orange head and body. The caudal portion of the body and the tail are lighter, sometimes approaching yellow. The brightness and placement of the colors can vary considerably. The Cuban Hogfish needs room to swim, so a tank of at least 125 gallons is needed for an adult. This is a very good fish for the novice with a large tank. It is docile and generally safe with all animals and invertebrates, except crustaceans. Tank mates should be larger than a Wrasse. Though it poses little threat even to smaller fish, it can be intimidating at feeding time. The mature adult Cuban Hogfish will eat snails, worms, mussels, small fish, shrimp, and squid. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1-1/2" to 2" Medium: 2" to 3"; Large: 3" to 4"; X-Large: 4" to 5"; XX-Large: 5" and Larger
products.description_zh: 古巴猪鱼，也称为斑鳍猪鱼，有粉橙色的头部和身体。身体尾部和尾巴颜色较浅，有时接近黄色。颜色的亮度和位置可能会有很大差异。古巴猪鱼需要游泳空间，因此成年猪鱼至少需要 125 加仑的水箱。对于拥有大缸的新手来说，这是一种非常好的鱼。它很温顺，对所有动物和无脊椎动物（甲壳类动物除外）通常都是安全的。坦克伙伴应该比濑鱼大。尽管它甚至对较小的鱼也几乎不构成威胁，但在进食时它可能会令人生畏。成熟的古巴猪鱼会吃蜗牛、蠕虫、贻贝、小鱼、虾p和鱿鱼。大致购买尺寸：小号：1-1/2" 至 2" 中号：2" 至 3"；大号：3 英寸至 4 英寸； XL：4 英寸至 5 英寸； XX 大号：5 英寸及以上

products.title: Bluehead Wrasse
products.description: The Bluehead Wrasse is a beautiful, multicolored wrasse. Similar to many wrasse species, the Bluehead Wrasse demonstrates dramatic color variation within individuals based on gender and age. The Bluehead Wrasse experiences distinct yet fluid color phases. The juvenile Bluehead Wrasse is generally yellow with black markings along their sides and sometimes on their fins. As an adult, the male Bluehead Wrasse has a bold stripe pattern (black, white, black) that divides a vibrant blue-green and yellow anterior from the namesake blue head. The female Bluehead Wrasse is completely turquoise except for two black stripes. The Bluehead Wrasse should be housed in a 75 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of live rocks for hiding and a sandy substrate to burrow into at night. Larger, gregarious tankmates are recommended since the Bluehead Wrasse will demonstrate territorial behavior and harass new additions to the aquarium. If possible, the Bluehead Wrasse should be the last fish added to the aquarium. The Bluehead Wrasse is a carnivore whose natural diet consists of fish, crustaceans, motile invertebrates, and worms. As such, the Bluehead Wrasse may eat unwanted mantis shrimp or bristleworm
products.description_zh: 蓝头濑鱼是一种美丽的多色濑鱼。与许多濑鱼物种类似，蓝头濑鱼在个体中表现出基于性别和年龄的显着颜色变化。蓝头濑鱼经历了独特而流畅的颜色阶段。幼年的蓝头濑鱼通常呈黄色，两侧有黑色斑纹，有时鳍上有黑色斑纹。成年后，雄性蓝头濑鱼具有醒目的条纹图案（黑、白、黑），将充满活力的蓝绿色和黄色的前部与同名的蓝头分开。雌性蓝头濑鱼除了两条黑色条纹外，全身呈青绿色。蓝头濑鱼应饲养在 75 加仑或更大的水族箱中，并配有 pl大量可供隐藏的活石和可供夜间挖洞的沙质基质。 Larger, gregarious tankmates are recommended since the Bluehead Wrasse will demonstrate territorial behavior and harass new additions to the aquarium.如果可能的话，蓝头濑鱼应该是最后添加到水族箱中的鱼。蓝头濑鱼是一种食肉动物，其天然食物包括鱼类、甲壳类动物、活动的无脊椎动物和蠕虫。因此，蓝头濑鱼可能会吃掉不需要的螳螂虾或刚毛虫

products.title: Labout's Fairy Wrasse
products.description: The Labout's Fairy Wrasse originates from the waters of the Great Barrier Reef and New Caledonia, and occurs in small groups on the outer reef. The Labout's Fairy Wrasse has a distinctive pattern of colors ranging from red, orange and yellow with a blue cap covering the nose and head. The male and female of this species are very similarly colored, but when courting, the male will display increased color intensity. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood. The Labout's Fairy Wrasse is a very peaceful, active fish that will bring both color and activity to a fish-only or reef aquarium of 90 gallons or larger. They will not bother any corals or invertebrates making them a perfect fish for the reef aquarium. A single male can be kept with a group of females that is introduced prior to or at the same time as the male. These wrasse like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is recommended. The Labout's Fairy Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. Approximate Purchase Size: Small 1-1/2 to 2", Medium 2" to 3", Large 3" to 4"; XLarge: 4" or la
products.description_zh: 仙女濑鱼起源于大堡礁和新喀里多尼亚水域，以小群的形式出现在外礁上。拉布特的仙女濑鱼具有独特的颜色图案，颜色范围为红色、橙色和黄色，鼻子和头部覆盖着蓝色的帽子。该物种的雄性和雌性颜色非常相似，但在求爱时，雄性会表现出更高的颜色强度。颜色可能会根据鱼的心情而变化。 Labout 仙女濑鱼是一种非常安静、活跃的鱼，可为 90 加仑或更大的纯鱼或珊瑚礁水族箱带来色彩和活力。它们不会打扰任何珊瑚或无脊椎动物，这使它们成为完美的鱼类。他礁水族馆。单个雄性可以与在雄性之前或同时引入的一组雌性一起饲养。这些濑鱼喜欢跳跃，因此建议使用紧身的顶篷。拉布特仙女濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食物，以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食物。大约购买尺寸：小号 1-1/2 至 2 英寸，中号 2 英寸至 3 英寸，大号 3 英寸至 4 英寸；超大号：4 英寸或 la

products.title: Pinkface Wrasse
products.description: The Pinkface Wrasse is also known as the Five Stripe Wrasse. This species will add bright coloration and movement to the aquarium making this species a great addition for the novice or expert alike. Pinkface wrasse can be recognized by their bright green and yellow body with several thick pink stripes from its mouth to just behind the eyes. This hardy fish should reside in a 70 gallon or larger aquarium, with other aggressive tank mates, and plenty of rocks for hiding. It will become territorial and often harass any new additions to the aquarium, therefore, it should be one of the last fish added to the tank. This species has been known to eat mantis shrimp and bristleworms as well as other crustaceans, but will normally not eat corals or live plants. The Pinkface Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. Approximate Purchase Size: Small 1" to 2-1/2"; Medium 2-1/2" to 4"; Medium/Large: 4" to 5"; Large: 5" to 6"
products.description_zh: 粉脸濑鱼也被称为五条纹濑鱼。该物种将为水族箱增添明亮的色彩和动感，使该物种成为新手或专家的绝佳补充。粉脸濑鱼可以通过其亮绿色和黄色的身体来识别，从嘴到眼睛后面有几条粗的粉红色条纹。这种耐寒的鱼应该生活在 70 加仑或更大的水族箱中，与其他好斗的鱼缸伙伴一起生活，并有大量的岩石可供隐藏。它会变得有领地意识，经常骚扰水族箱中的任何新鱼，因此，它应该是最后添加到水族箱中的鱼之一。众所周知，该物种以螳螂虾和刚毛虫以及其他动物为食。甲壳类动物，但通常不吃珊瑚或活植物。粉脸濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉食以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食物。大致购买尺寸：小号 1 英寸至 2-1/2 英寸；中号 2-1/2" 至 4"；中/大号：4 英寸至 5 英寸；大号：5 英寸至 6 英寸

products.title: Yellowtail Wrasse
products.description: The Yellowtail Wrasse is also referred to as the Yellow-tail Tamarin, or Spotted Wrasse. It has a black body covered with varying sized white dots. The tail is bright yellow. It requires a 50 gallon or larger aquarium with a 2 inch layer of live sand in which to bury itself. It is a jumper, so a secure lid on the aquarium is required. The Yellowtail Wrasse may be very difficult to keep in an aquarium due to its feeding habits. When first introduced into the aquarium, live saltwater feeder shrimp should be used to entice this fish to eat. It eats very small invertebrates (amphiopods) that grow on live rock. The diet should also include live, small feeder shrimps (brine, mysid) and finely chopped marine meats. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2-1/4"; Medium: 2-1/4" to 3-1/2"; Large: 3-1/2" to 5"
products.description_zh: 黄尾濑鱼也被称为黄尾狨猴或斑点濑鱼。它有一个黑色的身体，上面覆盖着不同大小的白点。尾巴是亮黄色的。它需要一个 50 加仑或更大的水族箱，并有 2 英寸厚的活沙层来将自己埋在其中。它是一个跳线，因此需要在水族箱上盖上安全盖。由于其饮食习惯，黄尾濑鱼可能很难在水族箱中饲养。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活的咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。它吃生长在活岩石上的非常小的无脊椎动物（片足类动物）。饮食还应包括活的小型饲养虾（盐水虾、糠虾）并切碎ped 海洋肉类。大约购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2-1/4 英寸； Medium: 2-1/4" to 3-1/2";大号：3-1/2" 至 5"

products.title: Yellowband Wrasse
products.description: The male Yellowband Wrasse, also known as the Yellowstreaked Fairy Wrasse or Velvet Multicolor Wrasse, has a bright maroon body, with a horizontal yellow streak on the side. There are blue stripes on the dorsal and anal fins. The females generally are not as colorful. They are olive green and purplish blue, and have two rows of red spots from the base of the pectoral fin to the tail. A 90 gallon or larger aquarium, either fish-only or reef, provides a good habitat. This species prefers dim lighting. The Yellowband Wrasse will not bother corals or invertebrates, making them a perfect addition to any reef aquarium. These wrasse like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is recommended. The Yellowband Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. Approximate Purchase Size: Small 1" to 2", Medium 2" to 3-1/4", Large 3-1/4" to 4-1/2", XLarge 4-1/2" to 5-1/2"

products.description: The Twin Spot Wrasse is also referred to as the Clown Coris, or Twinspot Coris. The juvenile is silver with dark spots on the face. The dorsal fin has a pair of dark spots with yellow highlights on the body. The adult becomes blue-green with a white or light green band around the midsection. When courting, the male will display an increased color intensity. It requires a 300 gallon or larger aquarium with a 4-6 inch layer of sand in which to bury itself. A single male can be kept with a group of females that is introduced prior to or at the same time as the male. The Twin Spot Wrasse will eat urchins, crabs, shrimp, and small invertebrates. It is an excellent hunter and will leave no rock unturned (literally), in search of food. The Twin Spot Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. A 50 gallon or larger aquarium, either fish-only or reef, with a shaded area is recommended. The Lubbock's Fairy Wrasse will not bother fish or invertebrates, making them a perfect addition to any reef aquarium. These fish do like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is required. products.title: Paddlefin Wrasse
products.description: The Paddlefin Wrasse is also referred to as the Rainbow or Cortez Rainbow Wrasse. As a juvenile they are mostly black in color with a yellow and pink belly. As they mature into an adult, their coloration brightens into an array of colors. Their body takes on a reddish coloration, and the head area and fins become blue to green in color. Adding to the appeal of the adult fish, is a bright yellow band located just behind the head. These are one of the smaller wrasse within the genus, and make a wonderful addition to a saltwater fish only aquarium. It should reside in a 75 gallon or larger aquarium with larger, aggressive tank mates, and plenty of rocks for hiding. It will become territorial and harass any new additions to the community, therefore, it should be the last fish added to the community. It may be kept with a mate if the aquarium is 125 gallons or larger. It may eat crustaceans, mantis shrimp and bristleworms. It does not eat corals or live plants. The Paddlefin Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. products.title: Marble/Hortulanus Wrasse
products.description: The juvenile Marble/Hortulanus Wrasse, also known as the Checkerboard Wrasse, is white with stripes, dots, and patches of black. With maturity, it becomes silver with a distinctive black checkerboard pattern on the body. The dorsal fin and tail are yellow, and the face is light green with orange to pink striped markings. A 125 gallon or larger aquarium with a sealed lid, a 2-3 inch sandy bottom to hide under if frightened, and other peaceful wrasses, including its own species, is a suitable environment. In the tank, it will eat fireworms and pyramidellid snails, protecting corals and clams which it will not bother. However, larger specimens may prey on smaller ornamental shrimp and crabs. In addition, it may eat feather dusters, wild shrimp, tubeworms, and flatworms. The Marble/Hortulanus Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. products.title: Blue Star Leopard Wrasse
products.description: The Blue Star Leopard Wrasse, also known as the Vermiculite Wrasse, or Divided Wrasse, has a distinct color pattern. The females or juveniles have a pearly white body with a combination of mottled oranges, yellows, and browns, with light blue spots found throughout the pattern, along with a large blue to black spot on their stomach. The males are brilliant neon green and blue with black outlines in a broken striped pattern down the length of their bodies. Like other members of the genus Macropharyngodon these fishes require a fine sandy substrate as they bury themselves at night for protection. They require a very well established aquarium as they naturally hunt for small crustaceans throughout the day. Leopard Wrasse are challenging fish to adapt to a captive environment, but in the hands of the expert reef aquarist who can provide these fishes with the proper care and environment, they can thrive and make for an incredible display. It is ideal to introduced Leopard Wrasse to the display aquarium well before any larger or more active fishes are introduced, so that they have ample time to settle in and adapt to their new environment, and start feeding on prepared foods well. Terminal phase males differ from females by having a vibrant colored face with a green and orange alternating striped pattern, and yellow on their lips. products.description: The Banana Wrasse is also known as the Yellow-brown Wrasse, Sunset Wrasse, or Yellow Wrasse. As an adult, it takes on a yellow appearance if female, and a blue appearance if male. Both sexes have facial markings in green and fine vertical striping along the body. The fins are very colorfully marked. It should reside in a 125 gallon or larger aquarium, with other aggressive tank mates, such as Tangs, Puffers and small Triggers and Angels. They are active fish and require plenty of rocks for hiding and a tight-fitting lid. It will become territorial and harass any new additions to the community, therefore, it should be added last to the tank. It may be kept with a mate, if the aquarium is 125 gallons or larger. It may eat mantis shrimp and bristleworms. It does not eat corals or live plants. The Banana Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. products.title: Blue and Yellow Fusiler
products.description: The Blue and Yellow Fusiler occurs in very large schools among the reefs of the Western Pacific. Their bodies are long and slender and are silver to blue in color with a striking yellow stripe that covers the back of the fish. They are a wonderful schooling fish for a large aquarium, and will draw more timid fish out into the open. A 125-gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of swimming room is recommended. A small school of 5 or more Blue and Yellow Fusilers makes an impressive display in a large FOWLR (Fish Only With Live Rock) aquarium. They do well with groupers, snappers, large wrasse, and other large predatory fish as long as they are not large enough to consume the Fusilers. They are not reef safe, as they will consume most invertebrates within the aquarium. The Blue and Yellow Fusiler should be offered a balanced diet of both meaty and vegetable items. Offer mysis and vitamin enriched brine shrimp, frozen carnivore and omnivore foods, as well as a quality flake food. Approximate Purchase Size: 2-1/2" to 3-1/2"

products.description_zh: 光芒四射的濑鱼也被称为橙头濑鱼、虹膜濑鱼和光芒四射的非洲濑鱼。成鱼身体呈深红色，边缘和鳍的颜色逐渐变浅。头部呈亮金色，黄色调沿着背鳍延伸。少年的颜色更加柔和。一个 50 加仑或更大的水族箱，有一个紧密的盖子，一个 2-3 英寸的沙底，可以在受到惊吓时躲在下面，还有其他和平的濑鱼，包括它自己的物种，是一个可以接受的环境。它会吃火虫和锥体蜗牛，保护珊瑚和蛤。此外，它还可能吃鸡毛掸子、野生虾、管虫和扁虫。它也可能吃掉身上的寄生虫坦克伙伴。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活的咸水虾来引诱该鱼进食。定期喂养应包括各种准备好的活肉食品，例如喂虾、片状食品和海鱼。大约购买尺寸：1-3/4" 至 2-1/4"

products.title: Linespot Flasher Wrasse
products.description: The Linespot Flasher Wrasse is also known as the Dot Dash or Spot Lined Flasher Wrasse, and is one of the most peaceful members of all the Flasher Wrasse. This gorgeous fish is an active show-stopper and makes a perfect addition to your peaceful community reef aquarium. The color of the female is subdued when comparing it to the brilliance of the male. The male during courting will change colors very rapidly, giving it its common name. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood, but most adult male Linespot Flasher Wrasse are vivid red in color, with a yellow dorsal fin base color with red filaments, and subtle blue running along the length where the dorsal fin meets the body. These fish are unique in having 4 or 8 red/orange filaments off of the dorsal fin, which can change coloration to white or yellow during their courting display. In their natural habitat, Linespot Flasher Wrasse have been reported from shallow crests to depths of up to 130 ft. in sheltered reefs. Be sure to provide plenty of rockwork in which to hide and build a sleeping area, though much of the time Linespot Flasher Wrasse prefer schooling in the water column with other wrasse. A single male can be kept wit
products.description_zh: 线斑闪光濑鱼也被称为点划线或斑点闪光濑鱼，是所有闪光濑鱼中最和平的成员之一。这种华丽的鱼是一种活跃的表演者，为您宁静的社区珊瑚礁水族箱增添了完美的色彩。与雄性的光彩相比，雌性的颜色显得柔和。雄性在求爱过程中会很快改变颜色，因此得名。颜色可能会根据鱼的情绪而变化，但大多数成年雄性线斑闪光濑鱼的颜色是鲜艳的红色，背鳍底色为黄色，带有红色细丝，背鳍与身体接触处的长度呈淡蓝色。这些鱼是它们的独特之处在于背鳍上有 4 或 8 根红色/橙色细丝，在求偶时可以将颜色变成白色或黄色。据报道，在它们的自然栖息地，线斑闪光濑鱼的栖息地从浅海到130英尺深的受保护的珊瑚礁。一定要提供足够的岩石来隐藏和建造睡眠区，尽管大多数时候，线斑闪光濑鱼更喜欢与其他濑鱼一起在水柱中聚集。单身男性可以保持智慧

products.title: Red Tail Flasher Wrasse
products.description: Not described until as recently as 2003, the Red Tailed Flasher Wrasse is the newest member of the genus Paracheilinus to be imported from Fiji and Vanuatu. We are fortunate to offer you this occasional fish outside of Diver's Den and on a more regular basis. The Red Tailed Flasher Wrasse has a wide red patch with a single line on its dorsal fin. Males have reddish stripes on their sides which turn whitish and their body becomes bright yellow when displaying. The color of the female is subdued when comparing it to the brilliance of the male. The male during courting will change colors very rapidly, giving it its common name. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood. The Red Tail Flasher Wrasse is a peaceful, active fish that will bring both color and activity to a fish-only or reef aquarium of 55 gallons or larger. They will not bother any corals or invertebrates making them a perfect fish for the reef aquarium. A single male can be kept with a group of females that is introduced prior to or at the same time as the male. These wrasses like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is recommended. Flasher wrasses should be fed two or three times a day in order to maintain their body we
products.description_zh: 直到 2003 年才被描述，红尾闪光濑鱼是从斐济和瓦努阿图进口的Paracheilinus 属的最新成员。我们很幸运能够在潜水员巢穴之外偶尔为您提供这种鱼，并且定期为您提供这种鱼。红尾闪光濑鱼的背鳍上有一个宽大的红色斑块，上面有一条线。雄性身体两侧有红色条纹，在展示时会变成白色，身体会变成亮黄色。与雄性的光彩相比，雌性的颜色显得柔和。雄性在求爱过程中会很快改变颜色，因此得名。颜色可能会根据鱼的心情而变化。红尾闪光器濑鱼是一种性情温和、活跃的鱼类，可为 55 加仑或更大的纯鱼或珊瑚礁水族箱带来色彩和活力。它们不会打扰任何珊瑚或无脊椎动物，使它们成为珊瑚礁水族馆的完美鱼类。单个雄性可以与在雄性之前或同时引入的一组雌性一起饲养。这些濑鱼喜欢跳跃，因此建议使用紧身的顶篷。濑鱼每天应该喂食两到三次，以保持其身体健康

products.title: Hooded Fairy Wrasse
products.description: Don't miss your chance to procure one of the newest and breathtaking additions to the aquarium hobby, the Hooded Fairy Wrasse. First described in 2003, Cirrhilabrus bathyphilus is currently one of the most highly sought after deep-water wrasse in its genus. Also recognized as the Coral Sea Wrasse, the Hooded Fairy Wrasse has a distinctive pattern of colors ranging from rose, pink, orange and yellow with purple-black edging on its dorsal and tail fins. The male and female of this species are very similarly colored, but when courting, the male will display increased color intensity. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood. The Hooded Fairy Wrasse is a very peaceful, active fish that will bring both color and activity to a fish-only or reef aquarium of 70 gallons or larger. It will not bother any corals or invertebrates making them a perfect fish for the reef aquarium. A single male can be kept with a group of females that are introduced prior to or at the same time as the male. This wrasse likes to jump, so a tight-fitting canopy is recommended. When first introduced into the aquarium, live brine shrimp or frozen mysis should be used to entice this fish to eat. Meals should cons
products.description_zh: 不要错过购买水族馆爱好中最新且令人惊叹的新产品之一——连帽仙女濑鱼的机会。于 2003 年首次被描述，Cirrhilabrus Bathyphilus 是目前该属中最受追捧的深水濑鱼之一。连帽仙女濑鱼也被称为珊瑚海濑鱼，具有独特的颜色图案，包括玫瑰色、粉色、橙色和黄色，背鳍和尾鳍上有紫黑色边缘。该物种的雄性和雌性颜色非常相似，但在求爱时，雄性会表现出更高的颜色强度。颜色可能会根据鱼的心情而变化。连帽仙濑鱼是一种非常安静、活跃的鱼，为 70 加仑或更大的纯鱼或珊瑚礁水族箱带来色彩和活力。它不会打扰任何珊瑚或无脊椎动物，使它们成为珊瑚礁水族馆的完美鱼类。单个雄性可以与一群雌性一起饲养，这些雌性在雄性之前或同时引入。这种濑鱼喜欢跳跃，因此建议使用紧身的顶篷。首次引入水族箱时，应使用活丰年虾或冷冻糠虾来引诱该鱼进食。膳食应该有缺点

Place it in an area of the aquarium where you would like additional visual appeal and watch as your aquatic life interacts with it. It is an affordable way to update your aquarium. products.title: Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral
products.description: The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Coral is referred to as Sarcophyton Coral, Mushroom, Leather, or Trough Corals. They are found in various shades of brown, tan or green, with white or gold polyps. It is difficult to identify many species because they all have the similar appearance of a mushroom or toadstool, each with a distinct stalk and capitulum (cap). As they grow older, they develop a folded appearance. The Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals are relatively peaceful, but adequate space should be provided between them and other corals in the reef aquarium. Some can produce toxins which are harmful to other reef inhabitants. The brown Sarcophyton Leather Corals from Indonesia and Tonga are easy to maintain in the reef aquarium and make an excellent coral for the beginning through expert reef aquarist. Toadstool Mushroom Leather Corals require medium to high lighting combined with medium to strong water movement. For continued good health, they will also require the addition of iodine, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Culturing by the experienced hobbyist is often accomplished by cutting off a portion of the Coral's crown and attaching that piece to live rock or pla
products.description_zh: 毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚被称为肉藻珊瑚、蘑菇、皮革或槽珊瑚。它们呈各种深浅的棕色、棕褐色或绿色，有白色或金色的息肉。许多物种很难识别，因为它们都具有蘑菇或伞菌的相似外观，每种都有独特的茎和头状花序（帽子）。随着年龄的增长，它们会出现折叠的外观。伞菌皮珊瑚相对安静，但它们与珊瑚礁水族箱中的其他珊瑚之间应提供足够的空间。有些会产生对其他珊瑚礁居民有害的毒素。来自印度尼西亚和汤加的棕色肉藻皮珊瑚是 e易于在珊瑚礁水族箱中维护，并通过专家珊瑚礁水族箱开始制作优质珊瑚。毒菌蘑菇皮珊瑚需要中到高的光照以及中到强的水流。为了持续保持身体健康，他们还需要在水中添加碘、锶和其他微量元素。经验丰富的爱好者通常通过切下珊瑚冠的一部分并将其固定在活石或平板上来完成培养

products.title: LiveAquaria® Freshwater Aquascaping Driftwood and Plants Bundle
products.description: Incorporate natural beauty into your freshwater aquarium and create a natural safe haven for your fish and invertebrates with our Reel-look Driftwood and plant bundle. Ruggedly beautiful, it will add visual interest and structure to your freshwater world while providing shelter and cover for aquatic inhabitants. Artificial driftwood eliminates the need for soaking and priming before using in your aquarium and sits on the aquarium bottom. These are ideal pieces of décor to incorporate a realistic-looking element into your freshwater tank. Included in this bundle: 1 Piece of LiveAquaria® Reel-look Driftwood (14.5” x 6” x 8”) 1 LiveAquaria® 8" Secure-T Mid-ground Plant 1 LiveAquaria® 14" Pearl Frond Plant 4 LiveAquaria ® 4" Long Legged Small Leaf Plant
products.description_zh: 使用我们的卷轴状浮木和植物束将自然美景融入您的淡水水族箱中，并为您的鱼类和无脊椎动物创造一个天然的安全港。它坚固美观，将为您的淡水世界增添视觉趣味和结构，同时为水生居民提供庇护和遮盖。人造浮木无需在水族箱中使用前进行浸泡和底漆处理，并且可以放置在水族箱底部。这些是将逼真的元素融入您的淡水箱的理想装饰品。本套装包含： 1 块 LiveAquaria® 卷轴状浮木 (14.5” x 6” x 8”) 1 个 LiveAquaria® 8" Secure-T 中地植物 1 个 LiveAquaria® 14" 珍珠叶状植物 4 LiveAquaria ® 4" 长腿小叶植物

products.title: GloFish® Purple, Pink & Orange Tetra 9 Pack + 10" Coral Beauty Plant
products.description: What do you get when you cross a moderately easy to-care-for freshwater fish with the brightest new breakthroughs in the aquarium hobby? The perfect starter fish for your desktop, kid's room, or specialty setup! Fluorescent GloFish® have expanded to also include the new line of Tetras which also come in six neon colors: Starfire Red®, Electric Green®, Sunburst Orange®, Cosmic Blue®, Galactic Purple® and Moonrise Pink®. GloFish® are not dyed and their color, which is inherited from their parents, does not fade! Original generations of GloFish® were genetically enhanced as embryos to help detect environmental pollutants and advance scientific research. Now every generation of GloFish® is born with its amazing color! The brilliant hues are produced by a fluorescent protein gene which occurs naturally in some marine organisms. Keeping GloFish® is as easy as keeping Tetras. For best care, keep this peaceful fish by themselves in small aquariums or in small schools with equally non-aggressive fish. Since they are omnivores, feed GloFish® a varied diet of flake and frozen foods Approximate Purchase Size: 1/2" to 1"
products.description_zh: 当你将一种比较容易饲养的淡水鱼与水族爱好中最耀眼的新突破结合在一起时，你会得到什么？适合您桌面、儿童房或专业设置的完美入门鱼！荧光 GloFish® 已扩展到包括新的 Tetras 系列，该系列也有六种霓虹灯颜色：星火红®、电绿色®、旭日橙®、宇宙蓝®、银河紫® 和月出粉®。 GloFish® 未经染色，其颜色遗传自父母，不会褪色！最初几代 GloFish® 在胚胎时就经过基因增强，有助于检测环境污染物并推进科学研究。现在每一代 GloFish® 都已诞生以其惊人的色彩！绚丽的色彩是由一些海洋生物中天然存在的荧光蛋白基因产生的。保留 GloFish® 就像保留 Tetras 一样简单。为了获得最好的护理，请将这种性情温和的鱼单独饲养在小型水族箱中，或者与同样没有攻击性的鱼一起饲养在小鱼群中。由于它们是杂食动物，请给 GloFish® 喂食各种片状和冷冻食品 大约购买尺寸：1/2 英寸至 1 英寸

products.title: Black Leopard Wrasse
products.description: The Black Leopard Wrasse, also known as Leopard Wrasse or Yellowspotted Wrasse, has a dark body with light blue to yellowish spots. The dorsal fin has black and white diagonal stripes, and it may have red highlights on the tail and head. A 90 gallon or larger aquarium with well established live rock and a layer of live sand is recommended. They will do best when introduced in groups of three or more. It eats small invertebrates (foraminiferans and amphiopods) that grow on live rock. The Black Leopard Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food.<; Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 3; Large: 3" to 4"
products.description_zh: 黑豹濑鱼，也称为豹纹濑鱼或黄斑濑鱼，身体呈深色，带有浅蓝色至黄色斑点。背鳍有黑白斜条纹，尾巴和头部可能有红色亮点。建议使用 90 加仑或更大的水族箱，其中有成熟的活石和一层活沙。当他们以三人或三人以上为一组时，效果会最好。它吃生长在活岩石上的小型无脊椎动物（有孔虫和片足类动物）。黑豹濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉食以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食物。近似值oximate 购买尺寸：小：1" 至 2"；中号：2 英寸至 3 英寸；大号：3 英寸至 4 英寸

products.title: Yellow & Purple Wrasse
products.description: The Yellow & Purple Wrasse is also known as the White or Four Spot wrasse, and originates from the invertebrate-rich waters of Sri Lanka. The Juvenile form is yellow and white/purple in coloration. The top half of the fish is yellow, while the lower half is white to purple. As the fish matures, the yellow coloration is lost to a beautiful pink coloration. Exercise caution if including this species into a reef aquarium, as it may feed upon feather dusters, ornamental shrimp and other similar invertebrates. The Yellow &; Purple Wrasse requires a 50-gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of live rock and a few inch deep sand bed which it will use for hiding and grazing. This species is a known jumper, and a tight fitting canopy is a must. It will eat fireworms and pyramidellid snails, protecting corals and clams. In addition, it may also eat feather dusters, wild shrimp, tubeworms, and flatworms. However, they should not bother polyps, mushrooms or corals. The Yellow &; Purple Wrasse wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. Approximate Purch
products.description_zh: 黄紫色濑鱼也被称为白斑濑鱼或四斑濑鱼，起源于斯里兰卡无脊椎动物丰富的水域。幼体的颜色为黄色和白色/紫色。鱼的上半部分是黄色的，而下半部分是白色到紫色的。随着鱼的成熟，黄色就会消失，变成美丽的粉红色。如果将这种物种放入珊瑚礁水族箱中，请务必小心，因为它可能以鸡毛掸子、观赏虾和其他类似的无脊椎动物为食。黄色&;紫濑鱼需要一个 50 加仑或更大的水族箱，里面有大量的活石和几英寸深的沙床，供其隐藏和放牧。该物种是已知的 jumper，并且紧密贴合的顶篷是必须的。它会吃火虫和锥体蜗牛，保护珊瑚和蛤。此外，它还可能吃鸡毛掸子、野虾、管虫和扁虫。然而，它们不应该打扰水螅体、蘑菇或珊瑚。黄色&;紫濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉食以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食物。大概购买量

products.description: The male Exquisite Fairy Wrasse, is green with bright red markings. Its bright red markings may vary depending on the location from which it was collected. It may also have blues, oranges, yellows, and purples decorating the body, depending on its mood. The females generally do not have quite as bold markings as the males. A 90 gallon or larger aquarium, either fish-only or reef, with a shaded area is recommended. The Exquisite Wrasse will not pick on corals or invertebrates, making them an ideal fish for the reef aquarium. These wrasses do like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is necessary. The Exquisite Fairy Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. products.title: Red Coris Wrasse
products.description: The Red Coris Wrasse, also known as the Clown Wrasse, Red Labrid, or Yellowtail Coris, can be found on almost every reef in the Indo-Pacific and Hawaiian Region, and extends all the way into the Red Sea. Adult specimens in the wild can easily grow to a foot, but in an aquarium, they rarely exceed 6-8 inches. The juvenile and adult appearances vary greatly. As a youth, the body color is orange with white tiger stripes or spots across the back. The stripes and fins are outlined in black. In adulthood, the body takes on a speckled blue coloration, the fins are decorated with yellows, reds, and blues, and the face is orange with green stripes. The male has a light green stripe on the body, just above the anal fin. The Red Coris Wrasse requires a 125 gallon or larger aquarium with a sandy bottom into which it will burrow to sleep, or if it is threatened. Do not attempt to keep the Red Coris Wrasse on crushed coral or similar substrate as they have a poor survival rate on such substrates. When very small, Red Coris are safe with almost any fish that will not eat them, but as they grow, they can become destructive. They should not be kept with invertebrates. products.description_zh: 红鲸鱼，也被称为小丑濑鱼、红拉布里鱼或黄尾鲸鱼，几乎可以在印度太平洋和夏威夷地区的每一个珊瑚礁上找到，并一直延伸到红海。野外的成年标本很容易长到一英尺，但在水族馆里，它们很少超过 6-8 英寸。幼年和成年的外貌差异很大。幼年体色为橙色，背部有白色虎纹或斑点。条纹和鳍的轮廓为黑色。成年后，身体呈现蓝色斑点，鳍饰有黄色、红色和蓝色，面部呈橙色，带有绿色条纹。雄性身上有浅绿色条纹，只是臀鳍上方。红鲸鱼需要一个 125 加仑或更大的水族箱，水族箱底部是沙质的，它会在里面挖洞睡觉，或者在受到威胁时。不要尝试将红濑鱼养在碎珊瑚或类似的基质上，因为它们在这些基质上的存活率很低。当红珊瑚很小的时候，它对几乎所有不吃它们的鱼都是安全的，但随着它们的成长，它们可能会变得具有破坏性。它们不应该与无脊椎动物一起饲养。红濑鱼饮食指南

products.title: Sleeper Gold Head Goby
products.description: The Sleeper Gold Head Goby, is known by many names including the Pennant Glider, Yellowheaded or Golden Head Sleeper, or Blueband, Bluestreak, or Yellowheaded Sleeper Goby. Its head is yellow-gold with a sapphire-blue stripe below the eyes, and the rest of the body is off-white. To be successfully cared for, it should be housed in a 30 gallon or larger aquarium with live sand as the substrate, and an attached populated refugium. A well-sealed canopy should be provided. It rarely will become aggressive towards other fish, but is territorial, and will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It feeds off the bottom as it sifts through the sand eating mouthfuls of substrate and the food that lives within the sand, keeping the substrate well oxygenated. The Sleeper Gold Head Goby feeds on a variety of live and frozen brine shrimp, mysis shrimp, live black worms, and prepared foods for carnivores, and should be fed frequently. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 3"; Large 3" to 4"; XLarge: 4" to 5"
products.description_zh: 睡眠金头虾虎鱼有很多名字，包括三角翼滑翔鱼、黄头或金头睡眠虾虎鱼、蓝带、蓝条纹或黄头睡眠虾虎鱼。它的头部是金黄色的，眼睛下方有一条宝石蓝色的条纹，身体的其余部分是灰白色的。为了成功地照顾它，它应该被安置在一个 30 加仑或更大的水族箱中，以活沙为基质，并附有一个有人居住的避难所。应提供密封良好的顶篷。它很少会对其他鱼产生攻击性，但具有领地意识，并且会与同类打架，除非它们是配对的。当它筛过沙子时，它会从底部进食，吃掉一口底物和生活在沙子里的食物，使基质保持良好的氧化。沉睡金头虾虎鱼以各种活的和冷冻的丰年虾、糠虾、活的黑虫以及食肉动物的预制食品为食，应经常投喂。大致购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；中号：2" 至 3"；大号 3 英寸至 4 英寸；超大：4 英寸至 5 英寸

products.description: The Sleeper Blue Dot Goby, also known as the Ladder Glider, Ladder Goby, or Sixspot Sleeper Goby, has a white body with bright blue spots under the eyes and mouth. In order to successfully care for this fish, it should be housed in a 30 gallon or larger aquarium with live sand as the substrate, and an attached populated refugium. It rarely will become aggressive towards other fish, but is territorial, and will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. The Sleeper Blue Dot Goby feeds off the bottom as it sifts through the sand eating mouthfuls of substrate and the food that lives within the sand. The diet should include a variety of live and frozen brine shrimp, mysis shrimp, live black worms, and prepared foods for carnivores, and it should be fed frequently.
