products.title: Sleeper Banded Goby
products.description: The Sleeper Banded Goby, also known as the Brownbarred Goby and Bullet Goby, was first discovered in the Indo-Pacific Ocean by Valenciennes in 1837. It has a greenish-yellow head with blue and orange dots and dashes. The remainder of the body is yellow with brown bands. It should be housed in a 30 gallon or larger aquarium with a substrate of loose coral rubble and a tight-fitting lid to prevent it from jumping out of the tank. It will rarely become aggressive towards other fish, but is territorial and will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It feeds on a variety of tiny crustaceans in the substrate as well as filamentous algae. In the home aquarium, offer a varied diet consisting of vitamin-enriched brine shrimp (live or frozen), mysis shrimp, prepared foods for herbivores, as well as nori strips of the aquarium lacks macro algae growth. It should be fed three times per day, depending on the amount of natural live food found within the aquarium. Approximate Purchase Size: Small:1-1/4" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 3"; Large: 3" to 4"
products.description_zh: 卧带虾虎鱼，也称为棕斑虾虎鱼和子弹虾虎鱼，是瓦朗谢纳于 1837 年在印度太平洋首次发现的。它的头部呈黄绿色，上面有蓝色和橙色的点和划线。身体的其余部分是黄色的，带有棕色条纹。它应该被安置在一个 30 加仑或更大的水族箱中，水族箱的底层是松散的珊瑚碎石，并有一个紧密的盖子，以防止它跳出水箱。它很少会对其他鱼类产生攻击性，但具有领地意识，会与同类发生战斗，除非它们是配对的。它以基质中的各种微小甲壳类动物以及丝状藻类为食。在家庭水族箱中，提供多样化的饮食富含维生素的丰年虾（活的或冷冻的）、糠虾、食草动物的预制食品以及水族箱中的紫菜条缺乏大型藻类的生长。每天应该喂三次，具体取决于水族箱内天然活体食物的数量。大约购买尺寸：小号：1-1/4 英寸至 2 英寸；中号：2" 至 3"；大号：3 英寸至 4 英寸

products.title: Clown Goby, Citrinis
products.description: The Citrinis Clown Goby, also known as the Citron or Citrin Goby, is common within the reefs of Sri Lanka and the Coral Sea. They are usually found among soft and hard coral colonies. They are a small yellow fish with blue vertical lines around the eyes and gills, and a blue horizontal line along the dorsal fin. Their body color can vary between dark brown and pale yellow. They are a peaceful fish that makes a wonderful addition to a reef aquarium containing colonies of polyp coral and other soft corals, as they enjoy swimming and hiding amongst the polyps. The Citrinis Clown Goby feeds on the mucous polyps of Acropora sp. in the wild and is considered reef safe but will nip at the polyps or bases of Acropora sp. and possibly other SPS corals. If the SPS dominated aquarium is not heavily stocked with very mature colonies these fish may severely damage Acropora sp. in these displays. It requires a 10 gallon or larger aquarium and prefers branched corals, often resting on them for hours at a time. products.description_zh: 柑橘小丑虾虎鱼，也被称为 Citron 或 Citrin Goby，在斯里兰卡和珊瑚海的珊瑚礁中很常见。它们通常出现在软珊瑚群和硬珊瑚群中。它们是一种黄色的小鱼，眼睛和鳃周围有蓝色的垂直线，背鳍上有蓝色的水平线。它们的身体颜色可以在深棕色和浅黄色之间变化。它们是一种性情温和的鱼，是珊瑚虫群和其他软珊瑚群落的珊瑚礁水族箱的绝妙补充，因为它们喜欢在珊瑚虫中游泳和隐藏。柑橘小丑虾虎鱼以鹿角珊瑚属的粘液息肉为食。在野外，被认为是珊瑚礁安全的，但会咬住珊瑚虫或鹿角珊瑚的基地。可能还有其他 SPS 珊瑚。如果以 SPS 为主的水族箱没有大量饲养非常成熟的鱼群，这些鱼可能会严重损害鹿角珊瑚属。在这些显示中。它需要一个 10 加仑或更大的水族箱，并且更喜欢分枝珊瑚，通常一次在它们上面休息几个小时。它很少会对其他鱼产生攻击性，但会在较小的水族箱中与同类进行战斗。最好与其他温顺的物种一起饲养。小丑虾虎鱼很常见

products.title: Pipe Organ Coral 3.5"
products.description: The Pipe Organ Coral is a soft coral but is often referred to as a hard coral because it produces an external calcareous skeleton that is red in coloration. Common names for the Pipe Organ Coral may include Organ Pipe Coral, Mat Polyp, or Daisy Coral. When its polyps are open, the Pipe Organ Coral is often easily confused with Star Polyp Corals or Clove Polyp Corals because of their similar appearance. However, unlike the aforementioned doppelgangers, the Pipe Organ Coral has a tight "well behaved" growth habit and will not spread aggressively across the rocks and potentially crowd neighboring corals. The ideal environment for the Pipe Organ Coral is an established reef aquarium with coral-friendly fish and invertebrates. The Pipe Organ Coral is safe to place near other peaceful corals as it lacks sweeper tentacles that can potentially damage other corals with which it may come into contact. Once established, the Pipe Organ Coral provides a fantastic living tapestry of color and movement ideal for softening the rough edges of rockwork or filling empty reef aquarium landscapes. products.description_zh: 管风琴珊瑚是一种软珊瑚，但通常被称为硬珊瑚，因为它产生红色的外部钙质骨骼。管风琴珊瑚的俗名可能包括风琴管珊瑚、席状息肉或雏菊珊瑚。当水螅体张开时，管风琴珊瑚经常很容易与星形水螅珊瑚或丁香水螅珊瑚混淆，因为它们的外观相似。然而，与上述的分身不同，管风珊瑚具有严格的“行为良好”生长习性，不会在岩石上积极扩散并可能挤占邻近的珊瑚。管风琴珊瑚的理想环境是拥有珊瑚的成熟珊瑚礁水族馆友善的鱼类和无脊椎动物。管风琴珊瑚可以安全地放置在其他和平的珊瑚附近，因为它没有清扫触手，可能会损坏它可能接触到的其他珊瑚。一旦建立起来，管风琴珊瑚就会提供梦幻般的色彩和动感的活生生的挂毯，非常适合软化岩石的粗糙边缘或填充空的珊瑚礁水族馆景观。管风琴珊瑚将在 T-5 荧光灯、p 实现的中等到高照明条件下茁壮成长

products.title: Lyretail Wrasse
products.description: The Lyretail Wrasse is also referred to as the Lunare Wrasse or Moon Wrasse. Juveniles are blue on the lower half of their body, with a black spot in the middle of the dorsal fin and a black blotch on the caudal fin base. As the fish matures, the black blotch will start turning into a yellow crescent. Their body will begin turning green with bright facial and fin markings. The Lyretail Wrasse should reside in a 125 gallon or larger aquarium with larger, aggressive tank mates, and plenty of rocks for hiding. It will become territorial and harass any new additions to the community, therefore, it should be the last fish added to the aquarium. It may be kept with a mate if the aquarium is 150 gallons or larger. It may eat mantis shrimp and bristleworms. It does not eat corals or live plants. The Lyretail Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2"; Small/Medium: 2" to 3" Medium: 3" to 4"; Large: 4" to 5"; X Large: 5" to 7"
products.description_zh: 琴尾濑鱼也被称为月濑鱼或月濑鱼。幼鱼下半身呈蓝色，背鳍中部有一个黑点，尾鳍基部有一个黑色斑点。随着鱼的成熟，黑色斑点将开始变成黄色新月形。它们的身体将开始变成绿色，面部和鳍上有明亮的斑纹。琴尾濑鱼应该生活在 125 加仑或更大的水族箱中，水族箱里有更大、更具攻击性的同伴，并且有大量的岩石可供隐藏。它会变得具有领地意识并骚扰社区中的任何新成员，因此，它应该是最后添加到水族馆的鱼。如果水族箱容量为 150 ga，则可以与伴侣一起饲养微米或更大。它可能吃螳螂虾和刚毛虫。它不吃珊瑚或活植物。 Lyretail濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉食以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食物。大致购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；小号/中号：2 英寸至 3 英寸 中号：3 英寸至 4 英寸；大号：4 英寸至 5 英寸； X 大号：5 英寸至 7 英寸

products.title: Rio de Para Pleco (L-075)
products.description: The Rio de Para Pleco originates from the rivers and tributaries of Brazil, and is also known as the Para Pleco or by its Loricariidae number, L-075. It is a beautiful species that is cream to gold in color with many dramatic black polka dots. Its dorsal fin is large for its size and is outlined in black and adorned with the same black polka dot pattern. A larger aquarium of at least 70 gallons is recommended to house the Rio de Para Pleco. It will get rather large in the aquarium, so provide plenty of room for it to move. Plants, rocks, and driftwood help mirror its natural environment and help give it a sense of security. In the wild this fish is an egg layer, but breeding in an aquarium setting has not been successful. A useful herbivore in an aquarium with algae, the Rio de Para Pleco will keep algae under control under normal tank conditions. If no algae is present, supplement its diet with dried algae sheets, algae wafers and other herbivore preparations. Approximate Purchase Size: 3" to 5"
products.description_zh: Rio de Para Pleco 河发源于巴西的河流和支流，也被称为 Para Pleco 或其 Loricariidae 编号 L-075。这是一个美丽的物种，颜色为奶油色到金色，带有许多引人注目的黑色圆点。它的背鳍尺寸较大，轮廓为黑色，并饰有相同的黑色圆点图案。建议使用至少 70 加仑的较大水族箱来容纳 Rio de Para Pleco。它在水族箱中会变得相当大，因此请为其提供足够的移动空间。植物、岩石和浮木有助于反映其自然环境并赋予其安全感。在野外，这种鱼是产卵鱼，但在水族箱中繁殖设置尚未成功。 Rio de Para Pleco 是有藻类的水族箱中有用的食草动物，在正常水箱条件下可以控制藻类。如果没有藻类，则用干藻片、藻片和其他草食动物制剂来补充其饮食。大约购买尺寸：3 英寸至 5 英寸

products.title: Pink Margin Fairy Wrasse
products.description: The Pink Margin Fairy Wrasse originates from the waters ranging from southern Japan to Indonesia, and occurs in small groups on the reef. The Pink Margin Fairy Wrasse is a very colorful fish displaying a multitude of colors including the red margin on both the tail and dorsal fin. The male of this species is more brilliantly colored when compared to both the female and the juvenile, and when courting, will display increased color intensity. Colors may vary depending on the fish's mood. The Pink Margin Fairy Wrasse is a very peaceful, active fish that will bring both color and activity to a fish-only or reef aquarium of 90 gallons or larger. They will not bother any corals or invertebrates making them a perfect fish for the reef aquarium. These wrasse like to jump, so a tight fitting canopy is recommended. The Pink Margin Fairy Wrasse diet should include vitamin enriched frozen mysis shrimp, vitamin enriched frozen brine shrimp, and other meaty foods along with a high quality marine flake and marine pellet food. products.description_zh: 粉红缘仙濑鱼起源于从日本南部到印度尼西亚的海域，以小群的形式出现在珊瑚礁上。粉红边缘仙女濑鱼是一种非常色彩缤纷的鱼，呈现出多种颜色，包括尾巴和背鳍上的红色边缘。与雌性和幼体相比，该物种的雄性的颜色更加鲜艳，并且在求爱时，会表现出更高的颜色强度。颜色可能会根据鱼的心情而变化。粉红边缘仙女濑鱼是一种非常安静、活跃的鱼，可为 90 加仑或更大的纯鱼或珊瑚礁水族箱带来色彩和活力。他们不会打扰任何珊瑚或无脊椎动物将它们视为珊瑚礁水族馆的完美鱼类。这些濑鱼喜欢跳跃，因此建议使用紧身的顶篷。粉红仙女濑鱼的饮食应包括富含维生素的冷冻糠虾、富含维生素的冷冻丰年虾和其他肉类食品以及高品质的海洋片状和海洋颗粒食品。大约购买尺寸：青少年/女性小号：1 英寸至 1-1/2 英寸；中号：1-1/2" 至 2"；大号：2 英寸至 3 英寸；公小号：1-1/2" 至 2-1/4"；中号：2-1/4" 至 3"；大号：3 英寸至 4 英寸； X

products.title: Regal Angelfish
products.description: With vivid vertical striations of blue, white, yellow, or orange on the body and pelvic fin, the Regal Angelfish deserves this distinctive name. Regal Angelfish from the Maldives and the Red Sea have a distinctive yellow breast, where their Indo-Pacific, Coral Sea, New Caledonia and Tahitian relatives normally have a blue/gray breast. This coloration is more prevalent in specimens that are more mature and are at least 4" in length. Juveniles will have a "False Eye Spot" on their dorsal fins that fades and the fish matures. Regal Angelfish from the Red Sea, Maldives, Coral Sea, Fiji and Tahiti are good shippers and are harvested and handled with care, and normally will adapt more easily than their Indo-Pacific counterparts to the home aquarium. The Regal Angelfish is more difficult to maintain than other species of angels so it should be introduced first so that it may stake out its territory in advance of other fish. A minimum of a 125 gallon tank with plenty of hiding places and live rock for grazing will offer a good environment. The Regal Angelfish may nip at large-polyped stony corals, an occasional soft coral and clam mantles, but may be kept with small-polyped stony corals an
products.description_zh: 帝王神仙鱼的身体和腹鳍上有生动的蓝色、白色、黄色或橙色的垂直条纹，它配得上这个独特的名字。来自马尔代夫和红海的帝王神仙鱼有一个独特的黄色胸部，而它们的印度太平洋、珊瑚海、新喀里多尼亚和大溪地亲戚通常有蓝色/灰色的胸部。这种颜色在较成熟且长度至少为 4 英寸的标本中更为普遍。幼鱼的背鳍上会出现“假眼斑”，随着鱼的成熟，该斑点会逐渐消失。来自红海、马尔代夫、珊瑚海、斐济和塔希提岛的帝王神仙鱼是良好的托运者，捕捞和处理时要小心，通常比鱼更容易适应。他们的印度太平洋地区的水族馆与家庭水族馆相似。帝王神仙鱼比其他种类的神仙鱼更难饲养，因此应首先引入它，以便它可以先于其他鱼标出自己的领地。至少 125 加仑的水箱，有足够的藏身之处和可供放牧的活石，将提供良好的环境。帝王神仙鱼可能会咬食大水螅体石珊瑚，偶尔也会吃软珊瑚和蛤蜊，但也可能与小水螅体石珊瑚和蛤蜊一起饲养。

products.title: Sea Stalk Briareum
products.description: The Sea Stalk Briareum is also referred to as the Corky Sea Fingers, Deadman's Fingers, Moss Coral, Encrusting Gorgonian, or simply Briareum. It has long, grass-like polyps which are normally extended continuously, retracted only when disturbed. Briareum asbestinum can have multiple forms including encrusting, flat or knobby crusts, or upright branches as pictured above. The polyps will vary in many color variations, size, and shape. Briareum is fast growing and care should be taken in placing the Sea Stalk Briareum within the aquarium, allowing ample room for expansion and any interference from other neighboring corals. It is moderately easy to maintain and propagate when encrusted to substrate rubble. It requires medium to high lighting combined with medium to strong water movement. For continued good health, it will require the addition of iodine, calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Some species of Briareum are toxic. It is highly photosynthetic, containing the symbiotic algae zooxanthellae from which it receives most of its nutrients, but may also capture some particulate matter. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 2.5" to 4"; Medium: 4" to 6"; Large: More
products.description_zh: 海茎Briareum 也称为Corky Sea Fingers、Deadman's Fingers、Moss Coral、Encrusting Gorgonian 或简称Briareum。它有长长的、草状的息肉，通常会不断伸展，只有在受到干扰时才会缩回。 Briareum asbestinum 可以有多种形式，包括结壳、平坦或多节的结壳，或如上图所示的直立分支。息肉的颜色、大小和形状各不相同。 Briareum 生长速度很快，将 Sea Stalk Briareum 放置在水族箱内时应小心，留出足够的空间进行扩张，并避免受到其他邻近珊瑚的干扰。当被包裹起来以取代时，它是相当容易维护和传播的。率瓦砾。它需要中到高的光照以及中到强的水流。为了持续保持身体健康，需要在水中添加碘、钙、锶和其他微量元素。 Briareum 的某些种类是有毒的。它具有高度光合作用，含有共生藻类虫黄藻，它从中获得大部分营养，但也可能捕获一些颗粒物。大致购买尺寸：小号：2.5 英寸至 4 英寸；中号：4" 至 6"；大：更多

products.title: Paralemnalia Tree Coral
products.description: Tree Corals may also be referred to as Paralemnia or Lemnalia Tree Corals, Finger Leather, Branch, or Cauliflower Corals. They are brown branching corals which form encrusting mats. In the wild, they are usually found in strong currents. They are aggressive and can produce toxins, so adequate space needs to be provided between them and other corals within the reef aquarium. They are moderately difficult to maintain in the reef aquarium but make excellent corals for the established reef aquarium system. They require medium to high lighting combined with medium to strong water movement. They seem to prefer a coarse gravel substrate. For continued good health, they will also require the addition of iodine, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. The symbiotic algae zooxanthellae are hosted within Paralemnia Tree Corals and provide the majority of their nutritional requirements from the light driven process of photosynthesis. They will also benefit from additional food such as micro-plankton, baby brine shrimp, or foods designed for filter feeding invertebrates. Paralemnia Tree Corals is normally shipped attached to a small piece of live rock or rubble. Approximate Purchase S
products.description_zh: 树珊瑚也可称为 Paralemnia 或 Lemnalia 树珊瑚、指皮珊瑚、树枝珊瑚或花椰菜珊瑚。它们是棕色的分枝珊瑚，形成结壳垫。在野外，它们通常出现在强劲的水流中。它们具有攻击性，会产生毒素，因此需要在它们和珊瑚礁水族箱内的其他珊瑚之间提供足够的空间。它们在珊瑚礁水族箱中维护起来比较困难，但对于已建立的珊瑚礁水族箱系统来说是极好的珊瑚。它们需要中到高的光照以及中到强的水流。他们似乎更喜欢粗糙的砾石基质。为了持续保持良好的健康，他们还需要补充水中的碘、锶和其他微量元素。共生藻类虫黄藻寄生在 Paralemnia 树珊瑚中，通过光驱动的光合作用过程提供其大部分营养需求。它们还将受益于额外的食物，例如微型浮游生物、丰年虾宝宝或专为滤食无脊椎动物设计的食物。 Paralemnia 树珊瑚通常附在一小块活石或瓦砾上运输。大概购买量S

products.title: Silver Scat 1" to 1.5"
products.description: The Silver Scat fish is a popular brackish water aquarium fish that is native to the Indo-Pacific region also known as the Spotbanded Scat, Barred Scat, and Striped Butterfish. Silver Scat fish are a hardy schooling fish that should be kept in a minimum tank size of 125 gallons. When introducing a school of Silver Scat's it is best to introduce all individuals at the same time as they establish a hierarchical system. Silver Scats have a uniquely-shaped silver or dark body with black stripes and spots, as the fish matures many of these characteristics are lost. Silver Scats are opportunistic omnivores that require a varied diet in vegetable matter as they mature. As they mature their diet switches to a more herbivorous, favoring filamentous algae and plant material. Provide a varied diet that includes blanched spinach, kale and seaweed while also offering a variety of frozen foods such as brine shrimp, bloodworms, mysis shrimp or krill. If you are offering a pellet or flake food ensure it is rich in vegetable based ingredients. The dorsal and ventral fins of the Silver scat are venomous, if stung it is similar to a bee sting but more potent.
products.description_zh: 银鱼是一种流行的咸水观赏鱼，原产于印度太平洋地区，也称为斑带鱼、条纹鱼和条纹鲳鱼。银鲶鱼是一种耐寒的鱼群，应饲养在最小 125 加仑的水箱中。在介绍银星猫的学校时，最好同时介绍所有个体，因为他们建立了等级制度。银鱼的身体呈独特的银色或深色，带有黑色条纹和斑点，随着鱼的成熟，这些特征中的许多特征都会消失。银鲫鱼是机会主义的杂食动物，在成熟时需要多样化的植物性饮食。随着他们的饮食逐渐成熟更适合草食性，更喜欢丝状藻类和植物材料。提供多样化的饮食，包括焯水菠菜、羽衣甘蓝和海藻，同时还提供各种冷冻食品，如丰年虾、红虫、糠虾或磷虾。如果您提供颗粒或片状食品，请确保其富含蔬菜成分。银粪的背鳍和腹鳍有毒，如果被蜇的话，其效果与蜜蜂蜇相似，但威力更强。

products.title: Miniatus Grouper 3.25"
products.description: The Miniatus Grouper, also known as the Miniata Grouper, Coral or Blue-Spot Rockcod, Coral Hind, and Coral Grouper, is a common and popular fish along the coral reefs of the Indo-Pacific, and it makes a most spectacular addition to a large home aquarium. In the wild, it can attain sizes up to 18", but tank specimens rarely exceed a foot in length. The Miniatus Grouper is a large and very hardy fish which requires a large aquarium of 180 gallons or more when full grown. It can be compatible with other fish provided they are too large to be eaten. It should not be trusted around invertebrates or small fish. In the wild this reef predator commonly attacks schools of reef-dwelling fish. In the aquarium, freeze-dried krill soaked in Selcon, feeder goldfish, or squid are acceptable.
products.description_zh: 迷你石斑鱼，也称为迷你石斑鱼、珊瑚或蓝点石斑鱼、珊瑚鹿和珊瑚石斑鱼，是印度太平洋珊瑚礁中常见且受欢迎的鱼类，它为大型家庭水族箱增添了最壮观的色彩。在野外，它的尺寸可达 18 英寸，但水箱标本的长度很少超过一英尺。迷你石斑鱼是一种大型且非常耐寒的鱼类，完全长大后需要 180 加仑或更多的大型水族箱。只要它们太大而无法食用，它就可以与其他鱼类兼容。在无脊椎动物或小鱼周围不应信任它。在野外，这种珊瑚礁捕食者通常会攻击珊瑚礁鱼类群。水族馆、浸泡在 Selcon 中的冻干磷虾、饲养金鱼或鱿鱼都是可以接受的。

products.title: Galaxy (L-240) Plecostomus 6.25"
products.description: The Galaxy Plecostomus also known as the Vampire or Tooth-Nose Pleco Pleco, comes from the Amazon Basin of South America. It is black with many striking yellow spots covering the entire body. The common name for this catfish comes from the bristle-like barbells that are present on the upper side of the mouth. Tooth-Nose Plecos make good additions to any community aquarium. Planted aquariums with high aeration and water movement make for a healthy environment. Rocks and driftwood help to accent a natural habitat and provide hiding spaces to cut down on stress for the Tooth-Nose Pleco. A recommended minimum tank of 50 gallons should be provided to house this fish. Breeding in an aquarium setting has not been successful yet, however, different methods are being used in the industry. The Galaxy Plecostomus is an egg-layer that tends to use plants and rocks as an anchor. Feeding the Galaxy Plecostomus is not difficult due to the fact that it is not a picky eater. Feeding off the bottom of the aquarium, it gets most of its nutrition from left over food and algae. If there is no algae or left over food present, supplement with high quality flake food, sinking carnivore pellets, freeze-dri
products.description_zh: 银河 Plecostomus 也被称为吸血鬼或牙鼻 Pleco Pleco，来自南美洲亚马逊盆地。它呈黑色，全身布满许多醒目的黄色斑点。这种鲶鱼的俗名来自于嘴上侧的鬃毛状杠铃。牙鼻异形鱼是任何社区水族箱的良好补充。具有高通气性和水流动性的水草缸营造出健康的环境。岩石和浮木有助于突出自然栖息地，并提供隐藏空间以减轻牙鼻异兽的压力。建议至少提供 50 加仑的水箱来容纳这种鱼。在水族箱中繁殖 setting 尚未成功，但是业界正在使用不同的方法。 Galaxy Plecostomus 是一种产卵动物，倾向于使用植物和岩石作为锚点。喂养 Galaxy Plecostomus 并不困难，因为它不挑食。它以水族箱底部为食，从剩余的食物和藻类中获取大部分营养。如果没有藻类或剩余食物，补充优质片状食物、沉性食肉动物颗粒、冻干食物

products.title: Maroon Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Maroon Clownfish, also known as the Spine-Cheeked Anemonefish or Maroon Anemonefish, has a bold, red body color with a broad white stripe on the forehead, and white stripes on its midsection and in front of the anal fin. Captive bred clownfish are very hardy and durable fish making them a perfect addition for the novice or seasoned aquarist. The Maroon Clownfish is a good candidate for a reef aquarium. The Maroon Clownfish are the most territorial of all clownfish species. Maroon Clownfish are very sensitive to elevated levels of copper, and should never be exposed to levels near or above . Captive bred clownfish are easy to breed in the home aquarium. The females will be the largest of the pair, and two fish will usually stay close to each other in the aquarium. These fish are egg layers and will deposit the eggs on a flat surface, and defend the eggs from other tank mates. The eggs will normally hatch in 6-11 days depending on the temperature. The fry must be reared in a separate aquarium on a diet of rotifers then baby brine shrimp. The Maroon Clownfish diet consists of meaty items such as frozen shrimp and herbivore preparations. Do not move the Maroon Clownfish with a net
products.description_zh: 栗色小丑鱼，也称为脊颊小丑鱼或栗色小丑鱼，体色大胆，红色，额头上有宽阔的白色条纹，中部和臀鳍前面有白色条纹。人工饲养的小丑鱼是非常耐寒和耐久的鱼，这使得它们成为新手或经验丰富的水族爱好者的完美选择。栗色小丑鱼是珊瑚礁水族馆的良好候选者。栗色小丑鱼是所有小丑鱼中领地意识最强的。栗色小丑鱼对铜含量升高非常敏感，切勿暴露在接近或高于铜含量的环境中。人工饲养的小丑鱼很容易在家庭水族箱中繁殖。雌性将是其中最大的成对的鱼和两条鱼在水族箱中通常会保持靠近。这些鱼是产卵鱼，会将卵产在平坦的表面上，并保护卵免受其他鱼缸同伴的伤害。卵通常会在 6-11 天后孵化，具体取决于温度。鱼苗必须在单独的水族箱中饲养，以轮虫为食，然后以丰年虾幼虫为食。栗色小丑鱼的饮食包括肉类食品，例如冷冻虾和草食动物制剂。不要用网移动栗色小丑鱼

products.title: Pink Skunk Clownfish
products.description: The Pink Skunk Clownfish, also known as the Pink Skunk Anemonefish or False Skunk-striped Anemonefish, has a peach-orange base color with one white stripe behind the head that runs from the nose and down the entire length of the back. Another contrasting white stripe is located just behind the eyes. The Pink Skunk Clownfish is a bit more challenging to spawn and rear than other clownfish species in the home aquarium, but with some effort can be accomplished by the dedicated marine aquarist. The females will be the largest of the pair and the two fish will usually stay close to each other in the aquarium. Clownfish are egg layers and will deposit the eggs on a flat surface and defend the eggs from other tank mates. The eggs will normally hatch in 8-11 days depending on the water temperature. The fry must be reared in a separate aquarium on a diet of rotifers followed by baby brine shrimp. The post-metamorphic juveniles will exhibit strong schooling or "balling" behaviors that can continue into adulthood. Pukani Live Rock is easy to maintain in the aquarium, and makes an excellent candidate for the beginner to the expert aquarist. products.title: Fine Spot Gold Nugget Plecostomus (L081) 2.25"
products.description: The name "Fine Spot Gold Nugget Pleco" is short for "Fine Spot Gold Nugget Plecostomus." It is a suckermouth catfish which was first captured and exported to Great Britain in 1981. Due to the abundance of stock available in the catfish category, it has become very difficult to categorize them by species. As a result, you may see a reference to the letter "L" for the family Loricariidae, followed by a number. The Fine Spot Gold Nugget Pleco is referred to as L081 or L-81 by most hobbyists. The Fine Spot Gold Nugget Pleco is a shy bottom-dweller that appreciates plenty of driftwood in its environment. Unfortunately, the Fine Spot Gold Nugget's breeding habits have not been documented. Feeding the Fine Spot Gold Nugget Pleco is not difficult due to the fact that it is not a finicky eater. Feeding off the bottom of the tank, it gets most of its nutrition from left over food and algae. If there is no algae or left over food present, supplement with high quality flake food, sinking carnivore pellets, and freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex.

products.title: Black Veil Angel
products.description: The Black Veil Angel is a strain of angelfish that is black in color with long flowing fins that are accentuated with a beautiful black lace. It prefers a well-planted tank of at least 30 gallons with soft, slightly acidic water. Rocks and driftwood can be added to the aquarium, but leave plenty of space for swimming. It is best, when trying to breed the Black Veil Angel, to house a number of angels in the same aquarium until they pair off. After a pair has developed, a flat surface needs to be provided where the eggs can be laid. A piece of slate, a large plant leaf, or even a flowerpot should be positioned at an angle of about 30 degrees in an area of moderate water flow. The female will lay the eggs and the male will follow behind to fertilize. After approximately three days, the eggs will hatch and the fry will emerge. Feed the fry newly hatched brine shrimp until large enough to accept crushed flake food. The Black Veil Angel needs to be fed a variety of foods including vegetables as well as meaty foods. Feed a quality flake food as well as live and frozen foods such as brine shrimp and bloodworms. Approximate Purchase Size: 1" to 3"

products.title: Green Cynarina Button Coral 3"
products.description: The Green Cynarina Button Coral, a large polyp stony (LPS) coral, is often called the Cat's Eye, Tooth, Doughnut, Teary Eye, or Meat Coral. Its genus name, Cynarina , originates from the Greek words kinara (artichoke) and ina (similar to), which fittingly describe its artichoke-like appearance. This solitary, round coral is among the largest single-polyped corals in nature and is available in a variety of color forms, ranging from pastel to bright and translucent, to vibrant shades like red, as well as more muted tones. It is sometimes mistaken for its close relative, Scolymia . Although it is not aggressive, the Cynarina Button Coral should have adequate space from other corals, as it can expand to twice its original size. It is simple to care for in a reef aquarium, making it a great choice for both novice and experienced reef aquarists. It thrives under medium lighting and low water movement. To maintain good health, the water should be supplemented with calcium, strontium, and other essential trace elements. This coral should be fed meaty foods such as micro-plankton or brine shrimp during the evening.

products.title: Red Sea Moray Eel - Juvenile 1"D x 24"L
products.description: Red Sea Moray Eels are typically shy upon introduction but quickly acclimate to aquarium life. While not inherently aggressive, they are opportunistic predators and will consume smaller fish and invertebrates, so tankmates must be chosen with care. Red Sea Moray Eels are a highly desirable species prized for their rich coloration, hardy nature, and intriguing behavior. Native to the warm, pristine waters of the Red Sea, these eels display beautiful tones ranging from golden browns to mottled patterns. Their adaptability and resilience make them a popular choice among experienced marine aquarists looking to add a unique predator to their system. Tank Size: 75 gallons or larger recommended (larger aquariums preferred for adult specimens)

products.description: The Orange Short Tentacle Plate Coral is a relatively hard to find coral that originates from the Indo Pacific. Even with short tentacles, it can still damage other corals that it comes in contact with. With placement in the aquarium, keep in mind that it will often inflate itself with water and expand to twice its size. It will do best on the bottom of a reef aquarium, preferably lying on a fine sandy substrate. The Orange Short Tentacle Plate Coral is easy to maintain in the reef aquarium and makes an excellent candidate for the beginner reef aquarist. products.description: The LiveAquaria® Premium Aquacultured SPS Coral offers coral collectors and aficionados a convenient way to create a beautiful reef aquarium landscape with diverse species. products.title: Griessingeri Goby
products.description: The Griessingeri Goby is a unique and vibrantly colorful addition to your reef aquarium. The Griessinger Goby is also know as the Flaming Prawn Goby and Spikefin Goby. Griessinger Gobies do need a tank with plenty of caves, rockwork and crevices with a sandy or rock rubble substrate. Cryptic behavior in the wild will also be common in the home aquarium, as they may seldomly be seen during the day. Griessinger Gobies due require a diet of high quality meaty foods such as brine shrimp, calanus, and rotifers as they are primarily carnivores. Twice daily feedings would be beneficial to the health of the goby. Approximate Purchase Size: 1/2" to 1"

products.description: Live corals are important contributors to the structure of a saltwater reef in nature as well as in reef aquariums. The USA Aquacultured Cyphastrea Coral ( Cyphastrea sp. ) is a healthy and attractive alternative to a wild caught specimen and does not contribute to the world's declining coral reefs. Most Cyphastrea Coral have an encrusting formation and are popular because they are hardy and fast growing. Additional interest is added because they can undergo some color shifting, displaying more vibrant colors when tank conditions are optimal. Requiring a moderate care level because they are a semi-aggressive coral, it is important that aquarists leave space between them and other corals when they are placed into an aquarium due to the fact that they will expand their sweeper tentacles well beyond their base as they grow. The USA Aquacultured Cyphastrea Coral will satisfy the majority of their nutritional requirements by means of photosynthetic, symbiotic zooxanthellae algae hosted within their bodies. products.description_zh: 活珊瑚是自然界和珊瑚礁水族馆中咸水礁结构的重要贡献者。美国水产养殖的 Cyphastrea 珊瑚 (Cyphastrea sp.) 是野生捕获标本的健康且有吸引力的替代品，并且不会导致世界珊瑚礁的衰退。大多数 Cyphastrea 珊瑚都有硬壳结构，由于它们耐寒且生长速度快，因此很受欢迎。额外的兴趣是因为它们可以经历一些颜色变化，在水箱条件最佳时显示出更鲜艳的颜色。由于它们是半攻击性珊瑚，因此需要适度的护理水平，因此水族爱好者在它们和其他珊瑚之间留出空间非常重要它们之所以被放入水族箱中，是因为随着它们的生长，它们的触角会远远超出它们的底部。美国水产养殖的 Cyphastrea 珊瑚将通过其体内的光合作用、共生虫黄藻来满足其大部分营养需求。它们还将受益于偶尔以微型浮游生物或为珊瑚设计的食物形式的广播喂养。为了持续保持健康，这些珊瑚需要添加

products.title: Helfrichi Firefish
products.description: The Helfrichi's Firefish is also known as the Helfrich's Dartfish, or Helfrich's Firefish. The head is distinctly yellow with a purple forehead, and the body is varying shades of purple and white. It requires a 20 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of loose coral rubble as part of the aquascape, and a tight-fitting lid to prevent it from jumping out of the tank. It will rarely become aggressive towards other fish, but is territorial, and will fight with its own kind unless they are a bonded pair. The Helfrichi's Firefish will feed mostly on prey suspended in the water column, but will pick food off the substrate. Its diet should vary between chopped or shaved seafood, vitamin-enriched brine shrimp, and mysis shrimp. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1/2" to 1-1/4"; Medium: 1-1/4" to 2"; Large: 2" to 2-1/2"

products.title: Green Cynarina Button Coral 2.75"
products.description: The Green Cynarina Button Coral, a large polyp stony (LPS) coral, is often called the Cat's Eye, Tooth, Doughnut, Teary Eye, or Meat Coral. Its genus name, Cynarina , originates from the Greek words kinara (artichoke) and ina (similar to), which fittingly describe its artichoke-like appearance. This solitary, round coral is among the largest single-polyped corals in nature and is available in a variety of color forms, ranging from pastel to bright and translucent, to vibrant shades like red, as well as more muted tones. It is sometimes mistaken for its close relative, Scolymia . Although it is not aggressive, the Cynarina Button Coral should have adequate space from other corals, as it can expand to twice its original size. It is simple to care for in a reef aquarium, making it a great choice for both novice and experienced reef aquarists. It thrives under medium lighting and low water movement. To maintain good health, the water should be supplemented with calcium, strontium, and other essential trace elements. This coral should be fed meaty foods such as micro-plankton or brine shrimp during the evening.

products.title: Zoanthus Coral 3.75"
products.description: The Zoanthus Colony Polyp Corals are stunning color varieties of the Zoanthus Colony Polyp Coral, also commonly known as Sea Mats or Button Polyps. These soft corals are prized for their bright, eye-catching hues and are available in a wide array of color morphs that add vibrant visual interest to reef aquariums. Each colony is composed of multiple individual polyps growing together on a piece of live rock, creating a carpet-like effect that enhances reefscapes with dynamic texture and movement. Zoanthus corals are relatively easy to care for, making them great choices for beginner and seasoned aquarists alike. They thrive in low to moderate water flow and under moderate lighting provided by T-5s, powerful LEDs, or metal halides. Regular supplementation of iodine and trace elements will help maintain polyp health and coloration. These corals multiply easily in established reef systems through budding, expanding their colony coverage over time. The symbiotic zooxanthellae algae they host fulfill most of their nutritional needs through photosynthesis. However, under suboptimal lighting, they may benefit from supplemental feeding with micro-plankton, baby brine shrimp, or other filter

products.title: Montipora Coral, Red/Orange 2.5"
products.description: The Montipora Coral, is a small polyp stony (SPS) coral also referred to as Rice Coral. This encrusting, massive, and highly-prized Montipora has large bumps or verrucae like tapioca. As it grows, it expands into a textured, vivid Red/Orange carpet enhancing your home reef aquarium. The Montipora Coral, is peaceful and can be placed in close proximity to other similar peaceful corals in the reef aquarium. It is moderately difficult to maintain and should be housed in a mature reef aquarium. It will require medium lighting combined with a medium intermittent water movement within the aquarium. For continued good health, it will also require the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. Montipora will thrive in a variety of lighting conditions, ranging from power compacts, VHO, T-5's up to the more intense metal halides. Alter their position in the aquarium depending on the lighting, and provide at least 3 watts per gallon using one of the lighting systems mentioned above. It will also benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of micro-plankton or foods designed for filter feeding invertebrates.

products.title: Red Panda Discus 5.75"
products.description: The overall coloration of Discus will vary depending on mood and overall health of the fish. The Discus has surpassed the Angelfish as the most popular freshwater aquarium fish. Depending on sub-species, the natural range of the Discus extends from the Amazon to the Rio Negro Regions of South America. Discus require an advanced level of care due to its feeding habits and water filtration requirements. Territorial during spawning, this otherwise peaceful fish is among the schooling group, forming a well-defined nuclear family. Becoming slightly territorial when breeding, it is best to breed an established pair, or maintain a group of young Discus and allow them to pair themselves. Warm, soft, slightly acidic water is required for spawning. The pair will clean a flat surface (usually a broad leaf or the side of the aquarium) prior to spawning. The parents must not be removed from the fry; the fry feed on their parents' mucus. Largely carnivorous, Discus prefer freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, pellet food designed for Discus, high-quality flake food, and meaty frozen foods.
products.description_zh: 七彩神仙的整体颜色会根据鱼的情绪和整体健康状况而变化。七彩神仙鱼已超越神仙鱼成为最受欢迎的淡水观赏鱼。根据亚种的不同，七彩神仙的自然分布范围从亚马逊延伸到南美洲的里奥内格罗地区。由于其进食习惯和水过滤要求，七彩神仙需要高级护理。这种原本性情温和的鱼在产卵期间会成为鱼群中的领地，形成一个明确的核心家庭。繁殖时会变得稍微有领地意识，最好繁殖成对，或者养一群年轻的七彩神仙，让它们自己配对。温暖、柔软、产卵需要微酸性水。产卵前，它们会清洁平坦的表面（通常是阔叶或水族箱的侧面）。不得将亲本从鱼苗中取出；鱼苗以父母的粘液为食。七彩神仙主要是肉食性的，喜欢冻干红虫和红虫、专为七彩神仙设计的颗粒食品、优质片状食品和肉质冷冻食品。

products.title: Black Storm Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Captive-Bred Black Storm Clownfish derives its lineage from a mutation that appeared during the selective breeding of the Mocha Vinci Clownfish. The Captive-Bred Black Storm Clownfish demonstrates an exaggerated white body pattern with an almost entirely white face. Black Storm Clownfish retain the prominent white swirl and curve, or “storm” pattern. While juveniles, the Black Storm Clownfish has dark orange coloration of the spots in between the white pattern. As the Black Storm Clownfish matures its dark orange color transitions to jet black creating a stunning contrast of pattern. The Black Storm Clownfish does best housed in an aquarium of at least 20 gallons or larger with plenty of live rock. It may form a symbiotic relationship with the following species of anemones; Carpet (Stichodactyla sp.) , Sebae (Heteractis crispa) , Bulb (Entacmaea quadricolor) , or Ritteri (Heteractis magnifica) . Though the Black Storm Clownfish does not require an anemone to thrive, if you choose to house an anemone, always be sure that your aquarium and lighting system will support the needs of the host anemone before incorporating one into the aquarium. What distinguishes this specific variety from conventional Ocellaris Clownfish is the prominent white banding that curve and merge together like brush strokes. Unlike Snowflake Ocellaris Clownfish that demonstrate a similarly high degree of white coloration but in a disorganized and random pattern, the Davinci Clownfish retains the orange coloration in neat, broad blocks beautifully traced by black striping. Captive-Bred DaVinci Clownfish are avaible in Grade A and Grade B. Grade A feature two connected white stripes. The Grade B category demonstrate 3 distinct wavy stripes with soft, rounded edges. The Davinci Clownfish does best housed in an aquarium of at least 20 gallons or larger with plenty of live rock. It may form a symbiotic relationship with the following species of anemones; Carpet (Stichodactyla sp.) , Sebae (Heteractis crispa) , Bulb (Entacmaea quadricolor) , or Ritteri (Heteractis magnifica) . products.title: Picasso Percula Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Captive-Bred Picasso Percula Clownfish is an interesting and desirable variation of the Percula Clownfish. This fish is orange with irregularly shaped white patches outlined in black. This member of the Pomacentridae family is an excellent addition to almost any saltwater aquarium system. Captive-bred fish have a unique advantage over wild-harvested species, as they are generally very hardy and more accustomed to conditions found in the home aquarium. Therefore, captive-bred fishes make a great choice for novices and seasoned aquarists alike. The Captive-Bred Picasso Percula Clownfish is easy to breed in the home aquarium. The females will be the largest of the pair and the two fish will usually stay close to each other in the aquarium. Clownfish are egg layers and will deposit the eggs on a flat surface and defend the eggs from other tank mates. The eggs will normally hatch in 8-11 days depending on the water temperature. The fry must be reared in a separate aquarium on a diet of rotifers followed by baby brine shrimp. This Clownfish is an aggressive eater. It will accept most meaty foods and frozen herbivore preparations. Approximate Purchase Size: 1-1/4" to 1-3/4"
products.description_zh: 人工饲养的毕加索小丑鱼是小丑鱼的一个​​有趣且令人向往的变种。这条鱼呈橙色，带有黑色轮廓的不规则形状白色斑块。这种 Pomacentridae 家族的成员是几乎所有咸水水族箱系统的绝佳补充。人工饲养的鱼类比野生捕捞的鱼类具有独特的优势，因为它们通常非常耐寒，并且更适应家庭水族箱中的条件。因此，圈养鱼类对于新手和经验丰富的鱼友来说都是一个不错的选择。人工饲养的毕加索小丑鱼很容易在家庭水族箱中繁殖。雌性将是这对鱼中最大的，两条鱼将通常在水族馆里彼此保持靠近。小丑鱼是产蛋鱼，会将鱼卵产在平坦的表面上，并保护鱼卵免受其他鱼缸同伴的侵害。卵通常会在 8-11 天孵化，具体取决于水温。鱼苗必须在单独的水族箱中饲养，以轮虫为食，然后是丰年虾幼虫。这条小丑鱼的食性极强。它可以接受大多数肉类食物和冷冻草食动物制剂。大约购买尺寸：1-1/4" 至 1-3/4"

products.title: Balanced Clean-Up Pack
products.description: The Balanced Clean-Up Pack offers targeted coverage across tank surfaces, substrate, and crevices. It includes 10 Astraea Turbo Snails for algae control, 10 Nassarius Snails to keep the sandbed clean and aerated, and 10 Blue Leg Hermit Crabs to tackle leftover food and organic waste. Great for aquarists looking for a functional, diversified clean-up crew.
products.description_zh: 平衡清洁包可有针对性地覆盖储罐表面、基材和缝隙。它包括 10 只用于控制藻类的 Astraea Turbo Snails、10 只用于保持沙床清洁和通风的 Nassarius Snails 以及 10 只用于处理剩余食物和有机废物的蓝腿寄居蟹。非常适合寻找功能齐全、多元化的清洁人员的水族爱好者。

products.title: White Cichlid
products.description: Contrary to its name, the White Cichlid Paraneetroplus argenteus actually has a silvery white background with black undertones in the fins. This tropical freshwater fish can display aggression toward smaller fish, so keep them in a tank with other larger fish with similar temperament. Provide plenty of room to swim and have many hiding places to establish territories in to help ease aggression. Growing to about 10 ½” when fully mature, they are difficult to sex, but males are usually larger than the females. To create a tank environment that White Cichlids will thrive in, good filtration is necessary, as these fish produce a lot of waste. A tropical fish, they prefer water temperature between 78-86 degrees with pH levels of approximately 7.0 in a tank of at least 75 gallons in size. The White Cichlid likes to uproot plants, so select hardy options for the tank bottom. They also use floating plants as cover. White Cichlids spawn on cleaned rocks and can lay up to 1000 eggs. Cichlids parents may eat their spawn. White Cichlids are omnivores that will eat most prepared and frozen foods, including freeze-dried bloodworms, brine shrimp, and tubifex, as well as flake food and Cichlid pel
products.description_zh: 与它的名字相反，白色丽鱼科鱼Paraneetroplus argenteus实际上有银白色的背景，鳍上有黑色的底色。这种热带淡水鱼会对较小的鱼表现出攻击性，因此请将它们与其他性情相似的较大鱼放在一个鱼缸中。提供足够的游泳空间，并有许多藏身之处来建立领地，以帮助缓解攻击性。完全成熟时长到约 10 ½ 英寸，很难进行性交，但雄性通常比雌性大。为了创造白慈鲷能够茁壮成长的鱼缸环境，良好的过滤是必要的，因为这些鱼会产生大量废物。热带鱼，它们喜欢介于在至少 75 加仑大小的水箱中，温度为 78-86 度，pH 值约为 7.0。白慈鲷喜欢将植物连根拔起，因此请为水箱底部选择耐寒的材料。他们还使用漂浮植物作为掩护。白慈鲷在干净的岩石上产卵，最多可产 1000 个卵。慈鲷的父母可能会吃掉它们的卵。白慈鲷是杂食动物，会吃大多数准备好的和冷冻的食物，包括冻干红虫、丰年虾和水母，以及片状食物和慈鲷鱼片

products.title: Bleeker's Hawkfish
products.description: While the Bleeker's Hawkfish Cirrhitichthys bleekeri may not be as rare as its cousin the Golden Hawkfish, it is still an uncommon Hawkfish. Presenting in a mottled brown and orange color, it only grows to a little over 3” in length. This Hawkfish is collected in the eastern region of the Indian Ocean where it can be found perched on rocky coral reefs, where it is on the lookout for prey. The Bleeker’s Hawkfish is an aquatic species that can withstand stronger water currents because it has the ability to use its fins to anchor itself onto rock. A 30 gallon or larger aquarium with plenty of hiding places is acceptable for this semi-aggressive marine fish. Although it may eat small fish and shrimp, it can become part of your reef aquarium under watchful conditions. A carnivorous member of the Cirrhitidae family, the diet of the Bleeker’s Hawkfish should include a variety of crustacean or marine meats, Mysis and brine shrimp, and krill. Approximate Shipping Size : Medium
products.description_zh: 虽然布利克鹰鱼 Cirritichthys bleekeri 可能不像它的表亲金鹰鱼那么稀有，但它仍然是一种不常见的鹰鱼。呈斑驳的棕色和橙色，长度仅超过 3 英寸。这种鹰鱼是在印度洋东部地区采集的，栖息在岩石珊瑚礁上，在那里寻找猎物。布利克鹰鱼是一种水生物种，可以承受更强的水流，因为它能够使用鳍将自己固定在岩石上。30 加仑或更大的水族箱，有足够的藏身之处是可以接受的对于这种半攻击性的海洋鱼来说，尽管它可能吃小鱼和鱼类。边缘，在小心的条件下它可以成为您的珊瑚礁水族箱的一部分。布利克鹰鱼是卷鱼科的肉食性成员，其饮食应包括各种甲壳类或海产肉类、糠虾、丰年虾以及磷虾。大约运输尺寸：中号

products.title: Neon Goby
products.description: The head and sleek body of the Neon Goby, also known as the Neon Blue Goby, are dark blue with a striking horizontal light-blue stripe on each side beginning above the eye and running the entire length of the body. The Neon Goby is a very hardy fish, and because its small size, is a great addition to a small reef tank. It should be housed in a 10-gallon or larger aquarium. It is a cleaner species which will service tank mates and help control some diseases. Rarely will it become aggressive towards other fish, but it is territorial, and will fight with its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It is common for the Neon Goby to spawn in an aquarium, laying its eggs in a crevice or empty shell. It feeds on a variety of live and frozen brine shrimp, frozen mysis shrimp, table shrimp, and frozen food preparations for carnivores. If kept in a reef tank, the Neon Goby should be fed once per day. Approximate Purchase Size: 3/4" to 1-1/4"
products.description_zh: 霓虹虾虎鱼（也称为霓虹蓝虾虎鱼）的头部和光滑的身体呈深蓝色，每侧都有醒目的浅蓝色水平条纹，从眼睛上方开始一直延伸到身体的整个长度。霓虹虾虎鱼是一种非常耐寒的鱼，而且由于其体型较小，因此是小型珊瑚缸的绝佳补充。应将其放置在 10 加仑或更大的水族箱中。它是一种比较清洁的物种，可以为坦克伙伴提供服务并帮助控制一些疾病。它很少会对其他鱼产生攻击性，但它有领地意识，会与同类打架，除非它们是配对的。霓虹虾虎鱼在水族馆中产卵是很常见的，将卵产在缝隙或空壳中。它以各种活的和冷冻的丰年虾、冷冻糠虾、食用虾和食肉动物的冷冻食品制剂为食。如果饲养在珊瑚缸中，霓虹虾虎鱼应该每天喂食一次。大约购买尺寸：3/4" 至 1-1/4"

products.title: Splendid Dottyback, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Captive-Bred Splendid Dottyback, also known as the Splendid Pseudochromis is an ornate fish boasting beautiful coloration and intricate markings. A warm, peach coloration washes over the body, providing the perfect complement for the lovely yellow coloration that highlights the tail and face of the Splendid Dottyback. A geometric, checkerboard pattern decorates the body as well as the dorsal and anal fins to dramatic effect. The black stripe that runs vertically across the eyes forms a handsome mask that harmonizes wonderfully with the black stripe echoed through the pectoral fins. A 30-gallon or larger established aquarium aquascaped liberally with live rock provides a good environment for the Captive-Bred Splendid Dottyback. Demonstrating strong territorial behavior, the Captive-Bred Splendid Dottyback will not shy away from other fish as it defend its territory, even against fish two to three times its size. This species may be territorial in smaller aquarium setups, so it is best to house the Captive-Bred Splendid Dottyback in a larger setup with larger tank mates. The Captive-Bred Splendid Dottyback is an active fish with a hearty appetite and will not pass the opportunity
products.description_zh: 人工饲养的锦鲤，也被称为锦鲤，是一种华丽的鱼，拥有美丽的色彩和复杂的斑纹。温暖的桃色覆盖全身，与可爱的黄色形成完美的互补，突出了灿烂斑背鸟的尾巴和脸部。几何棋盘图案装饰身体以及背鳍和臀鳍，产生戏剧性的效果。垂直穿过眼睛的黑色条纹形成一个漂亮的面具，与胸鳍上呼应的黑色条纹完美协调。 30加仑或更大的水族箱，配有大量活石，可提供良好的环境为圈养繁殖的锦绣斑背鹬而生。圈养繁殖的锦鲤表现出强烈的领地行为，在保卫领地时不会回避其他鱼类，甚至面对体型是其两到三倍的鱼类。该物种在较小的水族箱环境中可能具有领地意识，因此最好将圈养的锦鲤饲养在较大的环境中，并与较大的水族箱伙伴一起饲养。圈养的锦鲤是一种活跃的鱼，食欲旺盛，不会放过这个机会

products.title: Indigo Dottyback, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Indigo Dottyback is a striking Pseudochromis that boasts a respected lineage of two marine aquarium favorites. The Indigo Dottyback is a hybrid between the Orchid Dottyback ( Pseudochromis fridmani ) and the Striped Dottyback ( Pseudochromis sankeyi ). The resulting offspring are beautifully colored fish sporting a soothing indigo coloration. At first glance, the Indigo Dottyback looks as though it takes after the brilliantly-colored Orchid Dottyback (appearing more like an exciting color morph of the Orchid Dottyback rather than a hybrid). However, upon closer examination, traits of the Striped Dottyback can be seen. Though the dominant stripe running parallel to the lateral line is greatly subdued, the Indigo Dottyback exhibits the same dark stripe that runs the entire ventral length of the Striped Dottyback. The unique indigo coloration and the dark graphic stripe add distinction to this wonderful captive-bred hybrid. LiveAquaria.com is proud to offer the Indigo Dottyback as another choice in our growing selection of aquacultured and captive-bred aquatic life. The ideal setup for the Indigo Dottyback will be an established saltwater aquarium of at least 30 gallons in size aq
products.description_zh: 靛蓝斑背鱼是一种引人瞩目的拟色鱼，拥有备受尊敬的两种海洋水族馆最爱的血统。靛蓝斑纹龟是兰花斑纹龟 (Pseudochromis fridmani) 和条纹斑纹龟 (Pseudochromis sankeyi) 的杂交品种。由此产生的后代是颜色美丽的鱼，呈现出舒缓的靛蓝色。乍一看，Indigo Dottyback 看起来就像是色彩鲜艳的 Orchid Dottyback（看起来更像是 Orchid Dottyback 的令人兴奋的颜色变形，而不是混合体）。然而，经过仔细观察，可以看出条纹斑背鸟的特征。尽管与侧线平行的主要条纹是灰色靛蓝斑纹龟的性格十分柔和，它的整个腹侧都有与条纹斑纹龟相同的深色条纹。独特的靛蓝颜色和深色图形条纹为这种美妙的圈养杂交品种增添了特色。 LiveAquaria.com 很自豪能够提供 Indigo Dottyback 作为我们不断增长的水产养殖和圈养水生生物选择中的另一种选择。 Indigo Dottyback 的理想设置是一个容量至少为 30 加仑的咸水水族箱

products.title: Haddon's Carpet Anemone, Blue
products.description: The Haddon's Carpet Anemone lives singly, in the shallow waters of the Indo Pacific and Red Sea. Found outside of the reef it resides in soft muddy or sandy substrate and can attain a size of up to 3 feet in diameter. This colorful Anemone is also referred to as Haddon’s Anemone, Saddle Anemone, Saddle Carpet Anemone, or Saddleback Anemone. Haddon's Carpet Anemone have short, blunt tentacles with a very potent sting, and can be distinguished from their close relatives Stichodactyla gigantea and Stichodactyla mertensii by the lack of any coloration, spots or markings on the underside of the anemone and down its column. This anemone serves as a "host" for many types of Clownfish in the wild including: Amphiprion clarkii, A. sebae, A. akindynos, A. chrysogaster, A. chrysopterus, and A. polymnus. In the home aquarium, they can also serve as host for Amphiprion ocellaris, A. percula, and A. allardi. The Haddon's Carpet Anemone requires a tank with strong lighting and good water movement. The aquarium should have a variety of sandy and rocky locations as this animal oftentimes can move about and seek refuge in a place it prefers. This species of Carpet Anemone prefers to bury its foot in
products.description_zh: 哈顿地毯海葵单独生活在印度太平洋和红海的浅水区。它发现于珊瑚礁之外，栖息在柔软的泥质或沙质基质中，直径可达 3 英尺。这种色彩缤纷的海葵也被称为哈顿海葵、马鞍海葵、马鞍地毯海葵或马鞍海葵。哈登地毯海葵的触手短而钝，具有很强的刺痛能力，并且可以通过海葵底部和柱子下方没有任何颜色、斑点或标记来与它们的近亲 Stichodactyla gigantea 和 Stichodactyla mertensii 区分开来。这种海葵是许多野生小丑鱼的“宿主”包括：克氏双虾、sebae、A. akindynos、A. chrysogaster、A. chrysopterus 和 A. polymnus。在家庭水族箱中，它们还可以作为双眼双足鱼（Amphiprion ocellaris）、鲈鱼（A. percula）和阿拉迪双足鱼（A. allardi）的宿主。哈顿地毯海葵需要一个光线充足、水流良好的水箱。水族馆应该有各种沙地和岩石位置，因为这种动物经常可以在它喜欢的地方四处走动并寻求庇护。这种地毯海葵喜欢将脚埋在

products.title: Gold Dot Maroon Clownfish, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Captive-Bred Gold Dot Maroon Clownfish is a variation of the incredible Gold Stripe Maroon Clownfish. Every Captive-Bred Gold Dot Maroon Clownfish is a one-of-a-kind fish, as no two individuals look the same. As juveniles, these fish will display a brilliant dot somewhere between their three bands, almost like a drop of paint. As the fish mature, the dot will shift into hues of metallic gold. Maroon Clownfish are well known for their intense coloration and oversized fins as well as their confident disposition. An adult sized Captive-Bred Gold Dot Maroon Clownfish with fully mature coloration is a remarkable centerpiece fish for any home aquarium. When pairing this species, it's typically best to have a dramatic difference in size between the individuals. Captive-Bred Clownfish are very hardy and durable fish making them a perfect addition for the novice or seasoned aquarist. Captive-Bred Clownfish are also good candidates for reef aquariums. In general, Maroon Clownfish are the most territorial of all clownfish species. Maroon Clownfish are very sensitive to elevated levels of copper, and should never be exposed to levels near or above 0.15. Captive-Bred Clownfish are easy to b
products.description_zh: 人工饲养的金点栗色小丑鱼是令人难以置信的金条纹栗色小丑鱼的变种。每条人工饲养的金点栗色小丑鱼都是独一无二的鱼，因为没有两条鱼看起来是一样的。作为幼鱼，这些鱼会在三条带之间的某处显示出一个明亮的点，几乎就像一滴油漆。随着鱼的成熟，该点会变成金属金色。栗色小丑鱼以其浓烈的色彩、超大的鳍以及自信的性格而闻名。成年体型的圈养金点栗色小丑鱼，颜色完全成熟，是任何家庭水族箱中引人注目的中心鱼。当配对这个物种时，通常是个体之间最好有巨大的体型差异。圈养的小丑鱼是非常耐寒和耐久的鱼，这使得它们成为新手或经验丰富的水族爱好者的完美选择。人工饲养的小丑鱼也是珊瑚礁水族馆的理想选择。一般来说，栗色小丑鱼是所有小丑鱼物种中最具领地意识的。栗色小丑鱼对铜含量升高非常敏感，切勿暴露于接近或高于 0.15 的铜含量。人工饲养的小丑鱼很容易饲养

products.title: Tomato Clownfish
products.description: The Tomato Clownfish, also known as the Bridled Clownfish or Red Clownfish, is found throughout the Pacific, almost always in association with an anemone such as Bubbletip Sea Anemone ( Entacmaea quadricolor ). The Tomato Clownfish has a wider distribution than the Fire Clown, which is usually restricted to the Indo-Pacific reefs. It has also been known to use coral as a host in the absence of an anemone. The Tomato Clownfish is a bright orange-red with one white vertical stripe behind the eyes. It can attain a length in the wild of 5 inches, but it usually reaches a maximum of 3.5 inches in an aquarium. The very hardy Tomato Clownfish can be housed with most fish that will not eat it and is a good choice for tank-cycling. It should not be housed with any shy or passive feeding fish, as the Tomato Clownfish tends to be somewhat territorial and aggressive with conspecifics and as it gets older. As with all clownfish, most are born as males, and the dominant male will change to a female. An aggressive eater, the Tomato Clownfish will consume most meaty foods and herbivore preparations. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 3/4" to 1-1/4"; Medium: 1-1/4" to 2-1/2"; Large: 2-1/2" to 4"
products.description_zh: 番茄小丑鱼，也被称为缰绳小丑鱼或红色小丑鱼，遍布整个太平洋，几乎总是与泡尖海葵（Entacmaea 四色）等海葵有关。番茄小丑鱼的分布范围比火小丑鱼更广泛，后者通常仅限于印度-太平洋珊瑚礁。人们还知道，在没有海葵的情况下，它会使用珊瑚作为宿主。番茄小丑鱼呈明亮的橙红色，眼睛后面有一条白色的垂直条纹。它在野外的长度可以达到 5 英寸，但在水族箱中通常最大可达 3.5 英寸。非常耐寒的番茄小丑鱼可以与大多数不吃它的鱼一起饲养，并且坦克循环的好选择。番茄小丑鱼不应该与任何害羞或被动进食的鱼一起饲养，因为随着年龄的增长，番茄小丑鱼往往对同种鱼有一定的领地意识和攻击性。与所有小丑鱼一样，大多数出生时都是雄性，占主导地位的雄性会变成雌性。番茄小丑鱼的食性极强，会吃掉大部分肉类食物和草食动物制剂。大致购买尺寸：小号：3/4 英寸至 1-1/4 英寸；中号：1-1/4" 至 2-1/2"；大号：2-1/2" 至 4"

products.title: Candy Cane Coral Indonesia 2.5"
products.description: The Caulastrea Candy Cane Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as the Trumpet, Torch, Candy, or Bullseye Coral. Its genus name, Caulastrea , comes from the Latin kaulos (stalk), and aster (star) describing its skeletal structure consisting of tubular stalks with stars on each tip. The plump circular polyps are vibrant green, yellow, or blue and brown, with the Candy Cane Coral from Tonga being a brilliant translucent green to teal and brown, and each tip is white. Under actinic light its colorful polyps will stand out from most other corals. It is hardy and a relatively peaceful reef inhabitant, with very short sweeper tentacles. It requires moderate lighting and moderate water movement, along with the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: Caulastrea 糖蔗珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为喇叭珊瑚、火炬珊瑚、糖果珊瑚或牛眼珊瑚。它的属名 Caulastrea 源自拉丁语 kaulos（茎）和 aster（星星），描述其骨骼结构，由管状茎组成，每个尖端都有星星。丰满的圆形水螅体呈鲜艳的绿色、黄色或蓝色和棕色，来自汤加的糖蔗珊瑚呈明亮的半透明绿色到青色和棕色，每个尖端都是白色的。在光化光下，其色彩缤纷的水螅体将从大多数其他珊瑚中脱颖而出。它是一种耐寒且相对安静的珊瑚礁居民，具有非常短的清扫触手。它需要适度的照明和适度的水的运动，同时向水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Candy Cane Coral Indonesia 2"
products.description: The Caulastrea Candy Cane Coral is a large polyp stony (LPS) coral often referred to as the Trumpet, Torch, Candy, or Bullseye Coral. Its genus name, Caulastrea , comes from the Latin kaulos (stalk), and aster (star) describing its skeletal structure consisting of tubular stalks with stars on each tip. The plump circular polyps are vibrant green, yellow, or blue and brown, with the Candy Cane Coral from Tonga being a brilliant translucent green to teal and brown, and each tip is white. Under actinic light its colorful polyps will stand out from most other corals. It is hardy and a relatively peaceful reef inhabitant, with very short sweeper tentacles. It requires moderate lighting and moderate water movement, along with the addition of calcium, strontium, and other trace elements to the water. It will benefit from additional food fed weekly in the form of brine shrimp or micro-plankton.
products.description_zh: Caulastrea 糖蔗珊瑚是一种大型息肉石 (LPS) 珊瑚，通常被称为喇叭珊瑚、火炬珊瑚、糖果珊瑚或牛眼珊瑚。它的属名 Caulastrea 源自拉丁语 kaulos（茎）和 aster（星星），描述其骨骼结构，由管状茎组成，每个尖端都有星星。丰满的圆形水螅体呈鲜艳的绿色、黄色或蓝色和棕色，来自汤加的糖蔗珊瑚呈明亮的半透明绿色到青色和棕色，每个尖端都是白色的。在光化光下，其色彩缤纷的水螅体将从大多数其他珊瑚中脱颖而出。它是一种耐寒且相对安静的珊瑚礁居民，具有非常短的清扫触手。它需要适度的照明和适度的水的运动，同时向水中添加钙、锶和其他微量元素。每周以丰年虾或微型浮游生物的形式喂食额外的食物将使其受益。

products.title: Yellow Tang, Hawaii
products.description: The Yellow Hawaiian Tang is for many aquarists, the definitive fish of home saltwater aquariums. With its oval-shaped, vibrant yellow body, Zebrasoma flavescens brightens any marine system. The Yellow Hawaiian Tang is an active swimmer that will glide throughout your aquarium in near constant motion, acting as an aquarium tour guide of sorts to any onlooker who follows its meandering swim path. Though iconic to the reefs of Hawaii, the Yellow Hawaiian Tang's natural habitat is actually widespread throughout the Pacific Ocean as far as Indonesia and the Great Barrier Reef. The Yellow Hawaiian Tang is also known as the Yellow Sailfin Tang or Yellow Surgeonfish. For best care, it should be housed in an aquarium of at least 100 gallons with ample room to swim. Like other Tangs, this member of the Acanthuridae family demonstrates territorial aggression towards its own species, or Tangs in general. Therefore, it is best to keep just one Yellow Hawaiian Tang per aquarium, unless multiple Yellow Hawaiian Tangs are introduced into the system simultaneously. Although the Yellow Hawaiian Tang will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important the Yellow Hawaiian T
products.description_zh: 对于许多水族爱好者来说，黄色夏威夷唐吊是家庭咸水水族箱中的最佳鱼类。黄斑斑马鱼以其椭圆形、充满活力的黄色身体，照亮了任何海洋系统。黄色夏威夷唐唐是一种活跃的游泳者，它会以近乎恒定的运动在您的水族箱中滑行，对于任何沿着蜿蜒的游泳路线的旁观者来说，它就像水族馆的导游。虽然黄色夏威夷唐吨是夏威夷珊瑚礁的标志性标志，但它的自然栖息地实际上广泛分布于整个太平洋，远至印度尼西亚和大堡礁。黄夏威夷唐鱼也被称为黄旗鱼唐鱼或黄刺尾鱼。为了获得最好的护理，应该是在房子里饲养在至少 100 加仑且有足够游泳空间的水族箱中。与其他唐人一样，这种棘尾唐人科的成员对自己的物种或一般唐人表现出领土侵略性。因此，每个水族箱最好只饲养一只黄色夏威夷唐唐，除非系统同时引入多只黄色夏威夷唐唐。虽然黄色夏威夷唐鱼会和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉食，但黄色夏威夷唐鱼很重要

products.title: Lavender Tang
products.description: The Lavender Tang, also known as the Spot-Cheeked Surgeonfish, travels in large schools on the reefs of the Central Pacific. This beautiful fish is colored in tones of lavender and tan, and has multiple orange spots on the face. The orange spots give away to many small black spots covering the rest of the body, and the tail is forked. A 125 gallon aquarium or larger is necessary to provide plenty of swimming room. Live rock is preferred by this species for grazing, and will provide plenty of structure for hiding places and territories. It is aggressive toward other Tangs and Surgeonfish, but peaceful with other fish. Although Tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" to 2" ; Small/Medium: 2" to 3" ; Medium: 3" to 4" ; Medium/Large: 4" to 5"; Large: 5" to 6"
products.description_zh: 薰衣草唐鱼，也被称为斑点颊刺鱼，成群结队地在中太平洋的珊瑚礁上活动。这条美丽的鱼呈淡紫色和棕褐色，脸上有多个橙色斑点。橙色的斑点掩盖了身体其余部分的许多小黑色斑点，尾巴是分叉的。需要 125 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳空间。该物种更喜欢活石来放牧，并且可以为藏身之处和领地提供充足的结构。它对其他唐鱼和刺尾鱼有攻击性，但对其他鱼却很和平。虽然唐鱼会和水族箱中的其他鱼一起吃肉食嗯，重要的是为他们提供大量的海洋海藻和藻类。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。大约购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸至 2 英寸；小号/中号：2 英寸至 3 英寸；中号：3 英寸至 4 英寸；中/大号：4 英寸至 5 英寸；大号：5 英寸至 6 英寸

products.title: Neon Blue Goby, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Neon Blue Goby, or Neon Goby, is known for its gorgeous electric blue stripes. The head and sleek body of the Neon Blue Goby are dark blue with a striking horizontal, light-blue stripe on each side of the body. These signature stripes begin above the eyes and run the entire length of the body. The Neon Blue Goby is a very hardy fish and because of its small size, it makes a great addition to smaller nano reef aquariums. The Neon Blue Goby should be housed in a 10 gallon or larger aquarium. Rarely will it become aggressive towards other fish. However, the Neon Blue Goby is territorial and will demonstrate aggression towards its own kind unless they are a mated pair. It is common for the Neon Blue Goby to spawn in an aquarium, laying its eggs in a crevice or empty shell. In the wild, parasites picked off larger reef fish make up a portion of the Neon Blue Goby's natural diet. However, in the home aquarium, the Neon Blue Goby needs to be fed a variety of live and frozen brine shrimp, frozen mysis shrimp, table shrimp, and frozen food preparations for carnivores. If kept in a reef aquarium, the Neon Blue Goby should be fed once per day. Approximate Purchase Size: Medium: 1" to 2"
products.description_zh: 霓虹蓝虾虎鱼，或称霓虹虾虎鱼，以其华丽的电蓝色条纹而闻名。霓虹蓝虾虎鱼的头部和光滑的身体是深蓝色的，身体两侧有醒目的浅蓝色水平条纹。这些标志性条纹从眼睛上方开始，贯穿整个身体。霓虹蓝虾虎鱼是一种非常耐寒的鱼，由于其体型较小，它非常适合小型纳米珊瑚礁水族箱。霓虹蓝虾虎鱼应饲养在 10 加仑或更大的水族箱中。它很少会对其他鱼产生攻击性。然而，霓虹蓝虾虎鱼有领地意识，会对同类表现出攻击性，除非它们是配对的。常见的是N无数的蓝虾虎鱼在水族箱中产卵，将卵产在缝隙或空壳中。在野外，霓虹蓝虾虎鱼天然饮食的一部分是从较大的礁鱼身上摘下来的寄生虫。然而，在家庭水族箱中，霓虹蓝虾虎鱼需要喂食各种活的和冷冻的丰年虾、冷冻糠虾、食用虾以及肉食动物的冷冻食品制剂。如果饲养在珊瑚礁水族箱中，霓虹蓝虾虎鱼应每天喂食一次。大致购买尺寸：中号：1 英寸至 2 英寸

products.title: Red Louti Grouper
products.description: As a juvenile, The Red Louti Grouper, also known as the Coronation Grouper or Lyretail Grouper, is orange dorsally, and yellowish-white ventrally, with mulitple spots. It often has some black patches separating the dorsal and ventral halves. As an adult, the body darkens to a deeper red or maroon, with multiple spots, and the tail takes on a lyre shape. A 300 gallon or larger aquarium is required due to its size and eating habits. It is an aggressive fish and may eat tank mates as well as crustaceans. The Red Louti Grouper prefers a diet of meaty foods such as krill, shrimp, and other small fish. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1-1/2" to 2"; Medium: 2" to 4"; Large: 4" to 6"
products.description_zh: 幼鱼时，红路提石斑鱼又名加冕石斑鱼或琴尾石斑鱼，背部呈橙色，腹面黄白色，有多个斑点。它通常有一些黑色斑点将背侧和腹侧分开。成年后，身体颜色变深，呈深红色或栗色，有多个斑点，尾巴呈七弦琴形状。由于其大小和饮食习惯，需要 300 加仑或更大的水族箱。它是一种攻击性鱼类，可能吃水族箱中的同伴以及甲壳类动物。红路提石斑鱼喜欢吃肉类食物，如磷虾、虾和其他小鱼。大致购买尺寸：小号：1-1/2 英寸至 2 英寸；中号：2" 至 4"；大号：4 英寸至 6 英寸

products.title: Galaxy (L-240) Plecostomus 3.5"
products.description: The Galaxy Plecostomus also known as the Vampire or Tooth-Nose Pleco Pleco, comes from the Amazon Basin of South America. It is black with many striking yellow spots covering the entire body. The common name for this catfish comes from the bristle-like barbells that are present on the upper side of the mouth. Tooth-Nose Plecos make good additions to any community aquarium. Planted aquariums with high aeration and water movement make for a healthy environment. Rocks and driftwood help to accent a natural habitat and provide hiding spaces to cut down on stress for the Tooth-Nose Pleco. A recommended minimum tank of 50 gallons should be provided to house this fish. Breeding in an aquarium setting has not been successful yet, however, different methods are being used in the industry. The Galaxy Plecostomus is an egg-layer that tends to use plants and rocks as an anchor. Feeding the Galaxy Plecostomus is not difficult due to the fact that it is not a picky eater. Feeding off the bottom of the aquarium, it gets most of its nutrition from left over food and algae. If there is no algae or left over food present, supplement with high quality flake food, sinking carnivore pellets, freeze-dri
products.description_zh: 银河 Plecostomus 也被称为吸血鬼或牙鼻 Pleco Pleco，来自南美洲亚马逊盆地。它呈黑色，全身布满许多醒目的黄色斑点。这种鲶鱼的俗名来自于嘴上侧的鬃毛状杠铃。牙鼻异形鱼是任何社区水族箱的良好补充。具有高通气性和水流动性的水草缸营造出健康的环境。岩石和浮木有助于突出自然栖息地，并提供隐藏空间以减轻牙鼻异兽的压力。建议至少提供 50 加仑的水箱来容纳这种鱼。在水族箱中繁殖 setting 尚未成功，但是业界正在使用不同的方法。 Galaxy Plecostomus 是一种产卵动物，倾向于使用植物和岩石作为锚点。喂养 Galaxy Plecostomus 并不困难，因为它不挑食。它以水族箱底部为食，从剩余的食物和藻类中获取大部分营养。如果没有藻类或剩余食物，补充优质片状食物、沉性食肉动物颗粒、冻干食物

products.title: Flowerhorn Cichlid 6.5" 2
products.description: The Flowerhorn Cichlid is the result of crossbreeding different Central American Cichlids. These fish have an elongated body with large pronounced dorsal and anal fins. The juvenile form is silver in coloration, which turns into a bright red as they mature. A mature fish with complete coloration will be about 5 inches in length. The Flowerhorn Cichlid requires an aquarium of at least 50 gallons, with a sandy bottom, rocks and plenty of hiding places among the rocks. Live plants should be planted in pots to protect the roots from these fish. They are territorial and will eat smaller fish or invertebrates that they can swallow. The Flowerhorn Cichlid is difficult to distinguish between the male and female. The females are typically less brightly colored and smaller then the males. Neutral water with soft to medium hardness, a pH of approximately 7.0, and temperatures of 78-82°F is recommended. Flowerhorn Cichlid are open breeders that need well-oxygenated water. They spawn in burrows, laying up to 500 eggs. The fry are well protected by the parents, and once mated, they will continue to spawn once the fry have grown. The Flowerhorn Cichlid is omnivorous and will eat most prepared and
products.description_zh: 花角慈鲷是不同中美洲慈鲷杂交的结果。这些鱼的身体细长，有大而明显的背鳍和臀鳍。幼年体呈银色，成熟后变成鲜红色。一条颜色完整的成熟鱼的长度约为 5 英寸。花角丽鱼科鱼需要至少 50 加仑的水族箱，底部有沙质，有岩石，岩石间有足够的藏身之处。应将活植物种植在花盆中，以保护根部免受这些鱼的侵害。它们具有领地意识，会吃较小的鱼或它们可以吞咽的无脊椎动物。花角慈鲷很难区分雌雄e 和女性。雌性通常比雄性颜色不那么鲜艳，体型也较小。建议使用软到中等硬度、pH 值约为 7.0、温度为 78-82°F 的中性水。花角慈鲷是开放式繁殖者，需要氧气充足的水。它们在洞穴中产卵，产卵多达 500 个。鱼苗受到父母的良好保护，一旦交配，鱼苗长大后就会继续产卵。花角丽鱼科鱼是杂食性的，会吃最准备好的和

products.title: Black Kuhlii Loach 3"
products.description: The Black Kuhlii Loach is one of about 100 species in the Cobitidae family. Loaches are bottom dwelling scavengers with reduced or absent scales and a mouth surrounded by barbels used to taste. At times, the loach will lie on its side when there are insufficient hiding places, giving the impression that it is sick; this behavior is normal. Largely nocturnal, loaches are shy fish that like to hide among driftwood, plant roots, rocks, and caves. Loaches are peaceful fish that get along well with other peaceful community tank mates. Unfortunately, the breeding habits of the Black Kuhlii Loach have not been documented. Although it is a scavenger, Pangio semicinctus is largely carnivorous, preferring freeze-dried bloodworms and tubifex, as well as frozen and live foods of all types. With time and training, the Black Kuhlii Loach may accept flake foods.
products.description_zh: 黑泥鳅是鳅科约 100 种泥鳅之一。泥鳅是底栖食腐动物，鳞片减少或无鳞，嘴周围有用于品尝的触须。有时，当藏身之处不够时，泥鳅会侧卧，给人一种生病的印象；这种行为是正常的。泥鳅主要在夜间活动，是一种害羞的鱼类，喜欢躲在浮木、植物根、岩石和洞穴中。泥鳅是性情温和的鱼类，能与其他性情温和的社区水族伙伴相处得很好。不幸的是，黑泥鳅的繁殖习性尚未有记录。虽然它是食腐动物，但 Pangio semicinctus 主要是肉食性的，更喜欢环冻干红虫和圆环虫，以及所有类型的冷冻和活食品。经过时间和训练，黑泥鳅可能会接受片状食物。

products.title: Yellowfin Tang
products.description: The Yellowfin Tang, also known as the Yellow-Mask Surgeonfish, is the largest of the Acanthurus genus, ideal for grand show displays and public aquariums. Coloration varies widely between juveniles and adults, with younger fish exhibiting yellow fins which morph to a dullish purple as they mature. In its natural habitat, the Yellowfin Tang can be found widely distributed in waters ranging from 3 to 300 feet. A 360 gallon or larger established aquarium with large amounts of live rock is necessary to provide both plenty of swimming room and territories within the live rock. Although tangs will eat meaty foods along with the other fish in the aquarium, it is important that they are offered plenty of marine based seaweed and algae. This will strengthen their immune system, reduce aggression and improve their overall health. Offer dried seaweed tied to a rock or use a veggie clip, and feed at least 3 times per week. Sea Veggies, Seaweed Salad and Ocean Nutrition are all ideal products and are very easy to use. These are great fish for controlling algae in the saltwater fish or reef aquarium. Approximate Purchase Size: Small: 1" - 2-1/4"; Small/Medium: 2-1/4" - 3-1/4"; Medium: 3-1/4" - 4
products.description_zh: 黄鳍唐鱼，也称为黄面具刺鱼，是棘刺鱼属中最大的一种，非常适合大型展览和公共水族馆。幼鱼和成鱼的颜色差异很大，幼鱼的鳍呈黄色，成熟后会变成暗紫色。在其自然栖息地，黄鳍唐鱼广泛分布在 3 至 300 英尺的水域中。需要拥有大量活石的 360 加仑或更大的水族箱才能提供充足的游泳池和活石内的区域。虽然唐吊会和水族箱中的其他鱼一样吃肉类食物，但为它们提供充足的食物很重要海洋海藻和藻类的含量。这将增强他们的免疫系统，减少攻击性并改善他们的整体健康状况。将干海藻绑在岩石上或使用蔬菜夹，每周至少喂食 3 次。海洋蔬菜、海藻沙拉和海洋营养都是理想的产品，而且非常易于使用。这些是控制咸水鱼或珊瑚礁水族馆中藻类的好鱼。大约购买尺寸：小号：1 英寸 - 2-1/4 英寸；小号/中号：2-1/4 英寸 - 3-1/4 英寸；中号：3-1/4" - 4

products.title: Colony Polyp Zoanthus Corals
products.description: The Blue & Green and Yellow Colony Polyp Corals are stunning color varieties of the Zoanthus Colony Polyp Coral, also commonly known as Sea Mats or Button Polyps. These soft corals are prized for their bright, eye-catching hues and are available in a wide array of color morphs that add vibrant visual interest to reef aquariums. Each colony is composed of multiple individual polyps growing together on a piece of live rock, creating a carpet-like effect that enhances reefscapes with dynamic texture and movement. The Blue &; Green coloration offers a cool-toned, soothing contrast to reef lighting, while the Yellow variety adds bold, sunny pops of color that stand out against live rock and other coral. Together, these varieties create a visually stimulating and rhythmic display ideal for reef keepers looking to enrich their aquarium with color diversity. Like other Zoanthus corals, both the Blue &; Green and Yellow Colony Polyp Corals are relatively easy to care for, making them great choices for beginner and seasoned aquarists alike. They thrive in low to moderate water flow and under moderate lighting provided by T-5s, powerful LEDs, or metal halides. Regular supplementation of iodin
products.description_zh: 蓝绿和黄色群落水螅珊瑚是 Zoanthus 群落水螅珊瑚的颜色令人惊叹的品种，通常也称为海垫或纽扣水螅。这些软珊瑚因其明亮、引人注目的色调而备受推崇，并且有多种颜色变形可供选择，为珊瑚礁水族箱增添了充满活力的视觉趣味。每个珊瑚群都由多个单独的水螅体组成，它们生长在一块活石上，形成地毯般的效果，通过动态纹理和运动增强珊瑚礁景观。蓝色&;绿色与珊瑚礁照明形成冷色调、舒缓的对比，而黄色则增添了大胆、阳光明媚的流行色彩，在活石和其他岩石的衬托下脱颖而出。珊瑚。这些品种共同创造了一种视觉刺激和有节奏的展示，非常适合那些希望通过色彩多样性丰富他们的水族箱的珊瑚礁饲养者。与其他 Zoanthus 珊瑚一样，蓝色和;绿色和黄色群落息肉珊瑚相对容易护理，对于初学者和经验丰富的水族爱好者来说都是不错的选择。它们在中低水流和 T-5、强大的 LED 或金属卤化物提供的中等照明下茁壮成长。定期补充碘

products.title: Ingen's Seahorse, Captive-Bred
products.description: The Ingen’s Seahorse, Hippocampus ingens , is one of the largest of the seahorse species. In the wild they spend most of their time hunting for tiny crustaceans to consume while using slow movements and camouflage to mimic their surroundings and appear invisible to predators. The Ingen’s Seahorse can be reddish to maroon, gray, yellow and gold with various shades of brown they may also have fine white markings which may run vertically down their body. Looking for the best food to feed your Seahorses? We recommend AlgaGen Tisbe biminiensis. These social fish thrive when kept as a mated pair or in small groups in a species-only aquarium. A 30 gallon aquarium is sufficient for a single pair. Add 20 gallons to the size of the aquarium for each additional pair. Spray bars may be used to create gentle flow while eliminating stagnant areas in the aquarium. Seahorses are not strong swimmers, preferring to use their prehensile tails to hitch to branching live rock, algae, or artificial decorations. Seahorses are less likely to contract Vibrio bacterial infections if the temperature is not allowed to exceed 74°F. This is particularly important if the aquarium contains other species of Syngna
products.description_zh: 英根海马（Hippocampus ingens）是最大的海马物种之一。在野外，它们大部分时间都在寻找微小的甲壳类动物来食用，同时使用缓慢的动作和伪装来模仿周围的环境，对捕食者来说是隐形的。英根海马的颜色可以是淡红色到栗色、灰色、黄色和金色，并带有各种深浅的棕色，它们也可能有细小的白色斑纹，这些斑纹可能垂直向下延伸到身体上。正在寻找喂养海马的最佳食物吗？我们推荐 AlgaGen Tisbe biminiensis。这些群居鱼类在只有物种的水族箱中成对饲养或小群饲养时会茁壮成长。 30加仑的水族箱足以容纳一对。广告d 每增加一对，需根据水族箱的大小添加 20 加仑。喷杆可用于产生柔和的水流，同时消除水族箱中的停滞区域。海马游泳能力不强，它们更喜欢用可抓握的尾巴来拴住分枝的活石、藻类或人造装饰品。如果温度不超过 74°F，海马就不太可能感染弧菌。如果水族箱里有其他种类的 Syngna，这一点尤其重要

products.title: Oreni Tilefish -
products.description: Be one of the few people IN THE WORLD to own an Oreni Tilefish Hoplolatilus oreni , referred to by some as the Holy Grail in aquarium keeping. A member of the Malacanthidae family, most Tilefish display shy or skittish behavior, but not this beauty. Sought after because it is rare, peaceful, photogenic, and has a lot of personality, it is relatively new to the aquarium industry. The Oreni Tilefish being offered by LiveAquaria® is from Kenya. Growing to a maximum of 8”, this marine fish displays a blue metallic zigzag line mid-body starting behind the head and ending at the base of the caudal fin. Scattered spots appear above the midline in a broken blue line on a bronze background. It possesses a torpedo-shaped body and has an ethereal presence. Demersal, it will live close to the bottom of your aquarium and create burrows or mounds in which it retreats if it feels threatened, so provide plenty of substrate. Requiring a relatively large aquarium (50 gallon minimum) because of its active nature, you will want to protect your investment by providing a cover for your aquarium. This Dartfish requires a diet containing a variety of marine fish, crustacean flesh, and Mysis shrimp fed two

products.title: Spotfin Butterflyfish
products.description: Bold, bright, and easy to care for, the Spotfin Reef Butterfly is named for the small, black spot located on the end of the dorsal fin. Adults are white, with bright yellow pelvic and caudal fins, and a narrow yellow bar from the gill to the base of the pectoral fins. A vivid black, vertical bar on the head passes through the eye. Juveniles exhibit an added dark spot at the base of the anal fins with a shadowy streak that extends to the small spot on the dorsal fin. What really sets the Spotfin Reef Butterfly apart is at night, this fish undergoes remarkable changes. The large, dusky smudge on the dorsal fin becomes black and broad, and dark bands appear on the body. It is also known to sometimes swim upside down, and occasionally squirt water like fountain above the waterline. The Spotfin Reef Butterfly is peaceful, most commonly found in shallow waters around coral reefs alone or in bonded pairs, who form a lifelong partnership. Most active during the day, they change color and seek shelter for sleep in the evening, as they are highly vulnerable to larger predators. Fellow tankmates should be peaceful in nature. Spotfin Butterflies are not recommended in the reef aquarium. A fini
products.description_zh: 斑鳍珊瑚蝴蝶大胆、明亮且易于照顾，因其背鳍末端的小黑点而得名。成鱼呈白色，有亮黄色的腹鳍和尾鳍，从鳃到胸鳍基部有一条狭窄的黄色条。头上有一条生动的黑色竖条穿过眼睛。幼鱼在臀鳍底部有一个额外的黑点，并有一条阴影条纹延伸到背鳍上的小点。真正让斑鳍礁蝴蝶与众不同的是在晚上，这种鱼会发生显着的变化。背鳍上的大块暗色斑点变得又黑又宽，身体上出现深色条纹。也有一些人知道有时会倒着游，偶尔会在吃水线上方像喷泉一样喷水。斑鳍礁蝴蝶性情平和，最常见于珊瑚礁周围的浅水中，单独或成对出现，形成终生伙伴关系。它们白天最活跃，晚上会改变颜色并寻找庇护所睡觉，因为它们非常容易受到较大捕食者的攻击。战友们的天性应该是平和的。不建议在珊瑚礁水族箱中饲养斑鳍蝴蝶。阿菲尼

products.title: Melon Butterflyfish
products.description: It is evident the Melon Butterflyfish Chaetodon trifasciatus draws attention wherever it goes, due to the number of names by which it is known. It is called the Indian Redfin Butterflyfish, Pinstriped Butterflyfish, Lineated Butterflyfish, and Purple Butterflyfish, among others. In nature, this Butterflyfish makes its home among coral reefs. A rare and beautiful pale lavender colored fish, its body is flat and oval shaped and has darker purple diagonal stripes that stretch between its gills to its caudal fin. The anal fin is melon colored and that color also appears on the base of the caudal fin. A dark spot is visible on its upper body. There is a wide dark bar that travels from one side of its head to the opposite side, travelling through the eye area. Melon coloring is again visible as it radiates across its chest and part of its head. A semi-aggressive fish, it enjoys live rock that provides hiding places and an aquarium with a lot of swimming area. It is possible to keep a male-female pair if they get along, but members of the same sex may fight. This member of the Chaetodontidae family is not reef safe, as it feeds on coral polyps (especially SPS) and may nibble on Tridacna c
products.description_zh: 很明显，瓜蝴蝶鱼 Chaetodon trifasciatus 无论走到哪里都会引起人们的注意，因为它的名字很多。它被称为印度红鳍蝴蝶鱼、细条纹蝴蝶鱼、线纹蝴蝶鱼和紫色蝴蝶鱼等。在自然界中，这种蝴蝶鱼在珊瑚礁中安家。一种罕见而美丽的淡紫色鱼，它的身体呈扁平椭圆形，有深紫色的斜条纹，从鳃到尾鳍。臀鳍呈瓜色，尾鳍基部也出现这种颜色。它的上半身有一个黑点。有一个宽阔的暗条从一侧延伸出来它的头转向另一侧，穿过眼睛区域。当它辐射到它的胸部和头部的一部分时，瓜色再次可见。它是一种半攻击性的鱼，喜欢提供藏身之处的活石和有很多游泳区的水族馆。如果男女相处融洽，可以保留它们，但同性成员可能会打架。这种毛齿兽科的成员对珊瑚礁并不安全，因为它以珊瑚虫（尤其是 SPS）为食，并且可能会啃食砗磲。

products.title: Kaudern's Cardinal
products.description: The Kaudern's Cardinal is highly sought after for its ease of care, attractive color pattern and distinctively long and elegant fins. The Kaudern's Cardinal, also known as the Banggai Cardinalfish or Longfin Cardinalfish, is metallic silver highlighted by rich black stripes and white, celestial spots on the body and fins. This sophisticated color pattern of the Kaudern's Cardinal makes it a visual striking and memorable addition to most saltwater aquariums. A 30 gallon or larger aquarium with cave-like rockwork and peaceful tank mates is ideal for this slow and methodical swimmer. Due to its aggressive behavior towards conspecifics, the Kaudern's Cardinal should not be kept in large groups. The Kaudern's Cardinal is relatively easy to breed in the aquarium setting. Once spawning has occurred, the male carries the eggs in his mouth to protect them. The Kaudern's Cardinal should be fed a well balanced diet of meaty foods such as feeder shrimp, marine flesh, bloodworms, and depending on its size, live feeder fish. Approximate Purchase Size: 1" to 2"

products.title: Captive-Bred Peacekeeper Maroon Clownfish
products.description: The Captive-Bred Peacekeeper Maroon Clownfish, available exclusively at LiveAquaria, showcases bold, high-contrast barring and deep maroon coloration. Each individual displays a unique pattern, with their markings becoming more striking and defined as they mature. Maroon clowns are well known for their intense coloration and oversized fins as well as their confident disposition. An adult-sized Peacekeeper Maroon with fully developed coloration is a striking centerpiece for any home aquarium. When pairing this species, it's typically best to have a dramatic difference in size between the individuals. Captive-bred clownfish are very hardy and durable fish making them a perfect addition for the novice or seasoned aquarist. The Peacekeeper Maroon Clownfish is a good candidate for a reef aquarium. In general, Maroon Clownfish are the most territorial of all clownfish species. Maroon Clownfish are very sensitive to elevated levels of copper, and should never be exposed to levels near or above .15. Captive bred clownfish are easy to breed in the home aquarium. products.title: LiveAquaria® CCGC Aquacultured Montipora Coral
products.description: Live corals are important contributors to the structure of a saltwater reef in nature as well as in reef aquariums. Our Certified Captive Grown Coral CCGC Aquacultured Montipora Coral ( Montipora sp .) are grown by our dedicated Wisconsin staff at our own LiveAquaria® facility. We are committed to providing healthy and attractive alternatives to wild caught specimens, so as not to contribute to the world’s declining coral reefs. Montipora sp corals are popular choices for aquariums because of the variety they offer. Not only do they come in many forms, but they also exhibit one of three different growth structures: branching, plating, or encrusting. The LiveAquaria® Aquacultured Montipora Coral has an encrusting formation that is hard and bumpy in appearance. Hobbyists that use our LiveAquaria® Professional Reef Salt have the added benefit knowing marine species shipped from our Wisconsin Facility share the same water parameters. products.title: Honeycomb Filefish
products.description: The Honeycomb Filefish Cantherhines pardalis has a wide distribution area in nature and lives among silty reef habitats at depths of around sixty-five feet. The species shown here offered by LiveAquaria® hails from Sri Lanka, but there are specimens of this marine fish found in Africa, Australia, Japan, and the United States (excluding Hawaii). Other names they are known by include the Wirenet Filefish, Honeycomb Leatherjacket, or Leopard Leatherjacket. It is a shy and secretive fish, most usually found living alone. Although they can grow to almost ten inches, six inches is more common. This Filefish has an oval shape that is laterally compressed, and two dominate dorsal spines in the front of the head that can sit in a groove in the dorsal area or stand at attention. These spines are coupled with soft rays at the rear of the dorsal fin. Eyes are set high on the face and a fair distance from its mouth. The Honeycomb Filefish can be found in three different colorations: greyish brown with a honeycomb pattern, an all over dark brown color, or in a mottled color of gray to brown.
